The Benedictine monastery connected local religious life with wider institutions, while agriculture supplied grain, livestock and rents to urban and ecclesiastical households.

The crown took over Ringsted's monastery at the Reformation in 1536, although it continued under an abbot until 1592. The town had already begun to decline in the late Middle Ages; it lost one of its three markets in 1615 and suffered repeated fires. Its church and royal associations nevertheless remained central to its identity.
simp_chinese:
灵斯泰兹位于西兰岛内陆，横穿岛屿的道路在这里汇合，聚落同丹麦王室及宗教机构关系密切。圣本笃教堂成为中世纪丹麦王室成员的安葬地，使城镇的意义超出市场与周围农田。本笃会修道院把地方宗教生活同更广泛的组织相连，农业则为城镇居民与教会家庭提供粮食、牲畜及地租收入。

1536年宗教改革时，王室接管灵斯泰兹修道院，但修道院仍由院长管理至1592年。城镇在中世纪晚期已经开始衰退，1615年又失去三处市场中的一处，随后屡遭火灾。教堂和王室联系仍是地方身份的重要组成部分。

english: Lake Riñihue lies in the Andean foothills east of Valdivia, its basin carved by glaciers and surrounded by wooded hills. It receives water from Lake Panguipulli through the Enco River, and its outlet becomes the San Pedro River. Farther west the river joins the Calle-Calle and Valdivia, carrying the waters of the lake district to the Pacific. Riñihue is the westernmost lake in a connected chain of southern Andean waters.
simp_chinese: 里尼韦湖位于瓦尔迪维亚以东的安第斯山麓，湖盆由冰川塑造，四周环绕林木茂盛的山丘。它经恩科河接收潘吉普伊湖的水，出水口形成圣佩德罗河。河流向西与卡耶卡耶河及瓦尔迪维亚河相连，将湖区的水带向太平洋。里尼韦是南安第斯相连湖泊中最西面的一个。

sources.title: Guía paleobotanica del río San Pedro.pdf
2017. red monitoreo lagos los rios (dga y eula).pdf

english:
Rinpung lies in the mountainous Songpan region of western Sichuan. Routes through this country connected agricultural districts with Tibetan highland communities.

Songpan itself was a military post whose town was rebuilt during the Ming dynasty. It also served as a center for exchanges of horses and tea among Sichuan, Gansu, Qinghai, and Tibet.
simp_chinese:
仁蚌位于川西松潘一带山地。穿越山区的道路将农业地区与藏地高原社群联系起来。

松潘本身是军事据点，城镇在明代重建，也是四川、甘肃、青海与西藏之间茶马交换的中心。

english: Rinpung lies in the Tsang country of central Tibet, along the valley of the Yarlung Tsangpo. Its name is shared with the fortress west of Shigatse from which the Rinpung family took its title. Rising from local authority under the Phagmodru rulers, the family transferred its administration to the fortress of Samdrubtse at Shigatse in 1435. Its power subsequently extended across Tsang, and in the late fifteenth century its leaders intervened in the affairs of Lhasa and Ü.
simp_chinese: 仁布位于西藏中部的藏地，沿雅鲁藏布江河谷分布。日喀则以西的一座同名宗堡，是仁蚌家族称号的来源。该家族原是帕竹统治下的地方势力，1435年将政务中心迁往日喀则的桑珠孜宗堡。此后仁蚌势力扩展至藏地各处，十五世纪末，其首领又介入拉萨和卫地的事务。

english: Rio del Rey is a broad estuary on the eastern shore of the Bight of Biafra, where tidal creeks wind through mangrove forests. Its waterways brought coastal communities into contact with traders arriving by sea. By the seventeenth century, commerce with Europeans had become established along this coast; inland networks supplied goods and enslaved people to the ports of the bight. Farther west, the Efik settlements of Old Calabar became a major center of the same Atlantic trade.
simp_chinese: 雷伊河是比夫拉湾东岸一片宽阔的河口，潮汐水道在红树林中蜿蜒。河道将沿岸社群与从海上到来的商人联系起来。十七世纪时，这片海岸与欧洲人的贸易已经形成；内陆网络向海湾港口输送货物和被奴役者。更西面的埃菲克聚落旧卡拉巴尔后来成为这一大西洋贸易的重要中心。

english: Bolola lies on the great tidal inlet known as the Rio Grande de Buba, beyond the channels of the Bijagós islands. The river was also known by the name Bolola, and its banks formed part of the country of the Biafada. African rulers controlled communities along the waterway, where merchants from the coast could meet those coming from inland. Portuguese traders moved upriver to Bolola as the older market of Bijorei declined, making the inlet a meeting place of African and Atlantic commerce.
simp_chinese: 博洛拉位于称为布巴大河的宽阔潮汐水道沿岸，外侧是比热戈斯群岛间的航道。这条河也曾以博洛拉为名，两岸属于比亚法达人居住的地区。非洲统治者掌管沿河社群，海岸商人可以在这里与内陆来客交易。随着比若雷旧市场衰落，葡萄牙商人沿河迁往博洛拉，使这片水域成为非洲与大西洋贸易的交汇处。

english: The Rio Nuñez winds from the hills of Guinea towards a wide Atlantic estuary. Its lower reaches pass through a coastal landscape of mangroves and tidal waterways, inhabited by Baga and Landouma communities. Rice cultivation and fishing sustained settlements along the river, while its navigable waters provided a route between the coast and inland markets. At Boké, upstream from the estuary, Landouma rulers and merchants dealt with visitors seeking access to the commerce of the river.
simp_chinese: 努涅斯河从几内亚丘陵蜿蜒流向宽阔的大西洋河口。下游穿过红树林与潮汐水道交错的海岸，巴加人和兰杜马人居住于此。稻作和捕鱼支撑沿河聚落，通航水道也为海岸与内陆市场提供了联系。在河口上游的博凯，兰杜马统治者与商人同希望参与河上贸易的外来者打交道。

english: The Rio Nunez reaches the Atlantic through a coast of mangrove channels and rice fields. Baga and Nalu farmers supplied rice to traders, exchanging it and other local products for goods from the interior. In 1793 the slave-ship captain Samuel Gamble recorded the skill with which Baga farmers managed irrigated fields. Their expertise existed alongside the dangers of the Atlantic slave trade, as raids and the expansion of inland powers brought violence to the rice-growing communities of the coast.
simp_chinese: 努涅斯河穿过红树林水道与稻田交错的海岸，汇入大西洋。巴加人与纳卢农人向商人供应稻米，以稻米和其他土产交换内陆货物。1793年，奴隶船船长塞缪尔·甘布尔记述了巴加农人经营灌溉稻田的精湛技艺。与此同时，大西洋奴隶贸易带来危险，劫掠与内陆势力的扩张使沿海稻作社群遭受暴力。

english: Rio Pardo de Minas lies in the upper Rio Pardo country of northern Minas Gerais. Gold discoveries encouraged settlement and trade with Bahia, while the surrounding hills and rivers formed part of the routes through the interior. The district belonged to Minas Novas until 1831, when it became the town of Nossa Senhora da Conceição do Rio Pardo. Its municipal council was installed two years later.
simp_chinese: 里奥帕尔杜迪米纳斯位于米纳斯吉拉斯北部的帕尔杜河上游地区。黄金的发现促进了定居以及与巴伊亚的贸易，周围丘陵和河流则属于通往内陆的道路网络。这里原属米纳斯诺瓦斯，1831年升格为里奥帕尔杜圣母无染原罪镇，两年后设立市议会。

english: Rio Pomba grew in the wooded eastern backlands of Minas Gerais, on a river that drains toward the Paraíba do Sul. In 1767 Father Manoel de Jesus Maria began missionary work among the Indigenous peoples of the region, and the parish of Rio Pomba was established. The concentration of Indigenous communities in colonial settlements helped open the surrounding country to incoming farmers, profoundly altering the lives of its earlier inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 里奥蓬巴兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯东部森林腹地，坐落在一条流向南帕拉伊巴河的河流旁。1767年，曼努埃尔·迪热苏斯·玛丽亚神父开始在当地原住民中传教，里奥蓬巴堂区随之设立。原住民社区被集中到殖民聚落，为外来农民进入周围土地创造了条件，也深刻改变了原有居民的生活。

english: The Rio Pongo is a tidal estuary on the Upper Guinea coast, where mangrove-lined channels open towards the Atlantic. Baga communities lived along its shores, cultivating rice and maintaining exchanges with peoples of the interior. The river gave access to a network of settlements and trading places amid the wetlands. By the late eighteenth century the Pongo had become an important outlet for the Atlantic slave trade. African and Afro-European merchants established trading houses along the river, buying captives brought from inland and dealing with visiting ships. Their commerce grew from older connections between the coast and Futa Jalon, while competition among traders and coastal authorities shaped the trade in people and goods.
simp_chinese: 蓬戈河是上几内亚海岸的一处潮汐河口，红树林环绕的水道通向大西洋。巴加社群居住在沿岸，种植稻米，并同内陆人群交换物产。河道穿过湿地，通往众多村落和贸易点。十八世纪末，蓬戈河成为大西洋奴隶贸易的重要出口。非洲及非欧混血商人在河边设立商馆，购买从内陆带来的俘虏，与来访船只交易。这门生意建立在海岸与富塔贾隆之间更早的联系之上，商人和沿海首领之间的竞争也影响着人口及货物的交易。

english: Rio Preto grew beside the river of the same name in the southern hills of Minas Gerais. A colonial registration post stood here on a route carrying gold toward Rio de Janeiro, and a settlement developed around it. Coffee cultivation gained importance in the valley from the 1820s. In 1832 the community’s church, dedicated to Nosso Senhor dos Passos, was raised to parish status.
simp_chinese: 里奥普雷图兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯南部丘陵的同名河畔。这里曾有一处殖民登记站，位于将黄金运往里约热内卢的道路上，聚落围绕它发展。十九世纪二十年代起，咖啡种植在河谷中日益重要。1832年，供奉受难主的小教堂升格为堂区教堂。

english: The Río Salado spreads into the dry plains of La Rioja after passing between the Mazán and Ambato ranges. Its broad lower bed divides into channels marked by salt deposits, while occasional torrents descend from the neighbouring hills. The river is part of the Abaucán system, whose flow varies greatly; in the low country its waters disperse into saline ground rather than reaching the sea. Nearby lies the extensive salt basin of La Antigua.
simp_chinese: 萨拉多河穿过马桑山脉和安巴托山脉之间的地带后，流入拉里奥哈的干旱平原。宽阔的下游河床分为多条水道，河床上留有盐类沉积；附近山岭偶尔也有急流汇入。萨拉多河属于流量变化很大的阿瓦坎河水系，河水在低地散入盐碱地，无法到达海洋。附近还有广阔的拉安蒂瓜盐盆地。

english: Riom grew around the church and relics of Saint Amable, a centre of pilgrimage in the Auvergne. It became the capital of the ducal lands of Auvergne, and the patronage of Duke Jean of Berry gave it a ducal palace and a Sainte-Chapelle. The Bourbon family held the duchy from 1416 until 1527. Riom and the duchy subsequently passed to Louise of Savoy and were joined definitively to the French crown in 1531.
simp_chinese: 里永围绕圣阿马布勒的教堂与遗骸发展起来，是奥弗涅的一处朝圣中心。它成为奥弗涅公爵领的首府，贝里公爵让在此兴建公爵宫殿和圣礼拜堂。1416至1527年，波旁家族拥有这一公国；此后里永和公国转入萨伏依的路易丝手中，并于1531年最终归属法国王室。

english: Ripoll grew around the Benedictine monastery of Santa Maria, founded by Count Wilfred the Hairy in the ninth century. Its Romanesque church and sculpted portal made the monastery a distinguished monument of Catalonia, while its scriptorium produced and preserved a remarkable collection of manuscripts. In 1835 the monks were expelled and the monastery was burned and looted, destroying part of its library.
simp_chinese: 里波尔围绕圣玛丽亚本笃会修道院发展起来，修道院由毛人伯爵维尔弗雷德于9世纪创建。罗曼式教堂和雕刻门廊使它成为加泰罗尼亚的重要建筑，而抄经室制作并保存了珍贵的手稿藏书。1835年，修士被逐，修道院遭到焚烧和劫掠，部分藏书因此毁失。

english: Ripon stands near the River Ure in northern Yorkshire, its minster rising above an old market town. The church traces its origins to a monastery associated with St Wilfrid in the seventh century; its ancient crypt survived beneath later buildings. The collegiate foundation was dissolved in 1547, but the church continued as the parish church. In 1836 it became the cathedral of a new diocese, giving renewed standing to an ancient religious centre.
simp_chinese: 里彭位于约克郡北部乌尔河附近，宏伟教堂高踞古老集镇之上。教堂可追溯至七世纪与圣威尔弗里德有关的修道院，古老地下室在后来的建筑下保存下来。教士团于1547年解散，但教堂继续作为教区教堂使用。1836年，它成为新教区的大教堂，使古老宗教中心获得新的地位。

english:
Rippowam was the Indigenous name for the country around the river and harbour later known as Stamford, on Long Island Sound. The Siwanoy lived here before English settlement, and the river gave its name to the first colonial plantation. In 1640 Nathaniel Turner of New Haven reached an agreement for land with the sachems Ponus and Wascussee.

English settlers arrived in 1641 and soon ordered a dam and gristmill built on the Rippowam River. Their town was renamed Stamford after an English town in Lincolnshire. Land was divided among the colonial households partly according to their contributions to the purchase. The agreement was renegotiated more than once; in 1700 Catoona and Coee, believed to be descendants of Ponus and his family, confirmed earlier grants to the settlers.
simp_chinese:
里波瓦姆是后来称为斯坦福的河流与港湾周围地区的原住民名称，位于长岛海峡岸边。英国人定居以前，西瓦诺伊人生活在这里；河名也被用于最初的殖民聚落。1640年，纽黑文的纳撒尼尔·特纳与首领波纳斯和瓦斯库西就土地达成协议。

英国移民于1641年到来，不久便下令在里波瓦姆河上修建堤坝和碾坊。城镇后来以英格兰林肯郡的一座城镇改名为斯坦福。殖民家庭分得的土地部分依据各家为购地所出的份额。协议经过多次重新协商；1700年，据信为波纳斯家族后裔的卡图纳和科伊确认了先前向移民授予土地的协议。

english: Riseberga was a Cistercian convent in western Närke, founded in the late twelfth century with estates given by Earl Birger Brosa. Its sisters acquired property across several provinces, making the house an important landowner as well as a religious community. The Reformation under Gustav Vasa ended its monastic life, and a major fire in 1546 destroyed its buildings. The once wealthy convent was left to decay, its lands and stones passing into other hands.
simp_chinese: 里瑟贝里亚是奈尔克西部的一座熙笃会女修道院，十二世纪末以伯爵比耶尔·布鲁萨捐赠的庄园为基础建立。修女们在多个省份拥有地产，使修院既是宗教社群，也是重要地主。古斯塔夫·瓦萨时期的宗教改革结束了修道生活，1546年的大火又毁坏建筑。昔日富有的修院逐渐荒废，其土地和石料转入他人之手。

english: Rishiri is an island off the northern coast of Ezo, dominated by its high volcanic mountain. Ainu lived here and traded marine products with Japanese merchants; a record of 1670 describes their exchanges. Around 1765 a trading house was established at Motodomari, handling abalone, sea cucumbers, cod and herring. Russian raiders reached the island in 1807, and the following year men of the Aizu domain were assigned to guard it.
simp_chinese: 利尻是虾夷地北岸外的一座岛屿，高耸的火山主峰占据岛中央。阿伊努人居住于此，与日本商人交换海产；1670年的记载便描述了这种往来。约1765年，本泊设立交易所，经营鲍鱼、海参、鳕鱼和鲱鱼。1807年俄国袭击者来到岛上，次年会津藩士被派来守备。

english: The waters around Rishiri separate its volcanic island from the northern coast of Ezo and from neighbouring Rebun. Mount Rishiri rises steeply above the sea, while its lower slopes descend towards the shore. The warm Tsushima Current reaches this far north and influences the surrounding waters, though winter brings severe winds and snow. The sea supports fish and other marine life around the islands.
simp_chinese: 利尻周围的水域将这座火山岛与虾夷北岸及邻近的礼文岛隔开。利尻山从海中陡然升起，低处山坡向海岸延伸。暖流对马海流远达此处，影响周围海水，但冬季仍有猛烈风雪。岛屿附近的海洋孕育鱼类和其他海洋生物。

english: Rishton lies in the southern Fergana Valley and is known for its potters and local red clay. Excavations have uncovered kilns, workshops and both glazed and unglazed pottery from the ninth to twelfth centuries. The town's ceramic tradition draws on clay found beneath the surrounding land; vessels are shaped, fired and decorated with coloured glazes. In the early nineteenth century Rishton grew into a regional pottery centre, supplying bowls, dishes and pitchers to the markets of the valley.
simp_chinese: 里什坦位于费尔干纳谷地南部，以陶工和当地红黏土闻名。发掘发现了九至十二世纪的窑炉、作坊，以及有釉和无釉陶器。当地制陶传统使用地下黏土，陶器经塑形、烧制和施以彩釉。十九世纪初，里什坦逐渐成为地区制陶中心，为谷地市场供应碗、盘和水罐。

sources.title: EN UZ libretto Arca del gusto ok web.pdf

english:
Ristiina lies on the waterways of southern Savolax. Its name honours Kristina Katarina Stenbock, wife of Count Per Brahe, whose estate became the centre of a new parish. Brahe, governor-general of Finland, received extensive lands in Savo in 1640 and began building Brahelinna on a ridge beside the water in 1646.

Brahe separated the parish from Mikkeli in 1649. His residence, protected by a stone wall around a rectangular building of brick and timber, was intended as the administrative centre of his lands, though construction continued into the late 1660s and the main building remained unfinished. After the estate passed to the crown, it became a colonel's residence in 1688. A later manor building housed a military school founded by G. M. Sprengtporten from 1777 to 1780.
simp_chinese:
里斯蒂纳位于南萨沃拉克斯的水道之间，地名纪念佩尔·布拉赫伯爵的妻子克里斯蒂娜·卡塔琳娜·斯滕博克。芬兰总督布拉赫于1640年获得萨沃大片封地，1646年在水边山脊开始修筑布拉赫城堡，其庄园也成为新教区的中心。

1649年，布拉赫将当地教区从米凯利分出。他的驻地以石墙环绕，主楼呈长方形，以砖和木材建造，原拟作为封地的行政中心，但工程延续到1660年代末，主楼仍未完工。庄园归王室后，于1688年成为上校的官邸。后来的一座庄园建筑在1777至1780年间容纳了G. M. 斯普伦特波滕创办的军事学校。

english: Ritzebüttel stood near the mouth of the Elbe, where the passage between Hamburg and the North Sea made control of the coast valuable. Its stone castle belonged to the Lappe family until a dispute with Hamburg led to a siege in 1393. The following year the knights sold the castle and their possessions to the city. Hamburg adapted the stronghold for its own officials, raising its tower and making it the seat of the Amt of Ritzebüttel. For centuries this outlying district allowed Hamburg to exercise authority near the entrance to its river.
simp_chinese: 里策比特尔位于易北河口附近，汉堡与北海之间的航道使这段海岸的控制权十分宝贵。当地石城堡原属拉佩家族，与汉堡的争端引发了1393年的围攻。次年，骑士将城堡及其地产出售给汉堡。城市改建堡垒供官员使用，加高塔楼，并将其设为里策比特尔行政区的驻地。此后数百年，这块远离本城的领地使汉堡得以在河口附近行使权力。

english:
Riva stands at the northern end of Lake Garda, where lake traffic meets roads into the Alpine valleys. The bishops of Trent held rights over the town in the Middle Ages; a document of 1155 regulated rents, use of the harbour and military assistance. Its position drew the attention of neighbouring powers, and Riva passed at different times under the control of the Scaligeri of Verona and the Visconti of Milan.

In 1440 Venice captured Riva after fighting Milan on Lake Garda. The Venetians had hauled vessels overland from the Adige to bring a fleet onto the lake. Near the end of their rule they built a bastion above the town, but Venice withdrew in 1509 and the territory returned to the bishop of Trent. In the seventeenth century Riva produced wine, paper and silk and served as a lake port for timber brought down from the valleys.
simp_chinese:
里瓦坐落在加尔达湖北端，湖上交通在此与通往阿尔卑斯谷地的道路相接。中世纪时，特伦托主教拥有这里的权利；1155年的文书规定了租金、港口使用和军事援助等事项。城镇的位置吸引周边势力争夺，里瓦先后处于维罗纳的斯卡拉家族和米兰的维斯孔蒂家族控制之下。

1440年，威尼斯在加尔达湖上与米兰交战后夺取里瓦。为将舰队送入湖中，威尼斯人曾把船只从阿迪杰河拖过陆地。威尼斯统治末期，城镇上方建起堡垒；但1509年威尼斯撤出，领地重归特伦托主教。十七世纪，里瓦生产葡萄酒、纸和丝绸，也是将谷地木材运上湖船的港口。

english: The River Nomlaki lived in the Sacramento Valley, east of their Hill Nomlaki relatives in the Coast Range foothills. Together they formed the central division of the Wintun peoples, with the Wintu to the north and the Patwin to the south. Nomlaki villages were communities of related families, each led by a headman who directed food gathering and ceremonies and settled disputes. Acorns were a staple: women and children gathered them, and some oak trees were recognized as belonging to particular individuals.
simp_chinese: 河流诺姆拉基人住在萨克拉门托谷地，其山地诺姆拉基亲族则居于西面的海岸山麓。两者共同构成温通人的中部支系，北有温图人，南有帕特温人。诺姆拉基村庄由彼此有亲属关系的家庭组成，每村由一名首领主持食物采集和仪式，并调解争端。橡实是主要食物，通常由妇女和儿童采集；有些橡树被认为属于特定的人。

english: Riverie occupies a hill in the country southwest of Lyon. A castle and walled town grew around a market square, where the lord's officials administered the surrounding lands. During the Wars of Religion, Riverie supported the future Henry IV against the Catholic League. In August 1590 forces of the League, which controlled Lyon, destroyed the village and castle. The settlement was rebuilt, and its lordship passed to the Bénéon family in 1680.
simp_chinese: 里弗里占据里昂西南乡间的一座山丘。城堡和有城墙的城镇围绕市场广场发展，领主官员在此管理周围土地。宗教战争期间，里弗里支持未来的亨利四世，对抗天主教同盟。1590年8月，控制里昂的同盟军摧毁村庄和城堡。聚落后来重建，领地于1680年转入贝内翁家族之手。

english: The Riviera di Levante follows the Ligurian shore east of Genoa, where steep hills descend to the sea. Along the coast between the Cinque Terre and Portovenere, generations of inhabitants built terraces supported by dry-stone walls, creating cultivable ground on the difficult slopes. Small towns occupy narrow valleys and promontories beside the water. Riomaggiore's houses line the valley of a stream, one of the settlements shaped by the meeting of mountain and sea.
simp_chinese: 东里维埃拉沿热那亚以东的利古里亚海岸延伸，陡峭丘陵直落海边。五渔村与韦内雷港之间，世代居民在山坡上修筑干石墙支撑的梯田，开辟可耕作的土地。小镇坐落在临水的狭窄山谷和岬角上。里奥马焦雷的房屋沿溪谷排列，是这片山海交会之地形成的聚落之一。

english:
The Riviera di Ponente is the Ligurian coast running west from Genoa toward Ventimiglia. The slopes of the Alps and Apennines descend close to the sea, forming rocky headlands; between them, hills open around coastal settlements. The broader plain at Albenga is a notable exception to the narrow coastal terrain.

Ports and coastal routes connected towns such as Savona, Noli and Albenga with Genoa and the wider Mediterranean. Fishing and seafaring complemented agriculture, including olive cultivation on the slopes. In the later medieval and early modern centuries Genoese power shaped much of this shore, where maritime commerce and the defence of coastal communities were closely related.
simp_chinese:
西里维埃拉是从热那亚向西延伸至文蒂米利亚的利古里亚海岸。阿尔卑斯山与亚平宁山的山坡逼近海面，形成岩石岬角；岬角之间，丘陵环抱着沿海聚落。阿尔本加附近较宽阔的平原则是狭窄海岸地形中的例外。

港口和沿海航路将萨沃纳、诺利、阿尔本加等城镇与热那亚及更广阔的地中海世界联系起来。捕鱼和航海补充农业生计，山坡上也种植橄榄。中世纪后期与近世，热那亚势力影响着这片海岸，海上贸易与沿岸社区的防御紧密相连。

english: The Riviersonderend Mountains form part of the southwestern Cape's landscape of ridges and valleys. Across the wider region, Indigenous communities used resources through hunting, gathering, pastoral movement and exchange. Paths and seasonal knowledge connected different environments, while water and pasture influenced livelihoods. European settlement at the Cape in the seventeenth century gradually increased demands for land, livestock and labour. Colonial expansion affected Indigenous access to resources, while disease and conflict caused disruption. British rule brought further political change in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 里维尔松德伦山是开普西南部山脊与河谷景观的一部分。更广大地区的原住民社群依照地方传统，通过狩猎、采集、放牧和交换利用资源。道路与季节知识连接不同环境，水源和草场影响生计。十七世纪欧洲人在开普定居后，对土地、牲畜和劳力的需求逐渐增加。殖民扩张影响原住民获取资源，疾病与冲突造成破坏；十九世纪初英国统治又带来政治变化。

english:
Rivne lies in Volhynia, a region of fertile country, river routes, and towns whose political history linked Ruthenian traditions with Lithuania and Poland. The settlement developed within a landscape where noble estates, churches, and markets connected rural production with urban exchange. Its position among neighboring centers supported commerce and the movement of people through a culturally varied borderland.

In the late fifteenth century, Princess Maria Nesvytska made Rivne a princely residence and obtained Magdeburg rights for the settlement in 1492. Later noble owners included the Ostrogski and Lubomirski families. The town's markets and religious communities developed within the political world of Lithuania and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, before Volhynia passed to the Russian Empire in the partitions of Poland.
simp_chinese:
里夫内位于沃里尼亚，这一地区拥有肥沃乡村、河流路线和城镇，政治历史把鲁塞尼亚传统同立陶宛及波兰联系起来。聚落在贵族庄园、教堂和市场组成的景观中发展，把农村生产接到城市交换。邻近区域中心的位置，支持商业与人口在文化多样的边缘地区移动。

十五世纪末，玛丽亚·涅斯维茨卡公主将里夫内建为亲王居所，并于1492年为聚落取得马格德堡法权。后来的贵族领主包括奥斯特罗格斯基和卢博米尔斯基家族。市场与宗教社群在立陶宛及波兰立陶宛联邦的政治环境中发展；瓜分波兰后，沃里尼亚归入俄罗斯帝国。

english:
Riwoche lies in a fertile valley of the Dzi River, a tributary of the Mekong in eastern Tibet. Its great monastery eventually became the principal seat of the Taklung Kagyu tradition in Kham, renowned for learning and meditation. The valley and its monastery formed an important religious centre among the mountains west of Chamdo.

Sangye Ön founded Riwoche in 1276 after leaving Taklung in central Tibet. From then on the tradition had two principal seats: Taklung itself, called the upper branch, and Riwoche, the lower branch. The historian of the Blue Annals described Riwoche as a monastery of exceptional reputation in Kham, with a large community of monks. Its teachers carried the Taklung lineage into the religious life of eastern Tibet.
simp_chinese:
类乌齐坐落在藏地东部扎曲支流孜曲的肥沃河谷中。这里的大寺成为康区达隆噶举派的主要驻锡地，以学问和禅修闻名。河谷与寺院共同构成昌都以西群山间的重要宗教中心。

1276年，桑杰温离开卫藏达隆寺，在此建立类乌齐寺。此后达隆传承有两处主要驻锡地：达隆本寺为上部，类乌齐为下部。《青史》作者称类乌齐在康区寺院中声望极高，僧众众多。寺院历代上师将达隆传承带入藏东宗教生活。

english: Riz lies in the inland hills of southern Iran, above the Persian Gulf coast near the old port of Siraf. Mountain ridges divide the coastal strip from valleys where villages and cultivated land occupy sheltered ground. Siraf was a major maritime trading centre in the Sasanian and Islamic periods, linking the Persian coast with the wider Indian Ocean. The routes through these hills connected its harbour with the settlements and agricultural districts of the interior.
simp_chinese: 里兹位于伊朗南部内陆丘陵，俯瞰古港锡拉夫附近的波斯湾海岸。山岭将沿海地带与内陆谷地分隔，村庄和耕地占据较受庇护的土地。锡拉夫在萨珊和伊斯兰时期是重要海上贸易中心，将波斯海岸与更广阔的印度洋相连。穿越丘陵的道路把港口与内陆聚落和农业地区联系起来。

english:
Rize lies on the eastern Black Sea coast, where steep, wet slopes descend toward a narrow maritime strip. Cultivation, livestock, woodland products, and fishing supported communities using resources across different elevations. Roads inland were constrained by terrain, making coastal shipping important to movement and exchange. Rainfall and mountain water shaped a productive environment whose opportunities differed greatly from the drier Anatolian interior.

The wider eastern Black Sea coast was connected with Trebizond and the neighbouring Caucasian lands. Rize belonged to the historical region of Chaneti, which was incorporated into the Ottoman Empire in 1547. Coastal exchange continued under changing authorities.
simp_chinese:
里泽位于黑海东岸，陡峭湿润坡地下降到狭窄沿海带。耕作、牲畜、林产和捕鱼，支持跨不同海拔利用资源的社群。地形限制内陆道路，使沿海船运对移动、交换重要。降雨与山水塑造生产性环境，机会同较干安纳托利亚内地差别明显。

更广阔的黑海东岸与特拉比松及邻近高加索地区有联系。里泽属于历史上的查内蒂地区，该地区于1547年纳入奥斯曼帝国。统治变更之下，沿海交换仍在继续。

english:
Rizhao belongs to the southern Shandong coast, where low hills, cultivated land and the sea supported communities with mixed livelihoods. Grain fields supplied food, while fishing and other coastal resources added to household production. Markets linked villages with neighbouring towns, allowing agricultural produce and manufactured goods to circulate. Seasonal weather affected both harvests and maritime activity, and practical knowledge of safe approaches mattered wherever boats used exposed shores.

Rizhao became a county under the Jin in 1184. During the Ming it was administered under Ju Prefecture, and records describe salt fields on its eastern coast. The modern industrial port belongs to a much later period; the earlier county joined a farming and fishing countryside to coastal administration and regional markets.
simp_chinese:
日照属于山东南部海岸，低丘、耕地和海洋支撑混合生计社区。粮田供应食物，捕鱼及其他海岸资源补充家庭生产。市场把村庄同邻近城镇联系起来，让农产和手工业品流通。季节天气影响收成及海上活动，舟船利用暴露岸线时，认识安全通道尤为重要，居民需要兼顾水陆条件。

金大定二十四年（1184年）设日照县。明代日照属莒州，史籍记载其东部沿海设有盐场。现代工业港口属于很晚的发展阶段；较早的县域则将农渔乡村与沿海行政及区域市场联系起来。

english: Roanne grew beside the Loire, where routes between the Lyon region and central France met the river. Its medieval castle guarded the town, and the church of Saint-Étienne developed nearby. The lower town around the port expanded in the seventeenth century as boatmen and other workers served river traffic. Boats known as rambertes and sapines carried cargoes including coal and wine downstream toward Paris, although the Loire's uneven flow made navigation seasonal. The town also had a weaving tradition that grew in the early nineteenth century. In 1817 Sébastien Mulsant acquired land for small buildings in which families of weavers worked for him. A canal from Roanne to Digoin was decided upon in 1827 to improve transport, although it did not open until 1838, just beyond the period described here. River commerce and textile work connected the town to markets far beyond its immediate countryside.
simp_chinese: 罗阿讷沿卢瓦尔河发展，连接里昂地区和法国中部的道路在这里与河流相遇。中世纪城堡守护着城镇，圣艾蒂安教堂在附近发展起来。十七世纪，港口周围的下城随着航运繁盛而扩张，船工和其他劳动者为河上运输服务。被称为朗贝特和萨皮纳的船只将煤炭、葡萄酒等货物顺流运往巴黎方向，但卢瓦尔河流量不稳定，航行受到季节限制。当地织造传统在十九世纪初进一步发展。1817年，塞巴斯蒂安·米尔桑购地兴建小型房舍，安排织工家庭为他工作。为改善运输，1827年决定开凿罗阿讷至迪关运河；运河直到1838年才通航，稍晚于此处所述时代。河运贸易和织造劳动把城镇与远方市场联系起来。

english:
Roanoke Island lies between the Carolina mainland and the barrier islands of the Outer Banks. It takes its name from the Algonquian-speaking people who inhabited the area when English ships arrived in the 1580s. On the island's southern end, a settlement used for fishing had long provided its inhabitants with oysters, clams and other food from the surrounding waters.

Walter Raleigh sponsored an English settlement on the island in 1585; a second group of men, women and children arrived in 1587 under John White. White sailed back to England for supplies but was delayed by war with Spain. When he returned in 1590, the settlement was deserted and the word “CROATOAN” had been carved on a post. The colonists' subsequent fate remains one of the enduring mysteries of early English America.
simp_chinese:
罗阿诺克岛位于卡罗来纳大陆与外滩群岛之间，得名于十六世纪八十年代英国船只到来时居住在此的阿尔冈昆语族人。岛屿南端的一处渔业聚落由来已久，居民从周围水域获取牡蛎、蛤蜊及其他食物。

1585年，沃尔特·罗利资助在岛上建立英国定居点；1587年，约翰·怀特率另一批男女和儿童抵达。怀特返回英格兰寻找补给，却因英西战争耽搁。1590年他再次回到岛上时，聚落已被遗弃，一根柱子上刻着“克罗阿托安”。殖民者此后的命运成为英国早期美洲史上长久流传的谜团。

english: The Robins Lake uplands lie east of Black Lake in the lake-strewn country of the northern Shield. The Porcupine River flows from Grove Lake nearby, while the Chipman River enters Black Lake to the west. Open stands of black spruce and lichen cover parts of the Selwyn Lake uplands, where barren-ground caribou move south into the forest in winter.
simp_chinese: 罗宾斯湖高地位于黑湖以东，属于北方地盾上一片湖泊星罗棋布的地区。波丘派恩河从附近的格罗夫湖流出，奇普曼河则在西面注入黑湖。塞尔温湖高地部分地区覆盖着稀疏的黑云杉和地衣，荒原驯鹿冬季向南进入这片林地。

english: Rochechouart lies near the western edge of Limousin, below the castle of its long-established viscounts. Until the French Revolution it belonged administratively to Poitou, while its church came under the diocese of Limoges. The castle was a centre of resistance to English forces during the Hundred Years' War. Its lords served the French crown: Viscount Jean fought at Crécy in 1346 and died at Poitiers ten years later. The castle was later restored in Renaissance style under Jean de Rochechouart-Ponville, and its decorated rooms reflected the family's status. A Protestant community also existed in the district; its numbers dwindled after the revocation of the Edict of Nantes, though a clandestine synod still recorded adherents at Rochechouart in 1744.
simp_chinese: 罗什舒阿尔位于利穆赞西缘，其历史悠久的子爵家族城堡俯瞰城镇。法国大革命以前，当地在行政上属于普瓦图，教会则隶属利摩日教区。英法百年战争期间，城堡是抵抗英军的一处据点。子爵家族为法国王室效力：让子爵参加了1346年的克雷西战役，十年后在普瓦捷战役中阵亡。让·德·罗什舒阿尔－蓬维尔后来以文艺复兴风格修复城堡，内部装饰体现了家族地位。当地也曾有新教社群；《南特敕令》被撤销后信众渐少，但1744年的秘密宗教会议仍记录了罗什舒阿尔的信徒。

english:
Rochefort lies beside the Charente in western France, where river access links inland resources with the Atlantic coast. Agriculture and nearby settlements supply food and labor, while waterways provide routes for heavy goods. The estuarine environment can offer protection from the open sea, though tides, channels, and distance from the river mouth complicate navigation. Practical knowledge and maintained infrastructure are essential to making a river town useful for maritime activity.

In 1666 Louis XIV ordered a naval arsenal established here for the Atlantic fleet. A planned town grew beside the shipyards, workshops and rope-making facilities, drawing skilled workers and supplies from a wider hinterland. The site offered shelter inland on the Charente, although the long, tidal passage to the sea remained a practical constraint on the movement of warships.
simp_chinese:
罗什福尔位于法国西部夏朗德河旁，河运把内陆资源连接到大西洋海岸。农业邻近聚落供应食物劳力，水路提供重货运输。河口环境能够庇护船只免受外海直接影响，潮汐、航道及距河口的路程却增加导航困难。实际知识和持续维护的设施，是河畔城镇服务海上活动的基本条件。

1666年，路易十四下令在此建立供大西洋舰队使用的海军兵工厂。规划新城随船坞、作坊和制绳设施兴起，吸引技术工人和腹地物资。夏朗德河内陆位置为舰船提供庇护，但通海航道漫长且受潮汐影响，仍限制军舰通行。

english: Rochester stands at the lowest crossing of the River Medway in Kent, on the road from London toward Canterbury. Its cathedral and Norman castle grew beside the bridge; the castle guarded the crossing and was besieged in 1215 and 1264. During the Reformation, Bishop John Fisher was executed under Henry VIII, and Bishop Nicholas Ridley was later executed under Mary I. Rochester's position near the Thames and the developing naval dockyard at Chatham gave the river strategic importance. In 1667, during the Second Anglo-Dutch War, a Dutch fleet broke through the defences at Upnor and reached Rochester Bridge, capturing or burning English ships. The town's older cathedral and bridge thus stood beside a maritime landscape increasingly shaped by naval power.
simp_chinese: 罗切斯特位于肯特郡梅德韦河最下游的桥渡处，伦敦通往坎特伯雷的道路经过这里。主教座堂与诺曼城堡坐落在桥旁；城堡守卫渡口，曾于1215年和1264年遭围攻。宗教改革时期，主教约翰·费舍尔在亨利八世统治下被处决，主教尼古拉斯·里德利后来又在玛丽一世统治下被处决。罗切斯特靠近泰晤士河及逐渐发展的查塔姆海军船厂，梅德韦河因而具有战略意义。1667年第二次英荷战争期间，荷兰舰队突破厄普诺的防线，抵达罗切斯特桥，掳获或焚毁英国舰船。古老的教堂和桥梁由此与日益受到海军力量影响的河岸相邻。

english:
Rochlitz grew beside the Zwickauer Mulde beneath its castle. Slavic villages existed in the area by the tenth century, and a market settlement developed near a river ford. The medieval town itself was founded around 1200, with an elongated market street and the church of Saint Cunigunde. Its walls were strengthened in the fourteenth century, and in 1380 the town acquired a regional monopoly on bleaching cloth.

Hussite troops attacked Rochlitz in 1430. The town recovered, and Saint Cunigunde's was rebuilt in late Gothic style. Elisabeth of Rochlitz introduced the Reformation in 1537; ten years later Protestant troops won a battle here during the Schmalkaldic War. Town and castle were taken repeatedly in the Thirty Years' War, and fires in 1632 and 1682 caused further damage.
simp_chinese:
罗赫利茨兴起于茨维考穆尔德河畔的城堡下。十世纪前后，当地已有斯拉夫村庄，河流渡口附近发展出集市聚落。中世纪城镇约于1200年建立，拥有狭长的市场街和圣库尼贡德教堂。十四世纪城墙得到加固，1380年城市取得当地布匹漂白的垄断权。

1430年，胡斯派军队袭击罗赫利茨。城镇后来恢复，圣库尼贡德教堂也改建为晚期哥特式。1537年，罗赫利茨的伊丽莎白在此推行宗教改革；十年后，新教军队在施马尔卡尔登战争中于此获胜。三十年战争期间，城镇和城堡多次被攻占，1632年与1682年的火灾又造成损害。

english: Bitter Creek crosses the dry uplands of southwestern Wyoming on its way to the Green River. Its valley lies amid the broad basins and sagebrush country east of the river, where water and seasonal resources were scattered across considerable distances. Shoshone people travelled through the wider Green River country and met other communities to exchange goods. In the 1820s, fur traders began holding mountain rendezvous on the Green and its tributaries, joining older networks of travel and trade.
simp_chinese: 比特溪穿过怀俄明西南部的干燥高地，流向绿河。溪谷坐落在河东宽阔盆地与蒿草地之间，水源和季节物产散布于相当广大的地域。肖肖尼人往来于更广阔的绿河地区，与其他社群会面交换物品。十九世纪二十年代，毛皮商人开始在绿河及其支流举行山地集会，加入更早形成的旅行与贸易网络。

english: The eastern front of the Rocky Mountains rises sharply above the plains of the upper Missouri. High ridges and deep valleys mark the boundary between mountain and prairie, while rivers descend from the range toward the Missouri and Saskatchewan watersheds. To the Blackfoot peoples the mountains are Miistakis, the backbone, a distinctive landmark at the western edge of their extensive homeland on the northern plains.
simp_chinese: 落基山脉东麓陡然耸立于上密苏里平原之上。高耸的山脊和深谷构成山地与草原的分界，河流从山中流向密苏里河及萨斯喀彻温河流域。黑脚诸族称这些山为米斯塔基斯，即“脊梁”；它们是北部平原广阔故土西缘的一道醒目标志。

english:
Rodez stands on a hill above the Aveyron, in the Rouergue. For centuries it was two towns, the Cité of the bishops and the Bourg of the counts of Rodez, separated by a wall and each with its own consuls and town hall. The counts, of the house of Armagnac, won the right to mint their own coin, and the rivalry between bishop and count shaped the city's growth.

After the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 the Rouergue was ceded to England, and the French crown only regained it by 1370. In 1443 the dauphin, later Louis XI, took Rodez and forced Count Jean IV of Armagnac to submit. Bishop François d'Estaing finished the cathedral of Notre-Dame between 1510 and 1526 by adding its 87-metre bell tower, topped by a statue of the Virgin. The last count, Henry of Navarre, brought the county to the crown when he became Henry IV in 1589. Bishop Paul-Louis de Lezay de Lusignan built the episcopal palace between 1684 and 1694. In 1792 Rodez was chosen as the meeting point for the surveyors Delambre, measuring south from Dunkirk, and Méchain, measuring north from Barcelona, as they determined the length of the metre. In 1790 it became the capital of the new department of Aveyron.
simp_chinese:
罗德兹坐落在鲁埃格的阿韦龙河上方的山丘上。数百年间，它是两座城镇：主教管辖的城区和罗德兹伯爵管辖的市镇，中间隔着一道城墙，各有执政官和市政厅。属于阿马尼亚克家族的伯爵们获得了自行铸币的权利，主教与伯爵之间的竞争左右着城市的发展。

1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》将鲁埃格割给英格兰，法国王室直到1370年前后才收回。1443年，王太子、后来的路易十一攻占罗德兹，迫使阿马尼亚克伯爵让四世屈服。主教弗朗索瓦·德斯坦于1510至1526年间完成圣母主教座堂，加建了高87米、顶上立着圣母像的钟楼。末代伯爵纳瓦拉的亨利于1589年即位为亨利四世，伯爵领随之并入王室。主教保罗-路易·德·勒泽·德·吕济尼昂于1684至1694年建造了主教宫。1792年，罗德兹被选为测量员德朗布尔与梅尚汇合的地点，两人分别从敦刻尔克向南、从巴塞罗那向北测量，以确定米的长度。1790年，它成为新设阿韦龙省的首府。

english:
Roding lies beside the Regen River in the Upper Palatinate of eastern Bavaria. The settlement was recorded in the ninth century and developed as a market place in the Middle Ages. Around 1364 Count Palatine Rupert I granted it market rights, and a further charter in 1432 confirmed privileges including an annual fair.

Roding returned to Bavarian rule with the Upper Palatinate in 1628 during the Thirty Years' War. Floods and fires damaged the settlement, including two major fires in 1745 and 1755. In 1815 the regional court was moved from Wetterfeld to Roding, strengthening its administrative role in the surrounding district.
simp_chinese:
罗丁位于巴伐利亚东部上普法尔茨的雷根河畔。聚落在9世纪已有记载，中世纪发展为集镇。约1364年，普法尔茨伯爵鲁普雷希特一世授予集市权；1432年的进一步特许确认了包括年市在内的权利。

三十年战争期间，罗丁于1628年随上普法尔茨重归巴伐利亚统治。洪水和火灾损害了聚落，其中1745年和1755年发生两场大火。1815年，地区法院从韦特费尔德迁至罗丁，加强了它在周边地区的行政地位。

english:
For much of antiquity Rhodes was the wealthiest and most cosmopolitan port in the eastern Mediterranean, its legendary Colossus, one of the Seven Wonders of the ancient world, once standing at the harbor entrance, and its maritime law, the #italic Lex Rhodia#!, governing commerce across the known sea. After centuries of Roman, Byzantine, and Arab influence the island passed to the Knights Hospitaller in 1309, who fortified it into one of the most powerful Christian strongholds in the eastern Mediterranean. Behind its massive walls the Knights transformed Rhodes into a center of crusading power, its galley fleets patrolling the sea lanes between Christendom and the Islamic east.

Those walls were put to the test twice in the 15th century. A Mamluk fleet besieged Rhodes in 1444 and was beaten off, and in 1480, with the Ottomans now masters of Constantinople, Mehmed II sent an army said to number 70,000 men, which was repulsed in its turn. The Grand Masters spent the next forty years rebuilding the defences against cannon, until Rhodes was among the strongest fortresses in Christendom.

In 1522 Suleiman the Magnificent came with, by one count, 100,000 men on 400 ships against some 7,000 defenders under Grand Master Philippe Villiers de L'Isle-Adam. Six months of bombardment and mining brought down the walls, and in December the Knights accepted terms that let them leave with their goods and promised the townspeople freedom of worship. They sailed away on 1 January 1523, later to find a new home on Malta, and under Ottoman rule the Greeks had to move out of the walled town while many of its churches became mosques.
simp_chinese:
在古代大部分时间里，罗得岛一直是东地中海最富有、最国际化的港口。古代世界七大奇迹之一的传奇巨像曾矗立于港口入口处；其海事法#italic 罗得岛法》#!曾管辖着已知海洋上的商业活动。经过罗马、拜占庭和阿拉伯数个世纪的影响之后，该岛于1309年落入医院骑士团手中，骑士团将其加固为东地中海最强大的基督教堡垒之一。在宏伟的城墙背后，骑士们将罗得岛转变为十字军权力的中心，他们的桨帆舰队巡弋于基督教世界与伊斯兰东方之间的海路上。

这些城墙在15世纪经受了两次考验。1444年，一支马穆鲁克舰队围攻罗得岛，被击退；1480年，已经据有君士坦丁堡的穆罕默德二世派来一支据说有7万人的大军，同样铩羽而归。此后四十年，历任大团长按抵御火炮的要求重修城防，罗得岛成了基督教世界最坚固的要塞之一。

1522年，苏莱曼大帝率军来攻，一说有10万人、400艘战船，守军只有约7000人，由大团长菲利普·维利耶·德·利勒-亚当指挥。六个月的炮击和坑道爆破摧毁了城墙，12月，骑士团接受条件：他们可以带着财物离开，居民可以继续信奉基督教。1523年1月1日，骑士们扬帆离去，后来在马耳他重新落脚；奥斯曼统治下，希腊人被迫迁出城墙内的旧城，许多教堂改成了清真寺。

english:
Rodosçuk lies on the northern shore of the Sea of Marmara, where the fertile plains of Thrace meet the water. Earlier known as Rhaidestos and Rodosto, the town became a port for grain shipped towards Constantinople. Its markets and religious buildings grew with the prosperity of a coastal town connected to the capital and the surrounding countryside.

In the sixteenth century Grand Vizier Rüstem Pasha endowed a complex here, including a mosque, school, baths, market and caravanserai. The mosque, dated 1553 by its inscription, was designed by the imperial architect Sinan. In the eighteenth century Rodosçuk sheltered the exiled Hungarian prince Ferenc Rákóczi and his companions. His secretary Kelemen Mikes described a town inhabited by Turks, Greeks, Armenians and Jews, recording the daily life of the exile community on the Marmara shore.
simp_chinese:
罗多斯楚克位于马尔马拉海北岸，色雷斯肥沃的平原在此与海水相接。这座城镇早先称为莱德斯托斯和罗多斯托，后来成为向君士坦丁堡运送粮食的港口。随着海滨城镇的繁荣，市场与宗教建筑逐渐发展，当地与都城及周围乡村保持密切联系。

十六世纪，大维齐尔鲁斯泰姆帕夏在此捐建建筑群，包括清真寺、学校、浴场、市场和商队旅舍。清真寺由帝国建筑师锡南设计，铭文上的日期为1553年。十八世纪，罗多斯楚克收留了流亡的匈牙利亲王费伦茨·拉科齐及其随从。他的秘书凯莱曼·米凯什描述了这个由土耳其人、希腊人、亚美尼亚人和犹太人共同居住的城镇，记录了流亡群体在马尔马拉海岸的日常生活。

english:
Rodrigues is a small volcanic island far east of Mauritius, surrounded by a broad lagoon and coral reef. Its isolation allowed unusual animals to flourish, including giant tortoises and the flightless Rodrigues solitaire. The island's hills and streams offered fresh water and shelter in a vast stretch of the Indian Ocean. It is the easternmost of the principal islands that make up the Mascarene group.

In 1691 the Huguenot François Leguat and seven companions landed, hoping to establish a refuge for Protestant settlers. They left in 1693, and Leguat later published an account of the island and its wildlife. France established a lasting settlement in 1735; tortoises were taken in great numbers to supply ships and neighbouring islands. British forces occupied Rodrigues in 1809.
simp_chinese:
罗德里格斯是毛里求斯远东面的一座小火山岛，周围环绕宽阔潟湖和珊瑚礁。孤立环境使独特动物繁盛，包括巨型陆龟和不会飞的罗德里格斯渡渡鸟。岛上丘陵与溪流在广阔印度洋中提供淡水和庇护。它是马斯克林群岛主要岛屿中最东的一座。

1691年，胡格诺派教徒弗朗索瓦·勒加与七名同伴登陆，希望为新教移民建立避难地。他们于1693年离开，勒加后来出版了关于岛屿和当地野生动物的记述。法国于1735年建立持久聚落；大量陆龟被捕捉，用于供应船只和邻近岛屿。英国军队于1809年占领罗德里格斯。

english: Rodrigues is a small volcanic island in the western Indian Ocean, far east of Mauritius. A broad lagoon and coral reef surround its shores, while its hills rise above the sea. In 1691 the French Huguenot François Leguat and seven companions landed here, hoping to establish a refuge for Protestants. They departed two years later. A permanent French settlement was established in 1735, and the island later passed into British hands in 1809.
simp_chinese: 罗德里格斯是印度洋西部的一座小型火山岛，远在毛里求斯以东。宽阔的潟湖与珊瑚礁环绕海岸，丘陵从海中升起。1691年，法国胡格诺派教徒弗朗索瓦·勒加和七名同伴在此登陆，希望建立新教徒的避难地，两年后他们离开了岛屿。1735年法国人在此建立永久聚落，1809年该岛又落入英国人之手。

english:
Roermond stands where the Roer approaches the Meuse, a commercial town of Guelders with rights recorded in the thirteenth century. Around 1350 it became the principal town of Upper Guelders, and in 1441 it joined the Hanseatic League. Monastic foundations included the Charterhouse, founded in 1376, while the Minster and Saint Christopher's Church marked its religious life. In 1559 Roermond became the seat of a bishopric.

The revolt against Spain brought fighting and religious violence. William of Orange occupied Roermond in 1572, when thirteen Catholic clerics were killed; Spanish forces subsequently retook it. In 1613 a witch trial ended with the burning of sixty-four people. Frederick Henry's campaign along the Meuse brought the town under Dutch rule in 1632, but Spain recovered it in 1637. Roermond again passed to the Dutch in 1702 and to the Austrian Netherlands in 1716, remaining under Austrian rule until the French conquest in 1794.
simp_chinese:
鲁尔蒙德位于鲁尔河接近默兹河之处，是海尔德兰的商业城镇，十三世纪已有城市权利。约1350年，它成为上海尔德兰的主要城镇，1441年加入汉萨同盟。1376年建立的加尔都西会修道院是当地宗教机构之一，明斯特教堂和圣克里斯托弗教堂也塑造了城市的宗教生活。1559年，鲁尔蒙德成为主教座堂所在地。

反西班牙起义带来战斗和宗教暴力。奥兰治的威廉于1572年占领鲁尔蒙德，十三名天主教神职人员在此被杀；西班牙军队随后夺回此城。1613年的巫术审判以六十四人被处火刑告终。1632年，腓特烈·亨德里克沿默兹河进军，将城镇纳入荷兰统治，但西班牙于1637年收复。1702年鲁尔蒙德再次归荷兰，1716年转属奥属尼德兰，直到1794年法国征服。

english:
Rogachyovo lies on the Yakhroma near its meeting with the Sestra, downstream from Dmitrov. In 1428 Prince Pyotr of Dmitrov gave the village to the St Nicholas-Peshnosha monastery, which held it until the secularisation of church lands in 1764. Roads from Klin to Dmitrov and from Moscow toward the Volga crossed here.

The village was also a transshipment point on the river route. Large cargo boats could ascend from the Volga as far as Rogachyovo, where their goods were transferred to smaller vessels for the journey upstream to Dmitrov. Markets brought together peasants from monastic, royal and private estates. As direct overland trade through Yaroslavl and Vologda grew, the village’s former importance on the water route diminished in the following centuries of Russian history.
simp_chinese:
罗加乔沃位于德米特罗夫下游的亚赫罗马河畔，靠近它与谢斯特拉河的汇合处。1428年，德米特罗夫的彼得亲王将村庄赠给圣尼古拉—佩什诺沙修道院；它一直归修道院所有，直到1764年教会土地世俗化。克林通往德米特罗夫的道路和莫斯科通往伏尔加河的道路在此交会。

村庄也是河路上的转运点。大型货船从伏尔加河上溯至罗加乔沃，货物在此转装小船，再运往上游的德米特罗夫。集市吸引了修道院、皇家及私人领地的农民。随着经雅罗斯拉夫尔和沃洛格达的直接陆路贸易增长，村庄在水路上的旧日地位在随后的几个世纪逐渐下降。

english:
The Roggeveld mountains form part of the high, dry interior associated with the Karoo. Cold seasons, variable rainfall, open grazing country, and limited water created conditions very different from the wetter coast. Indigenous communities maintained knowledge of plants, animals, water sources, and routes, supporting hunting, gathering, and pastoral livelihoods across the wider landscape. Movement between productive places was an organized adaptation to environmental variation rather than aimless wandering through empty country.

From around 1740, colonial pastoralists pushed into the Hantam and Roggeveld uplands. Competition for water and grazing brought dispossession and conflict with Khoe and San communities. In the early 1770s, Indigenous attacks on farms formed part of a wider resistance to colonial encroachment; armed commandos were organized in response. The frontier was contested, and the advance of settlers did not proceed without resistance.
simp_chinese:
罗格费尔德山脉属于与卡鲁相联系的干燥高地内陆。寒冷季节、变化降雨、开阔牧地和有限水源，形成与湿润海岸不同的条件。原住民社区熟悉植物、动物、水源和道路，在广大景观中维持狩猎、采集及牧业生活。人们按照资源变化在丰富地点之间移动，拥有细致而持续的环境利用安排。

约1740年起，殖民牧民向汉塔姆和罗格费尔德高地推进。水源与草场竞争带来了对科伊人和桑人土地的侵占与冲突。1770年代初，原住民袭击农场是抵抗殖民侵入的一部分；殖民者则组织武装队伍应对。这片边疆长期处于争夺之中，殖民扩张并非没有遭到抵抗。

english: Rognedino lies in the forest country between Roslavl and the Desna. Its early history is associated with a princely estate known as Zarub and with Princess Rogneda Mstislavna, sister of the Smolensk ruler Rostislav. A chronicle records Rostislav's death here in 1167 on his journey from Smolensk toward Kyiv. Later documents describe settlements of the same name in the district, reflecting the long survival of the old estate's name among the villages.
simp_chinese: 罗格涅季诺位于罗斯拉夫尔与杰斯纳河之间的林区。它的早期历史与名为扎鲁布的王公庄园及罗格涅达·姆斯季斯拉夫娜公主有关；公主是斯摩棱斯克统治者罗斯季斯拉夫的姐妹。编年史记载，罗斯季斯拉夫于1167年从斯摩棱斯克前往基辅途中在此去世。后来的文书记载当地有数个同名聚落，显示古老庄园的名称长期保存在村庄中。

english: Rogozh was a village of coachmen on the road east from Moscow. Its inhabitants served the postal route, providing horses and transport for travellers and official correspondence. In 1781 Catherine II raised Rogozh to the status of a district town and gave it the name Bogorodsk. A description of 1788 recorded a wooden church, government offices, a school, merchants’ and coachmen’s houses, a brewery and a smithy. The modest town grew from the needs of the road it had long served.
simp_chinese: 罗戈日是莫斯科向东道路上的驿夫村。居民为驿路提供马匹和运输，服务旅人及公文传递。1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世将罗戈日升为县城，赐名博戈罗茨克。1788年的记载列出了木造教堂、官署、学校、商人与驿夫的住宅、啤酒作坊和铁匠铺。这个规模不大的城镇，正是因长期服务道路的需要而成长起来。

english: Roh stands in the southern Bihar plain, in the country once ruled from the cities of Magadha. In the eighteenth century it formed part of the landed interests of the Mayi family. Iqbal Ali Khan, a son of Kamgar Khan, inherited holdings at both Roh and Narhat, linking the fortunes of these neighbouring places to the family’s position among the landholders of Bihar.
simp_chinese: 罗赫位于比哈尔南部平原，地处古代摩揭陀诸城统治过的地区。十八世纪，这里属于迈伊家族的地产范围。卡姆加尔汗之子伊克巴尔·阿里汗继承了罗赫和纳尔哈特两处地产，使这两个邻近地方的命运与家族在比哈尔地主中的地位联系在一起。

sources.title: 16680617124963--1662355246711Account of the Districts of Bihar and Patna in 1811-1812 (5).pdf

english:
Rohan grew beside a castle and priory established by Alain de Rohan in the twelfth century, becoming the seat of a Breton viscounty. During the Breton War of Succession, English forces took and burned the town in 1342. It was rebuilt, though the viscounty's seat moved to Pontivy in 1418.

The castle suffered further attacks in the late fifteenth century amid conflict between Brittany and France. Repaired in the early sixteenth century, it was gradually abandoned as the Rohan family preferred other residences. A market and fairs served the small town and its surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese:
罗昂围绕阿兰·德·罗昂在十二世纪建立的城堡和修道院发展，成为布列塔尼子爵领的中心。布列塔尼继承战争期间，英军于1342年攻陷并焚毁城镇。罗昂随后得到重建，但子爵领治所于1418年迁往蓬蒂维。

十五世纪末，布列塔尼与法国的冲突使城堡再次遭到攻击。城堡在十六世纪初修复，但罗昂家族后来更常居住在其他宅邸，此处逐渐荒废。市场和集市则服务小城及周围乡村。

english: Rohat Kermen is a historical name placed in the lower Dnipro country near the later Hornostaivka. The river here crossed the steppe north of Crimea, a region in which the Crimean khans' power and the movements of pastoral communities shaped the frontier. Farther downstream, forts at the Tavan crossing gave the khanate and its Ottoman allies a means of controlling passage across the river.
simp_chinese: 罗哈特堡是第聂伯河下游地区的一个历史名称，位置在后来的霍尔诺斯泰夫卡附近。河流在此穿过克里米亚以北的草原；克里米亚诸汗的权力与牧民社群的迁徙共同塑造了这片边疆。更下游的塔万渡口设有堡垒，使汗国及其奥斯曼盟友得以控制过河的通道。

english:
Rohatyn stands on the Hnyla Lypa River in Galicia. Under Polish rule it received Magdeburg rights in 1415 and developed as a trading and manufacturing town. A school of icon painting emerged in the sixteenth century, and an Orthodox brotherhood was founded in the 1580s.

The Jewish community received a charter of privileges from King Władysław IV in 1633. Local tradition associates Rohatyn with Roxelana, later Hürrem Sultan at the Ottoman court, though her precise origins are uncertain. After the first partition of Poland in 1772 the town passed to Austria.
simp_chinese:
罗哈京位于加利西亚的赫尼拉利帕河畔。波兰统治下，它于1415年获得马格德堡法，并发展为贸易和手工业城镇。16世纪当地出现圣像画派，1580年代建立东正教兄弟会。

犹太社群于1633年获得国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世颁发的特许状。当地传统将罗哈京与后来成为奥斯曼宫廷许蕾姆苏丹的罗克塞拉娜联系起来，但她的确切出生地并不确定。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，城镇转归奥地利。

english:
Rohrbach grew at a meeting of roads carrying salt from the Danube towards Bohemia. Laid out as a market in the early thirteenth century, it offered rest and provisions to packhorse drivers before they crossed the Bohemian Forest. Its parish was attached to Schlägl Abbey in 1319, and the settlement was recorded as a market in 1320. Hussite forces destroyed the town and church in 1427; Duke Albert renewed its market rights in 1459.

Salt and cattle brought trade through Rohrbach, but restrictions imposed in favour of Freistadt ended the local salt trade around 1570. During the Upper Austrian Peasants' War, insurgents occupied Rohrbach and nearby Berg Castle in 1626. Linen trading later replaced the declining cattle trade as an important source of income, reaching its height around 1700. From 1749 Rohrbach also served as the seat of a district administration.
simp_chinese:
罗尔巴赫兴起于道路交会处，运盐者从多瑙河沿这些道路前往波希米亚。十三世纪初，这里被规划为集镇，为越过波希米亚森林的驮运者提供食宿和补给。1319年，当地堂区归施莱格尔修道院管理；1320年的文献已称其为集镇。1427年，胡斯派军队摧毁城镇和教堂，1459年阿尔布雷希特公爵重新确认集市权。

盐和牲畜贸易曾经过罗尔巴赫，但为保护弗赖施塔特利益而实施的限制，使当地盐贸在1570年前后终止。上奥地利农民战争期间，起义者于1626年占领罗尔巴赫和附近的贝格城堡。此后，亚麻布贸易接替衰落的牲畜贸易成为重要收入来源，约在1700年前后达到鼎盛。1749年起，罗尔巴赫也成为地区行政机构驻地。

english:
Rohri stands on the eastern bank of the Indus opposite Sukkur. Between the two towns the river divides around the rocky island of Bukkur, whose fort commanded an important crossing. Upstream and downstream, boats carried goods along the Indus, while the limestone hills around Rohri supplied stone used by people in the region since prehistoric times.

The river changed its course through the hills, and Rohri grew beside the passage facing the island fortress. Under successive rulers of Sindh, Bukkur and the towns on either bank formed a strategic and commercial centre. Shrines along the river also attracted worshippers; an island sanctuary associated with Khwaja Khizr was revered by Muslims and Hindus alike. The fort’s position gave whoever held it a strong influence over movement through this narrow stretch of the Indus.
simp_chinese:
罗赫里位于印度河东岸，与苏库尔隔河相望。两城之间，河水绕过岩石岛屿布库尔分流，岛上堡垒控制重要渡口。船只沿印度河上下运送货物；罗赫里周围石灰岩丘陵则自史前时代起为当地人提供石料。

河流改道穿过丘陵后，罗赫里在面向岛上堡垒的通道旁发展。信德历代统治者时期，布库尔和两岸城镇共同形成战略与商业中心。沿河圣所也吸引信众；与赫瓦贾·希兹尔有关的岛上圣地受到穆斯林和印度教徒共同尊敬。堡垒的位置使掌控它的人能够强烈影响通过这段狭窄印度河道的往来。

english:
Rohtak lies on the plains northwest of Delhi, near the ancient site of Khokhrakot. Clay coin moulds found there reveal the work of minting under the Yaudheyas, while later finds include Gupta terracottas and Jain images. The town's older name, Rauhitaka, appears in medieval sources, and the Chahamanas held the region in the twelfth century.

The Ain-i Akbari records Rohtak as a Mughal pargana under Delhi, with a brick fort and obligations to supply infantry and cavalry to the imperial army. Jats were prominent in the surrounding country. In 1762 Suraj Mal of Bharatpur sent his sons Jawahar Singh and Nahar Singh into the region, where they captured the Rohtak pargana amid the struggle for power that followed the great battle of Panipat.
simp_chinese:
罗塔克位于德里西北的平原，靠近古代霍克拉科特遗址。那里发现的陶制钱模揭示了腰提耶统治时期的铸币工艺，较晚的发现还有笈多陶塑和耆那教造像。城镇的旧名罗希塔迦见于中世纪文献，十二世纪乔汉人曾统治这一地区。

《阿克巴制度》记载罗塔克是德里下属的莫卧儿帕尔加纳，有砖堡，并须提供步兵和骑兵。贾特人在周边地区颇具势力。1762年，婆罗多补罗的苏拉杰·马尔派遣儿子贾瓦哈尔·辛格和纳哈尔·辛格进军，在伯尼巴德大战后的权力争夺中夺取了罗塔克帕尔加纳。

english:
High above the valley of the Son stands Rohtasgarh, a hill fort whose formidable position made it a place of refuge as well as a seat of power. Inscriptions attest to its medieval past, while its palaces, mosques and reservoirs bear witness to the rulers who later occupied it. Sher Shah Suri took the fort in 1539, and his general Haibat Khan built the Jami Masjid there in 1543.

Under the Mughals, Raja Man Singh, governor of Bihar and Bengal, made Rohtasgarh a residence and added a palace, gardens and water tanks. The fort also sheltered Prince Khurram during his rebellion against his father Jahangir in 1621, before Aurangzeb used it as a prison. After his defeat in 1763, Mir Qasim sought refuge here; the fort was subsequently handed to Captain Goddard, whose men destroyed its stores and defences.
simp_chinese:
罗赫达斯堡高踞宋河谷之上，险峻的地势使它既是避难之所，也是统治者的据点。铭文见证了堡垒的中世纪历史，而宫殿、清真寺和蓄水池则留下了后来诸位主人的印记。1539年舍尔沙·苏里夺取此堡，其将领海巴特汗于1543年在此修建聚礼清真寺。

莫卧儿统治时期，比哈尔和孟加拉总督曼·辛格王公将罗赫达斯堡辟为居所，增建宫殿、花园与水池。1621年，胡拉姆王子反抗其父贾汉吉尔时，也曾到此避难；奥朗则布后来则把堡垒用作监狱。1763年米尔·卡西姆战败后逃至这里，堡垒随后被交给戈达德上尉，其部下摧毁了仓库和防御工事。

english:
Roi Et lies on the Khorat Plateau in the basin of the Chi River. Its history is closely bound to the Lao town of Suwannaphum, founded earlier in the eighteenth century by people from the Champasak kingdom. A dispute among Suwannaphum's leaders led one group under Katiyawongsa to leave and establish Roi Et in 1775. The new town became another centre of Lao settlement and Siamese authority in the plateau's interior.

The later city of Maha Sarakham also lies here.
simp_chinese:
黎逸位于呵叻高原的奇河流域，其历史与老挝人城镇素万那普密切相关。素万那普由占巴塞来的居民于十八世纪前期建立。1775年，城中领袖发生争执，卡提亚旺萨率领一部分人离去，建立黎逸。新城成为高原腹地老挝人聚居及暹罗权力的另一个中心。

后来的马哈沙拉堪也位于此地。

english: The Rokan River flows east across Sumatra from its upland branches to the Malacca Strait. In its upper basin a number of small kingdoms developed along the waterways, including Rokan, whose seat was at Rokan IV Koto. Their courts and communities were separated by forest and tributaries but linked by the river, which continued through the broad lowlands to its estuary on the strait.
simp_chinese: 罗干河从高地支流向东横穿苏门答腊，注入马六甲海峡。上游流域沿水道发展出多个小王国，其中罗干王国的驻地位于罗干四城。这些宫廷与社群之间隔有森林和支流，却通过河流相连；河水继续穿过广阔低地，在海峡沿岸形成河口。

english:
Rokia Point projects from the northern coast of Misima Island into the Solomon Sea, at the western end of the Louisiade Archipelago. No broad reef lagoon shelters this shore: limestone cliffs rise above exposed water, while reefs, beaches and mangroves appear farther southeast. The point forms a conspicuous turn for canoes and sailing vessels following the coast.

Before European ships entered the region, Misima islanders were experienced mariners. Large canoes crossed to Panaeati and the Calvados Chain, travelled northwest to Woodlark and west toward Wari, carrying people, food, materials and obligations between communities. The sea extended social and political life, and knowledge of reefs, currents, winds and landing places made these voyages possible.

The Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres passed through the Louisiades in 1606. Louis Antoine de Bougainville named the archipelago in 1768, and Bruni d'Entrecasteaux visited it in 1793. These voyages entered the region into European charts, but did not immediately replace island routes or local authority. Rokia Point therefore belonged to a maritime world shaped by navigation and exchange long before sustained European rule.
simp_chinese:
罗基亚角从米西马岛北岸伸入所罗门海，位于路易西亚德群岛西段。这里没有宽阔礁湖遮挡海岸，石灰岩峭壁直立于外海水面，东南方向则分布着珊瑚礁、沙滩和红树林。对沿岸航行的独木舟和帆船而言，这个岬角构成显著转向点。

欧洲船只进入这一海域以前，米西马居民已是熟练航海者。大型独木舟前往帕纳埃蒂岛和卡尔瓦多斯群岛，向西北驶向伍德拉克岛，或向西前往瓦里，在社群之间运送人口、食物、材料和义务。海洋因此延伸了社会与政治生活，对礁石、洋流、风向和登陆点的知识维持着这些航程。

1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德托雷斯率领的西班牙船队经过路易西亚德群岛。1768年，路易·安托万·德布干维尔为群岛命名，布鲁尼·德昂特雷卡斯托又于1793年到访。这些航行把海岸收入欧洲海图，却没有立即取代岛屿航路或地方权威。罗基亚角属于一个在稳定欧洲统治以前很久便由航行和交换塑造的海洋世界。

english: Rokiškis grew around a manor in northeastern Lithuania, amid the lands of the Grand Duchy. The estate is first recorded in 1499, when it was held by the noble Grigalius Astikas. It later belonged to the Kroszyński and Tyzenhaus families. Under the latter, the town centre took shape in the late eighteenth century with a planned square and streets linking the manor to the settlement. Rokiškis passed to the Russian Empire when the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth was partitioned in 1795.
simp_chinese: 罗基什基斯围绕立陶宛东北部的一座庄园发展，曾属于立陶宛大公国。1499年的记载首次提到庄园，当时由贵族格里加柳斯·阿斯蒂卡斯持有。此后庄园先后属于克罗申斯基和蒂森豪斯家族。十八世纪末，在后者统治下，城镇中心逐渐形成，规划的广场和街道将庄园与聚落连接起来。1795年波兰立陶宛联邦被瓜分时，罗基什基斯归入俄罗斯帝国。

english: On the Adriatic coast of Romagna, Cervia's salt pans gave the town one of its most valuable products. Salt workers carried the harvest in flat-bottomed boats along the canal to the harbour. The Papal administration built the Torre warehouse beside the canal in 1691 and the Darsena warehouse opposite it in 1712. Between 1697 and 1714, the old town was moved from the salt marshes to a new site near the harbour.
simp_chinese: 在罗马涅的亚得里亚海岸，切尔维亚的盐田出产当地最珍贵的货物之一。盐工用平底船沿运河将收获的盐运往港口。教皇国当局于1691年在运河边建造托雷盐仓，1712年又在对岸建造达尔塞纳盐仓。1697至1714年间，旧城从盐沼地带迁往港口附近的新址。

english:
Roman stands near the confluence of the Moldova and Siret rivers. Named for the Moldavian voivode Roman I, it was a centre of the principality's Lower Country and an Orthodox episcopal see from 1408. A document issued by Roman I bears one of the earliest legible Moldavian seals, with the aurochs, star, moon and flower that became enduring emblems of the land.

Stephen the Great built a stone fortress near the Siret, replacing older earthen defences. It resisted King Matthias Corvinus in 1467 and was besieged again by Mehmed II's army in 1476. Prince Petru Rareș rebuilt the episcopal church in 1542. Orthodox, Armenian and Catholic communities shared the town; in 1641 a visiting cleric counted adherents of all three. In 1691 the chronicler Miron Costin was executed at Roman on the orders of Prince Constantin Cantemir. A hospital was established in 1798, followed in 1817 by a Jewish school.
simp_chinese:
罗曼位于摩尔多瓦河与锡雷特河交汇处附近，以摩尔达维亚大公罗曼一世命名。它是公国下地的中心，自1408年起也是东正教主教座所在地。罗曼一世签发的一份文书带有最早清晰可辨的摩尔达维亚印玺之一，上面的原牛、星、月和花成为这片土地长久使用的象征。

斯特凡大公在锡雷特河附近建造石堡，取代较早的土制防御工事。堡垒于1467年抵御匈牙利国王马加什·科尔维努斯，1476年又遭穆罕默德二世的军队围攻。彼得鲁·拉雷什公爵于1542年重建主教座堂。东正教、亚美尼亚教会和天主教社群共居城中；1641年一位途经的教士记录了三者的信徒。1691年，编年史家米龙·科斯廷奉康斯坦丁·坎特马尔公爵之命在罗曼被处决。1798年城中建立医院，1817年又开办一所犹太学校。

english:
Romang belongs to the eastern Chaco, where wooded plains approach the Paraná basin's river networks. In this wider region, Moqoit and other Indigenous communities used seasonal waters, forests and open ground for food and materials. They combined fishing, hunting and gathering according to local conditions, while exchange, kinship and political relationships connected communities across the landscape.

Colonial settlements along the larger rivers created new points of contact without immediately controlling the entire interior. Missions and military expeditions changed relations with Indigenous peoples, while trade brought new goods into local life. Horses transformed mobility for many Chaco groups, extending the reach of hunting, diplomacy and conflict. Local leaders negotiated with outsiders while maintaining relationships with neighbouring peoples.
simp_chinese:
罗芒所属的查科东部，林木覆盖的平原接近巴拉那河流域水网。在这一广大地区，莫科维和其他原住民社群利用季节性水域、森林及开阔地获取食物和材料。居民依照当地条件捕鱼、狩猎、采集，并通过交换、亲属关系与政治往来保持联系。

殖民聚落沿较大河流建立，带来新的接触，但并未立即控制整个内陆。传教站和军事远征改变了殖民者与原住民的关系，贸易也将新物品带入当地生活。马匹改变许多查科群体的移动方式，扩大狩猎、外交和冲突的范围。地方领袖与外来者协商，同时维护与邻近族群的关系。

english:
Romanov stood on the Volga opposite Borisoglebsk. Rebuilt by Prince Roman Vasilyevich in the mid-fourteenth century, it became the center of a small principality before passing into the orbit of Moscow. Grand Princess Maria Yaroslavna strengthened its defenses in 1468 with a new kremlin, ramparts, a ditch and towers. The wooden fortifications survived until a fire in 1622. In 1491, following the arrest of her son Andrei of Uglich, the town passed definitively to the Moscow prince.

In 1563 Ivan IV granted Romanov and nearby settlements to Nogai nobles for their service. A register of 1593–1594 records a Tatar sloboda with the households of the murzas and their service Tatars. During the Time of Troubles, forces loyal to the Tushino claimant occupied the town; Nikita Vysheslavtsev's militia took it in 1609. Romanov later became known for river vessels and trade. In 1822 it was united with Borisoglebsk across the Volga to form Romanov-Borisoglebsk.
simp_chinese:
罗曼诺夫位于伏尔加河畔，与鲍里索格列布斯克隔河相望。十四世纪中叶，罗曼·瓦西里耶维奇公爵重建城镇，使其成为小公国的中心，后来它进入莫斯科的势力范围。1468年，大公夫人玛丽娅·雅罗斯拉夫娜修筑新的克里姆林、土垒、壕沟和塔楼，加强防御。这些木制工事一直留存到1622年的火灾。1491年，她的儿子乌格利奇公爵安德烈被捕后，城镇最终归莫斯科公爵所有。

1563年，伊凡四世将罗曼诺夫及附近聚落赐给诺盖贵族，以酬谢他们的服役。1593至1594年的登记簿记载了一处鞑靼人聚落，其中有穆尔扎及其服役鞑靼人的家庭。混乱时期，效忠图希诺僭位者的军队占领城镇；1609年，尼基塔·维舍斯拉夫采夫的民兵夺回此地。罗曼诺夫后来以河船制造和贸易闻名。1822年，它与伏尔加河对岸的鲍里索格列布斯克合并为罗曼诺夫—鲍里索格列布斯克。

english: Romanovsky Khutor grew beside a fortified post on the Kuban, where the river marked part of Russia's Caucasian frontier. The post was established in the late eighteenth century, and a Cossack settlement developed in its neighbourhood. Its name recalled the Don stanitsa of Romanovskaya, from which Cossacks came to serve on the line. A road later linked the settlement with Yekaterinodar and Stavropol, crossing a landscape increasingly shaped by frontier forts and Cossack communities.
simp_chinese: 罗曼诺夫斯基农庄兴起于库班河畔的一处哨所旁，这条河曾是俄国高加索边疆的一段界线。哨所建立于十八世纪末，附近逐渐形成哥萨克聚落。其名称令人想起顿河畔的罗曼诺夫斯卡亚哥萨克村，曾有哥萨克从那里来到防线服役。后来一条道路将此地同叶卡捷琳诺达尔和斯塔夫罗波尔连接起来，沿途的景观日益受到边防堡垒与哥萨克社群的影响。

english: Romans grew on the Isère around the collegiate church of Saint Barnard. Its inhabitants received a charter of municipal liberties in 1160 from the archbishop of Vienne and the church's chapter. In 1580 tensions between artisans, the wealthy and the surrounding countryside erupted during carnival. Festivities became violent, and after the killings the authorities executed men identified as leaders of the artisans' party. The bloody carnival left a lasting mark on the town's history.
simp_chinese: 罗芒在伊泽尔河畔围绕圣巴纳尔协同教堂发展。1160年，维埃纳总主教与教士团向居民颁发城市自由特许状。1580年，工匠、富人和周围乡村之间的紧张关系在狂欢节期间爆发。庆祝演变为暴力，杀戮之后，当局处决了被视为工匠派领袖的人。这场血腥的狂欢节在城镇历史中留下持久印记。

english: Lake Rombebai lies in the lowlands near the northern coast of New Guinea, east of Cenderawasih Bay. The lake forms part of a broad wetland landscape associated with the Mamberamo River, where forest and swamps surround open water. Rivers and channels cross the plain between the interior mountains and the Pacific coast.
simp_chinese: 龙贝拜湖位于新几内亚北岸附近的低地，处在极乐鸟湾以东。湖泊是与曼贝拉莫河相连的广阔湿地景观的一部分，森林与沼泽环绕开阔水面。河流和水道穿过内陆山地与太平洋海岸之间的平原。

english:
The Eternal City on the Tiber ruled an empire that spanned continents. Even after the fall of its empire, Rome endured as a beacon of faith and authority, home to the Papacy.

In 1337 the popes were still at Avignon, and Rome went short of the pilgrims and papal revenue it lived on; its great churches began to fall into ruin while the Colonna, Orsini and other noble houses fought over its streets. In 1347 Cola di Rienzo, a commoner, seized the Capitoline at the head of a crowd and ruled as tribune for a few months; he was killed in a tumult in 1354. Gregory XI finally brought the Holy See back on 17 January 1377 and found a city in anarchy, and the Western Schism kept Rome unsettled for four more decades. Martin V settled there in 1420 and began restoring its streets, churches and palaces.

Under Nicholas V, pope from 1447, scholars and artists returned to the papal court and Leon Battista Alberti began remaking the city. Rome reached its height in the first decades of the 16th century, under Julius II and the two Medici popes who followed, when it became the greatest centre of art in the world and the old St Peter's was pulled down to make way for a new basilica. In 1527 the unruly troops of Emperor Charles V stormed the city, pillaged it for days and held Clement VII prisoner in Castel Sant'Angelo, bringing that golden age to an end.
simp_chinese:
这座台伯河畔的永恒之城曾统御着横跨三洲的庞大帝国。即便帝国已经陨落，罗马仍作为信仰与权威的灯塔延续其辉煌，并成为圣座治下的教廷中枢。

1337年，教宗仍驻在阿维尼翁，罗马赖以为生的朝圣者和教廷收入锐减，大教堂开始破败，科隆纳、奥尔西尼等贵族家族则在街巷间争斗不休。1347年，平民柯拉·迪·里恩佐率领人群占领卡比托利欧山，以保民官的身份执政数月，1354年死于一场骚乱。1377年1月17日，教宗格列高利十一世终于把圣座迁回罗马，却发现城中一片无政府状态；随之而来的西方教会大分裂又让罗马动荡了四十年。1420年，马丁五世在罗马定居，着手修复街道、教堂和宫殿。

1447年即位的尼古拉五世把学者和艺术家重新请回教廷，莱昂·巴蒂斯塔·阿尔贝蒂也开始改造城市。16世纪初，在儒略二世和其后两位美第奇教宗治下，罗马达到鼎盛，成为世界艺术中心，旧圣彼得大教堂被拆除，新的大教堂动工。1527年，查理五世麾下纪律涣散的帝国军队攻入罗马，劫掠数日，并把克雷芒七世囚禁在圣天使堡，这个黄金时代就此终结。

english: Romen stands beside the river from which it takes its name, in the Sula basin of left-bank Ukraine. It is recorded in 1096, when the fortified settlements of Kyivan Rus' faced the steppe to the south. Over the centuries the town passed through Mongol, Lithuanian, Polish and Russian spheres of rule. By 1638 it had about six thousand inhabitants, making it a major settlement of its region. Its position amid the river valleys helped sustain the market and the communities that grew around it. In 1781 Empress Catherine II granted the town a charter.
simp_chinese: 罗门坐落在同名河流旁，属于乌克兰左岸的苏拉河流域。1096年，文献已记载此地；当时基辅罗斯的设防聚落面向南方草原。数百年间，城镇先后处于蒙古、立陶宛、波兰和俄国的统治范围。到1638年，这里约有六千居民，是地区内的重要聚落。河谷间的位置有助于维持市场及其周围的社区。1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世女皇授予城镇特许状。

english:
Romorantin lies on the Sauldre in the Sologne of central France. Louise of Savoy, mother of King Francis I, had a residence here. Early in his reign Leonardo da Vinci worked on plans associated with Romorantin, including a royal palace and waterways. The ambitious designs were not completed, and the precise relationship between Leonardo's plans and the work undertaken at the existing château remains a subject of discussion.

In 1560 the Edict of Romorantin became associated with the town amid the religious tensions of the French kingdom. Its royal connections placed this Sologne settlement within the political and cultural life of Renaissance France.
simp_chinese:
罗莫朗坦位于法国中部索洛涅地区的索尔德河畔。国王弗朗索瓦一世的母亲萨伏依的路易丝在此拥有居所。国王统治初年，列奥纳多·达·芬奇参与了与罗莫朗坦有关的规划，包括王宫和水道设计。这些宏大方案未能完成；达芬奇的设计与旧城堡实际施工之间的具体关系仍有讨论。

1560年，在法国王国宗教局势紧张之际，《罗莫朗坦敕令》与这座城镇联系在一起。王室关系使这个索洛涅聚落参与到文艺复兴时期法国的政治与文化生活之中。

english: Roncesvalles, known in Basque as Orreaga, lies in the Pyrenees of Navarre near the route across the mountains from France. Its collegiate church of Santa María and former pilgrims' hospice, built around the end of the twelfth and beginning of the thirteenth centuries, became an important resting place on the French Way to Santiago de Compostela. In 1439 the prior of Roncesvalles led a Navarrese embassy negotiating a royal marriage in Burgundy. The pass is also associated with the defeat of Charlemagne's rearguard by Basque forces in 778, remembered in the story of Roland. Much later, fighting took place in the area during the Peninsular War in 1813. Pilgrimage and warfare alike made this mountain crossing important beyond its small settlement.
simp_chinese: 龙塞斯瓦列斯的巴斯克语名称为奥雷亚加，位于纳瓦拉比利牛斯山中，靠近从法国翻山而来的道路。圣玛丽亚协同教堂及其旧朝圣者收容所建于十二世纪末至十三世纪初，后来成为通往圣地亚哥的法国之路上的重要歇脚处。1439年，龙塞斯瓦列斯的院长率领纳瓦拉使团前往勃艮第，商议王室婚事。山口也与778年查理曼后卫部队遭巴斯克人击败的事件相联系，罗兰的故事使这场战斗流传后世。1813年半岛战争期间，这一带再次发生战斗。朝圣与战争都使这条山地通道的意义超越了小聚落本身。

english: Ronda crowns a rocky plateau cut by the deep gorge of the Guadalevín. Its walls and gates recall the town’s Muslim past and its place within the Nasrid kingdom until the Catholic Monarchs took it in 1485. Centuries later the growing town needed a new crossing over the gorge. The great Puente Nuevo was completed in 1793, joining the old city to the Mercadillo on the opposite side.
simp_chinese: 龙达高踞岩石台地，瓜达莱温河在此切出深邃峡谷。城墙与城门令人想起城镇的穆斯林历史，以及它在1485年被天主教双王夺取前属于纳斯里德王国的时代。数世纪后，扩展中的城镇需要一座新的跨峡通道。宏伟的新桥于1793年建成，将老城与对岸的梅尔卡迪略连接起来。

english: Rong Damrel lies in the wooded border country northwest of Saigon, in the region later called Tây Ninh. Its Khmer name is associated with elephants, which inhabited the forests of the area. Vietnamese settlers gradually cleared land and established villages in this frontier country. In 1836 the Nguyễn court created Tây Ninh as a prefecture under Gia Định, extending its administration over the region and its mixed communities.
simp_chinese: 龙达姆雷位于西贡西北方的林间边地，即后来称为西宁的地区。其高棉语名称与栖居当地森林的大象有关。越南移民逐渐在这片边地垦荒建村。1836年，阮朝设立隶属嘉定的西宁府，将行政管辖扩展到当地及不同族群的社群。

sources.title: Ngay Hoi KHGV  TAP III merged.pdf

english:
Rongchang lies among the rolling hills of eastern Sichuan, a place long associated with the making of pottery. At Anfu, potters worked local clay into vessels for daily use, firing wares whose fine body and smooth surface became characteristic of the district. Kilns operated through the Yuan and Ming periods, continuing a craft that had already flourished under the Song, when many kilns worked around Anfu.

After the warfare and population losses of the late Ming, migrants came to Sichuan from other provinces. Some made pottery their livelihood, handing the craft down within their families. Their work helped sustain and renew Rongchang's kilns in the early Qing, when the production of everyday jars and other vessels continued to serve the surrounding country.
simp_chinese:
荣昌坐落在川东起伏的丘陵间，制陶传统源远流长。安富的陶工利用当地泥土制作日用器皿，烧成的陶器胎质细密、表面光润，形成了地方特色。元明时期，窑场仍在运作，延续着宋代已十分兴盛的手艺。

明末战乱和人口损失之后，外省移民陆续来到四川。一些人以制陶为生，将技艺代代相传。清初，荣昌的窑业因此得到延续和发展，陶工继续烧制日用的坛罐等器物，供给周边地区。

english: Rongcheng was an old county seat on the Xun River west of Wuzhou. Known earlier as Suicheng, it acquired the name Rongcheng under the Sui and was absorbed into Cangwu in 1071. The settlement continued as Rongxu, a market town on the river. In 1714 merchants from Guangdong converted an existing shrine to Guan Yu into a guildhall; it was rebuilt and enlarged in 1788, reflecting the presence of merchants from downstream in this inland market.
simp_chinese: 戎城是梧州以西浔江边的一处古县治。这里原称遂城，隋代改名戎城，1071年并入苍梧，此后作为戎圩市镇延续。1714年，广东商人将原有关夫子祠改建为会馆，1788年又重建扩充。会馆见证了下游商人在这处内河市镇的活动。

english: Rongelap is a low coral atoll in the northern Ralik chain of the Marshall Islands. Its islands and lagoon formed part of a seafaring world in which Marshallese navigators travelled between distant atolls. In 1825 Otto von Kotzebue sighted Rongelap from the Predpriaty and named it for the Russian naval officer Rimsky-Korsakov.
simp_chinese: 朗格拉普是马绍尔群岛拉利克岛链北部的低矮珊瑚环礁。其岛屿与潟湖属于马绍尔航海者乘船穿越远方环礁的海洋世界。1825年，奥托·冯·科策布从企业号上望见朗格拉普，并以俄国海军军官里姆斯基-科萨科夫的名字命名。

english: Rongelap is a coral atoll in the northern Marshall Islands, with low islets surrounding a lagoon. In 1825 Otto von Kotzebue examined Rongelap and neighbouring atolls, giving them the name Rimsky-Korsakov Islands. Marshallese communities had inhabited and navigated the region before European arrival.
simp_chinese: 朗格拉普是马绍尔群岛北部的一座珊瑚环礁，低矮小岛围住潟湖。1825年，奥托·冯·科策布考察朗格拉普和邻近环礁，将它们命名为里姆斯基-科萨科夫群岛。欧洲人到来之前，马绍尔社群已在这一地区生活和航行。

english: Rongerik is a small atoll east of Rongelap in the northern Marshall Islands. Its low islets lie along a coral reef enclosing a lagoon. Marshallese navigators knew the islands long before European ships crossed the group. In 1825 Otto von Kotzebue sighted Rongerik during the voyage of the Russian sloop Predpriaty.
simp_chinese: 朗格里克是马绍尔群岛北部、朗格拉普以东的小环礁。低矮小岛沿珊瑚礁分布，围住一片潟湖。欧洲船只穿越群岛之前，马绍尔航海者早已熟悉这些岛屿。1825年，奥托·冯·科策布乘俄国帆船企业号航行时望见朗格里克。

english:
Róngjīng belongs to the mountain approaches west of the Sichuan Basin, where valleys and passes connect agricultural country with the Tibetan highland world. Cultivation occupies suitable ground, while forests, livestock, and local crafts broaden household resources. Routes carry goods between environments with very different productive possibilities. Rain, steep slopes, and river crossings make practical knowledge essential to transport and the maintenance of dependable connections.

Rongjing is associated with Yingjing, historically known as Yandao. The wider Yazhou region linked the Sichuan basin with highland communities, and Yingjing lay on routes later associated with the tea-horse trade. County names and jurisdictions changed over time.
simp_chinese:
荣经属于四川盆地以西山地入口，河谷山口将农业地区同西藏高地世界连接起来。适宜土地用于耕作，森林、牲畜和地方手工业丰富家庭资源。路线在生产机会差异明显的环境之间运输货物，降雨、陡坡及渡河条件，使实际知识对交通及可靠联系维持十分重要。

荣经与荥经相关，荥经古称严道。广大雅州地区连接四川盆地与高地社群，荥经位于后来与茶马贸易相关的路线之上。县名与辖区曾有变化。

english: Tsige Dartso lies in a high basin north of the Nyainqêntanglha Mountains. The salty, alkaline lake has no outlet to the sea and reaches nearly forty metres in depth. Its water forms persistent layers: the less dense upper water remains distinct from the deeper layer. Springs, streams and seasonal inflow bring water to Tsige Dartso, while evaporation removes it from the basin.
simp_chinese: 兹格塘错坐落在念青唐古拉山以北的高原盆地，湖水咸而呈碱性，没有通往海洋的出口，最深处接近四十米。湖水长期分层，密度较低的上层与深层水保持区分。泉水、溪流与季节性径流补给兹格塘错，蒸发则带走湖盆中的水分。

english: Róngměi was a powerful hereditary chiefship in the mountains of western Hubei, ruled by the Tián family. Its chiefs governed a network of subordinate offices and maintained connections with the imperial courts, while their mountain residences supported a distinctive local literary culture. The Qing writer Gù Cǎi visited the chief Tián Shùnnián and described his travels through Róngměi. Relations with Qing officials became increasingly strained in the early eighteenth century. Officials accused Tián Shùnnián of abuses and proposed replacing hereditary rule with appointed administration. In 1735 the court completed its reorganisation of the western Hubei chiefships, creating Hèfēng Zhou and other new jurisdictions in their place.
simp_chinese: 容美是湖北西部山地中势力强大的世袭土司，由田氏掌管。土司统辖多个下属建置，与历代朝廷保持联系，其山中居所也孕育出地方文学传统。清代文人顾彩曾访问土司田舜年，写下《容美纪游》。十八世纪初，容美与清朝官员的关系日益紧张。官员弹劾田舜年，并提议改土归流。雍正十三年（1735年），清廷完成鄂西土司地区的行政调整，在原有辖地上设鹤峰州及其他新建置。

english:
Rongmei refers to a Naga people of the hills of northeastern India, also known in some sources as Kabui. Wooded slopes and valleys form the setting for communities with their own language and social traditions. Cultivation, forest resources and paths between villages supported life in the uplands.

Rongmei communities share cultural ties with the Zeme, Liangmai and Inpui, peoples associated with the collective name Zeliangrong. An ethnographic study of Manipur describes related customary practices and oral traditions alongside distinct languages or dialects.
simp_chinese:
荣梅指印度东北丘陵地带的一个那加族群，部分资料也称其为卡布伊。林木覆盖的山坡与河谷，是拥有自身语言和社会传统的社群生活之地。耕作、森林资源及村落间的山路，共同支持高地生活。

荣梅人与泽梅、梁迈和因普伊人有文化联系，这些群体与泽梁荣的合称相关。一项关于曼尼普尔的民族志研究描述了相近的习惯和口头传统，同时指出各群体有不同语言或方言。

english: Rongpo is associated with Shak Rongpo Gaden Dargyeling, a Gelug monastery in the highlands of Nagchu. It was established in the seventeenth century by the first Rongpo Chöje, Lobsang Trinley, on the instructions of the Fifth Dalai Lama. The monastery became a religious centre for the surrounding communities of the northern Tibetan plateau.
simp_chinese: 绒布与那曲高地的夏曲绒布噶丹达吉林寺相联系。这座格鲁派寺院由第一世绒布曲杰洛桑赤列于十七世纪依第五世达赖喇嘛之命创建，成为藏北高原周围社群的宗教中心。

english: Róngshān was a hereditary native chiefship in the Bōzhōu region of northern Guizhou, in the country around Méitàn. The Yuan had already established an office here, and the Ming renewed it in 1384 under the authority of the Bōzhōu ruler. Its chief came from the Zhāng family, with a deputy from the Hán family. After the Ming campaign against Bōzhōu in 1600, officials proposed distributing the lands of Róngshān among the counties created to replace the old native jurisdictions.
simp_chinese: 容山是黔北播州地区的一处世袭土司辖地，位于今湄潭一带。元代已设容山长官司，明洪武十七年（1384年）沿置，归播州宣慰司管辖；正长官为张氏，副长官为韩氏。万历二十八年（1600年）明军平定播州后，官员提议将容山所属土地划入新设各县，以取代旧有土司建置。

english: Rongshui stands in the mountainous country of northern Guangxi, beside the river that gives it its name. Under the Yuan it was the seat of Rongzhou, whose territory extended across the surrounding highlands. The early Ming reorganized the district: in 1369 Rongshui County was absorbed into the prefecture, and in 1377 Rongzhou itself was reduced to Rong County under Liuzhou Prefecture. Mountain streams and the Rong River connect the scattered valleys of this forested region.
simp_chinese: 融水位于广西北部山地，融江从这里流过。元代融水为融州州治，州境延及周围山岭。明初，朝廷重新调整建置：1369年撤融水县并入融州，1377年又降融州为融县，属柳州府。融江和山间溪流连接着林地间分散的河谷。

english: Rong County lay in the hills south of the Yangtze, in a region inhabited by communities known in Ming records as the Duzhang. The county was established from the former Rongzhou under the early Ming. In the sixteenth century campaigns against the Duzhang brought severe fighting to the district. Afterwards the authorities changed the county's name to Xingwen and established a fortified administrative centre at Jianwu.
simp_chinese: 戎县位于长江以南的丘陵地带，明代文献所称都掌诸部居住于此。明初，朝廷将原戎州降为县。十六世纪，针对都掌的军事行动使当地陷入激烈战争；此后官府将戎县改名兴文，并在建武设立设防的治所。

english: Rongzhou lies among the hills east of Jiading. Its great seated Buddha, carved into a cliff east of the town, looks out over a landscape of wooded slopes. The image represents Shakyamuni and rises more than thirty metres high. The monument stands as a testament to the Buddhist communities of the region, and its great scale recalls the other famous Buddha at neighbouring Jiading.
simp_chinese: 荣州位于嘉定以东的丘陵间。城东崖壁上雕有一尊巨大的释迦牟尼坐像，俯瞰林木覆盖的山坡，佛身高逾三十米。这座造像是当地佛教传统的醒目标志，其规模使人联想到邻近嘉定的著名大佛。

english: Ronneby grew beside a river in Blekinge, near the Baltic coast. Its oldest surviving town privileges date from 1387, when the region belonged to Denmark, and in the Middle Ages it was an important trading and shipping town. During the Northern Seven Years' War, Swedish forces under Erik XIV took Ronneby in 1564, killing many inhabitants and burning the town. Contemporary accounts on both sides exaggerated the number of victims. Blekinge passed to Sweden under the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658. The Swedish crown later founded the naval town of Karlskrona to the east and withdrew Ronneby's town privileges. Ronneby nevertheless attracted industries in the eighteenth century; a mineral spring discovered in 1705 also gave rise to a spa.
simp_chinese: 龙讷比位于布莱金厄的河畔，靠近波罗的海。现存最早的城市特权文书可追溯至1387年，当时这里属于丹麦；中世纪的龙讷比是重要的贸易与航运城镇。北方七年战争期间，埃里克十四世率瑞典军队于1564年攻占此地，杀害许多居民并焚毁城镇；交战双方的同时代记载都夸大了遇难人数。1658年《罗斯基勒条约》使布莱金厄转归瑞典，瑞典王室后来在东边建立海军城市卡尔斯克鲁纳，并撤销龙讷比的城市特权。十八世纪当地仍吸引了一些产业，1705年发现的矿泉也促成了疗养地的发展。

english: Roon is an island in Cenderawasih Bay, off the eastern side of the Bird’s Head Peninsula of New Guinea. Its language is Austronesian, and its shores face the mountainous mainland across sheltered waters. Canoe voyages connected islands and coastal communities around the bay, where different Papuan and Austronesian languages were spoken.
simp_chinese: 罗翁是新几内亚鸟头半岛东侧极乐鸟湾中的一座岛屿。当地语言属于南岛语系，岛岸隔着较受庇护的水域，面向多山大陆。独木舟航行连接海湾周围的岛屿与沿海社群，那里分布着不同的巴布亚语言和南岛语言。

english: Ropsk lies in the wooded country southwest of Starodub. The town of Ropesk is mentioned in the chronicles in 1159 and is associated with the settlement later called Stary Ropsk. In the seventeenth century the district became part of the Cossack Hetmanate. When the Starodub regiment was separated from the Nizhyn regiment in 1663, Ropsk was among its company centres.
simp_chinese: 罗普斯克位于斯塔罗杜布西南方的森林地带。1159年的编年史提到罗佩斯克城镇，它与后来称为旧罗普斯克的居民点相联系。十七世纪，这一地区成为哥萨克酋长国的一部分。1663年，斯塔罗杜布团从涅任团分出时，罗普斯克是其百人队驻地之一。

english:
Røros is a mining town in the cold uplands near the Swedish border. Its wooden houses grew around a copper smelter on the Hitterelva, while mines in the surrounding mountains supplied the ore. Agriculture was difficult at this altitude, yet miners and their families kept livestock and cultivated what they could, combining town life with the work of mountain farms.

Copper was found in the Røros mountains in 1644, and a productive mine opened at Storwartz the following year. In 1646 Christian IV granted the copper works privileges over a wide area around the mine, including access to forests, waterways and labour. Smelting required enormous quantities of charcoal and wood; farmers carried these supplies by horse and sledge, while finished copper travelled to Trondheim. Swedish troops burned the settlement in 1678 and again in 1679, but it was rebuilt.

As nearby woodland was exhausted, the works sought fuel farther away and established additional smelters near forests. A system completed in 1764 connected waterways between Lakes Femunden and Feragen, allowing timber to be floated towards Røros. During winter, frozen lakes also formed part of the route for carrying ore to the smelter at Femundshytta. The works depended on supplies from farmers well beyond its original privilege area. Mining thus reshaped a far larger landscape than the town itself, drawing together mines, forests, farms and transport routes.
simp_chinese:
勒罗斯是一座靠近瑞典边境的寒冷高地矿城。木屋围绕希特尔河畔的铜冶炼厂兴起，周围山中的矿场提供矿石。高海拔使农业艰难，矿工及家人仍饲养牲畜、尽力耕作，将城镇生活同山地农场劳动结合起来。

1644年，勒罗斯山区发现铜矿，次年斯图尔瓦茨开始开采富有价值的矿脉。1646年，克里斯蒂安四世授予铜矿公司以矿场为中心的广大特许区域，包括利用森林、水道和劳力的权利。冶炼需要大量木炭和木材；农民用马和雪橇运输这些物资，成品铜则运往特隆赫姆。瑞典军队在1678和1679年两次焚毁聚落，但它得到重建。

随着附近林木消耗，公司向更远处寻找燃料，在森林附近设立更多冶炼场。1764年完工的一套水道连接费蒙湖与费拉根湖，使木材能够漂运往勒罗斯。冬季结冰的湖面也成为运送矿石前往费蒙冶炼场的路线之一。铜矿公司依靠远在原特许区外的农民供应物资。采矿因此改变了远超城镇本身的广大土地，将矿场、森林、农场和运输路线联系起来。

english:
Roscommon stands in the heart of Connacht, close to the great limestone castle built for the English Crown in the thirteenth century. The town also grew around an older religious foundation and a Dominican friary. Its castle, intended to secure royal authority in a contested province, became a stronghold of the Gaelic O'Conors for more than two centuries.

The O'Conor Don surrendered the castle in 1569.
