english: Rumoi grew around the mouth of a river on the Sea of Japan, where an Ainu settlement and the Rurumoppe trading district stood. Salmon, trout and kelp were exchanged here, and fishing vessels gathered at the river mouth. In 1808, according to local history, the district's manager Yamada Bun'emon employed Ainu workers to prepare a mountain route from Rumoi toward the Uryū River basin, connecting the coast with the interior.
simp_chinese: 留萌位于注入日本海的河口附近，阿伊努聚落和“鲁鲁莫佩”交易场所曾设于此。鲑鱼、鳟鱼和昆布在这里交换，渔船也汇集河口。据地方史记载，1808年，场所管理人山田文右卫门雇用阿伊努人修整从留萌翻山通向雨龙川流域的道路，将海岸与内陆相连。

english: Rumu country lies along the middle Kikori River and its tributaries, inland from the great delta of the Gulf of Papua. The Rumu language is also known as Kairi, and its speakers inhabit a forested river landscape upstream from the Kerewo. The Kikori connects the interior with the delta, where goods moving along river routes met those exchanged on the coast.
simp_chinese: 鲁穆地区位于基科里河中游及其支流沿岸，处于巴布亚湾大三角洲的内陆。鲁穆语又称凯里语，使用者生活在克雷沃地区上游的森林河流地带。基科里河连接内陆与三角洲，沿河流动的物品与沿海交换的货物在那里相遇。

english: The Rungan River flows through the forested interior of central Borneo toward the Kahayan. Ngaju Dayak communities inhabit its valleys and the surrounding hills, sharing a language spoken along several rivers of the region. The Rungan's tributaries and forested banks form part of a landscape where waterways connect settlements with the wider Kahayan basin and the lowlands to the south.
simp_chinese: 容岸河流经婆罗洲中部森林覆盖的内陆，流向卡哈扬河。恩加朱达雅克社群居住在河谷与周围丘陵，使用该地区数条河流沿岸通行的语言。容岸河支流和林木覆盖的河岸构成一片水道纵横的土地，将聚落与更广阔的卡哈扬流域及南方低地联系起来。

english: Rùnyán lay in the salt-producing highlands of southwestern Sichuan. The Yuan established a salt-well command here in 1277, later making it a county under Baixing. In 1393 the Ming set up the Yánjǐng military garrison. Salt from the White and Black wells of the Yanyuan area travelled along routes through mountain communities towards Ninglang and Lijiang.
simp_chinese: 闰盐位于四川西南产盐高地。元朝于1277年在此设盐井千户，后来置闰盐县，属柏兴。明洪武二十六年（1393年）设盐井卫；盐源白盐井与黑盐井出产的盐沿山路运往宁蒗、丽江等地。

english: Lake Rupanco lies among the forested foothills of the southern Andes, south of Lake Puyehue. Its long basin is overlooked by volcanic peaks, including Puntiagudo to the east. Streams descending from the mountains feed the lake, whose waters continue west through the river system of the Chilean lake district. The name Rupanco comes from an indigenous language and has been interpreted as referring to flowing water.
simp_chinese: 鲁潘科湖位于南安第斯森林山麓中，在普耶韦湖以南。狭长的湖盆上方耸立着火山峰，包括东面的蓬蒂亚古多火山。山间溪流汇入湖中，湖水经智利湖区河网向西流去。鲁潘科之名来自原住民语言，被解释为与流动的水有关。

english: The Rupert Plateau is a broad region of forest and rolling ground in the northern Canadian Shield. Thin glacial deposits cover much of its ancient rock, while organic soils gather in hollows and lakes and rivers break the woodland into innumerable stretches. Black spruce dominates the boreal forest, with balsam fir in denser stands. Summers are cool and winters cold across the country between Lake Mistassini and James Bay.
simp_chinese: 鲁珀特高原是加拿大地盾北部一片广阔的森林和起伏地带。古老岩层上覆盖着薄薄的冰川沉积物，洼地中积聚着有机土壤，湖泊与河流将林地分割成无数片。黑云杉是北方森林的主要树种，稠密林分中也有香脂冷杉。米斯塔西尼湖与詹姆斯湾之间的这片地区夏季凉爽，冬季寒冷。

english: Rupharupha lies in the warm, forested valley of the upper Huallaga, where rivers descend from the eastern Peruvian Andes. Before the expansion of Spanish settlement, the Panatahua and neighbouring peoples inhabited the country along the Monzón, Tulumayo and Huallaga rivers. Their lands occupied the transition between high mountain slopes and the humid forests of the Amazon basin.
simp_chinese: 鲁法鲁法位于温暖、森林茂密的瓦亚加河上游河谷，河流从秘鲁安第斯东坡下降至此。西班牙聚落扩张之前，帕纳塔瓦人及邻近族群居住在蒙松河、图卢马约河与瓦亚加河沿岸。他们的土地处在高山山坡与亚马孙盆地湿润森林之间的过渡地带。

english:
Ruppin lies in the lake country of northern Brandenburg. The castle at Alt Ruppin served as the political centre of the lordship of the counts of Lindow-Ruppin, while nearby Neuruppin became its economic centre and received town rights in 1256. A Dominican monastery was founded there in 1246, the first in the Mark of Brandenburg.

When the ruling line died out in 1524, Ruppin passed to the electors of Brandenburg. The Reformation brought the monastery's property under electoral control. In 1787 a major fire devastated Neuruppin; it was rebuilt in the following years with Prussian support. The name Ruppin can refer to both the historic lordship and its settlements around the lake.
simp_chinese:
鲁平位于勃兰登堡北部的湖泊地区。旧鲁平的城堡是林多—鲁平伯爵领地的政治中心，附近的新鲁平则发展为经济中心，1256年获得城镇权。1246年，当地建立了勃兰登堡马克的第一座多明我会修道院。

1524年统治家族绝嗣后，鲁平转归勃兰登堡选侯。宗教改革期间，修道院财产落入选侯控制。1787年大火重创新鲁平，随后在普鲁士支持下重建。鲁平一名既可指历史领地，也可指湖泊周围的聚落。

english: Rurutu rises above the South Pacific as a high island fringed by uplifted limestone cliffs and caves. Its Polynesian communities cultivated the valleys beneath the hills. In 1821 islanders who had reached Raiatea returned with Christian teachers, bringing the new faith from the Society Islands to Rurutu.
simp_chinese: 鲁鲁图是一座耸立于南太平洋的高岛，四周有隆起的石灰岩峭壁和洞穴。岛上的波利尼西亚社群在丘陵下的山谷耕作。1821年，抵达赖阿特阿的岛民带着基督教教师返回，将社会群岛的新信仰传到鲁鲁图。

english: Rurutu is a high island of the Austral group, with valleys opening toward the Pacific. James Cook passed it in 1769 without landing. In the following decades traders and whalers visited; Rurutuans who encountered Christianity on Raiatea later carried their new faith back to the island.
simp_chinese: 鲁鲁图是南方群岛的一座高岛，山谷向太平洋敞开。詹姆斯·库克于1769年经过，但没有登陆。此后几十年，商人和捕鲸船到访；在赖阿特阿接触基督教的鲁鲁图人后来将新信仰带回岛上。

english: Al-Rusafa was a settlement in the district of Wasit in southern Iraq, associated with the Maymun watercourse. Medieval writers distinguished it from the many other places bearing the same name, including the eastern quarter of Baghdad. One described it as a large village downstream from Wasit; another named it the principal settlement of the Maymun district. Its position belonged to the network of river channels and cultivated lands that spread across the lower Iraqi plain.
simp_chinese: 鲁萨法是伊拉克南部瓦西特地区的一处聚落，与迈蒙水道相联系。中世纪作家将它同其他许多同名地点区分开来，包括巴格达东部的城区。一位作者称它是瓦西特下游的大村庄，另一位则称它为迈蒙地区的主要聚落。这里处于遍布伊拉克下游平原的水道和耕地网络中。

english:
On the southern bank of the Danube, Ruse occupied a site long prized for its river traffic. The Roman fortress of Sexaginta Prista, whose name meant the port of sixty ships, guarded the empire's northern frontier here. A fortified Bulgarian settlement called Rusi later grew near the ancient remains. Under Ottoman rule it became known as Rusçuk, a port whose river connections made it a center of commerce and military supply.

By the 16th century Rusçuk had become an active trading and military town, and in the early 17th century it served as a base for the Ottoman Danube fleet. Its fortress became prominent in the wars between the Ottoman Empire and Russia. In 1811 Russian and Ottoman armies fought near the town, while Austrian merchants established themselves there and strengthened trade along the river.
simp_chinese:
鲁塞位于多瑙河南岸，这里很早便因河运而受到重视。罗马堡垒塞克萨金塔·普里斯塔曾守卫帝国北部边疆，其名称意为“六十艘船的港口”。一座名为鲁西的保加利亚设防聚落后来在古城遗址附近兴起。奥斯曼统治下，此地称为鲁斯丘克，凭借河流交通成为商业和军需供应中心。

到16世纪，鲁斯丘克已是活跃的贸易与军事城镇；17世纪初，它又成为奥斯曼多瑙河舰队的基地。奥斯曼帝国与俄国交战时，这里的堡垒备受关注。1811年，俄军与奥斯曼军队在城镇附近交战；与此同时，奥地利商人来到此地定居，促进了沿河贸易。

english: Rushan occupies a stretch of the southern Jiaodong coast, where bays and low hills meet the sea. On a peninsula nearby, the Ming established the Haiyang military post at a place once called Shagouzhai. Its garrison formed part of the coastal defences against maritime raiders. Military households from other parts of China settled in the district, and their descendants remained after the post was abolished. The name Haiyangsuo passed from the garrison to the settlement that grew around it.
simp_chinese: 乳山位于胶东半岛南岸，海湾与低丘在此相接。明朝在附近半岛上的沙沟寨设海阳守御所，作为防备海上袭扰的驻军据点。来自各地的军户在境内落籍，守御所裁撤后，后代仍在此居住。“海阳所”之名也由军所传给了周围的聚落。

english:
Rușii de Vede is a market town on the Vedea in the plains of Teleorman. Its merchants dealt in the products of the surrounding countryside and maintained connections with Brașov across the Carpathians. A company of mounted soldiers stationed here gave the town a military as well as a commercial role in southern Wallachia.

Two German pilgrims returning from Jerusalem recorded a stop at a place called Russenart in 1385, identified with the town. Merchants from Rușii de Vede appear in the registers of Brașov in 1503, and a princely deed of 1526 uses the full name. During the sixteenth century it became the seat of Teleorman county, a distinction it retained into the nineteenth century. By 1831 its trades included grocers, furriers, shoemakers, coppersmiths and dyers.
simp_chinese:
韦代亚河畔鲁希是泰莱奥尔曼平原上的一座集镇，坐落在韦代亚河边。商人在此交易周围乡村的产品，并与喀尔巴阡山另一侧的布拉索夫保持联系。一支驻扎于此的骑兵使城镇在瓦拉几亚南部兼具军事和商业地位。

1385年，两名从耶路撒冷归来的德国朝圣者记下了在鲁森阿尔特停留的经历，这个地方被认为就是此城。1503年布拉索夫的账册中出现了来自韦代亚河畔鲁希的商人，1526年的公爵文书则使用了完整地名。十六世纪，这里成为泰莱奥尔曼县治所，并一直保持这一地位至十九世纪。1831年镇上已有杂货商、皮货匠、鞋匠、铜匠和染工等行业。

sources.title: HCL nr. 93 din 29 august 2003 - Statutul Municipiului Rosiorii de Vede (cu completările și modificările ulterioare).pdf

english: Rusokastro stands inland from the Bay of Burgas, where a fortified height overlooks the approaches to the eastern Balkan passes. Its walls enclosed a citadel, and a protected passage led down to a well supplied by the Rusokastrenska River. In 1332 Tsar Ivan Alexander defeated the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III near the fortress, securing Bulgarian control of the southern Black Sea coast for a time. The stronghold remained a landmark of the region's medieval frontier and was destroyed during Ottoman campaigns in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 鲁索卡斯特罗位于布尔加斯湾内陆，一处设防高地俯瞰着通往巴尔干山东部山口的道路。城墙围护着堡垒，一条受到保护的通道通向下方水井，井水来自鲁索卡斯特伦斯卡河。1332年，沙皇伊凡·亚历山大在堡垒附近击败拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世，使保加利亚暂时巩固了对黑海南岸的控制。这座据点是地区中世纪边疆的重要堡垒，十五世纪在奥斯曼军队的战事中被毁。

english: Forests and wetlands spread across the watershed east of Lake Onega, broken by lakes and narrow rivers. The Vodla and Ileksa offered routes through this northern country: Novgorodian traders travelled along them toward the inland forests and Pomorye. Communities grew around lakes such as Vodlozero, while stretches of wet ground and woodland lay between their cultivated clearings. In winter the frozen waters changed the routes available through the forest.
simp_chinese: 奥涅加湖以东的分水岭上森林和湿地延展，其间分布着湖泊与狭窄河流。沃德拉河和伊列克萨河提供穿越北方土地的路线，诺夫哥罗德商人沿水路前往内陆森林和波莫里耶。沃德洛泽罗等湖泊周围形成了社区，湿地和树林则分隔着各处开垦地。冬季水面封冻，穿越森林的路径也随之改变。

english: The forests east of the Vashka belong to the northern taiga between the Mezen and Vychegda basins. Spruce woods and patches of pine stretch across a country of low ridges, streams and wetlands. The Vashka flows northwest through this landscape to the Mezen, connecting the river villages with a route towards the White Sea. Far from the riverbanks, forest and marsh occupy much of the land.
simp_chinese: 瓦什卡河以东的森林属于梅津河与维切格达河流域之间的北方针叶林。云杉林和片片松林覆盖低矮山脊、溪流与湿地交错的地带。瓦什卡河穿过这片景观向西北流入梅津河，将沿河村庄与通向白海的水路联系起来。离开河岸之后，大片土地为森林与沼泽所占据。

english: South of the Pinega, wet forests and peatlands spread across the northern Dvina basin. Small streams drain the low ground towards the Pinega and its tributaries, while spruce and pine grow on the better-drained slopes. The river valleys offer passages through a landscape otherwise broken by bogs and dense woodland. In winter snow and frozen waters change the character of travel across this northern country.
simp_chinese: 皮涅加河以南，潮湿森林与泥炭沼泽遍布北德维纳河流域。小溪将低地的水汇入皮涅加河及其支流，排水较好的坡地则生长着云杉和松树。河谷提供穿过沼泽与密林的通道；冬季积雪与冰封的水面，又改变了人们穿行这片北方土地的方式。

english: The forests between the Northern Dvina and Kuloy cover a low northern landscape of streams, bogs and conifers. Pine and spruce stand among wetlands in the long winter cold, while the rivers find their way towards the White Sea. In the Kuloy basin the Kelda and Polta are among the tributaries cutting through this broad forest country, whose waters join the Mezen Gulf.
simp_chinese: 北德维纳河与库洛伊河之间，针叶林覆盖着溪流和沼泽交错的北方低地。漫长寒冬中，松树和云杉生长在湿地之间，河流向白海汇去。库洛伊流域的凯尔达河和波尔塔河等支流穿过广阔林地，水流最终注入梅津湾。

english: Between the Pinega and Kuloy stretches a northern forest landscape shaped by rivers and soluble rock. The headwaters of the Kuloy approach the Pinega so closely that travellers once hauled their boats across a short portage. Gypsum and other soluble strata have produced caves and hollows in the country between the rivers. Forest and wet ground surround the waterways that lead towards the Northern Dvina and the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 皮涅加河与库洛伊河之间，是由河流和可溶岩层塑造的北方林地。库洛伊河上游与皮涅加河相距很近，旅人曾在两条河之间经短陆路拖运船只。石膏等可溶岩层在两河间形成洞穴和洼地；森林与湿地环绕着通向北德维纳河和白海的水道。

english: East of the Kuloy, the northern taiga stretches across the watershed towards the Mezen. Spruce woods and stands of pine surround the streams and marshes that feed the rivers. The Kuloy and its tributaries drain north towards the White Sea, while rivers farther east belong to the Mezen basin. In winter snow and ice cover a landscape whose waterways and forests define its long northern seasons.
simp_chinese: 库洛伊河以东，北方针叶林横跨分水岭，延伸至梅津河方向。云杉林与松树林环绕着汇入河流的溪水和沼泽。库洛伊河及其支流向北流向白海，更东边的河流则属于梅津河流域。冬季，积雪与冰层覆盖大地，水道和森林共同塑造了这里漫长的北方季节。

english: The forested watershed between the Pinega and Vashka forms part of the broad northern taiga. The Pinega belongs to the Northern Dvina system, while the Vashka flows towards the Mezen; both eventually reach the White Sea. Spruce and pine grow among streams and bogs, and snow lies over the forest for much of the year. River valleys provide the clearest routes through the wooded country.
simp_chinese: 皮涅加河与瓦什卡河之间的森林分水岭属于广阔的北方针叶林。皮涅加河归入北德维纳河水系，瓦什卡河则流向梅津河，两者最终都通往白海。云杉和松树生长在溪流与沼泽之间，一年中大部分时间森林被积雪覆盖。河谷为穿过林地提供了较清晰的通路。

english: East of the Mezen the northern forest gives way gradually to the open tundra of the Timan country. Low ridges and wetlands divide the waters flowing towards the Mezen and Pechora. Spruce and pine are found along the southern river valleys, while farther north trees become sparse. Snow covers the ground through the long winter, and the short summer brings life to the marshes and streams.
simp_chinese: 梅津河以东，北方森林逐渐过渡为季曼地区开阔的苔原。低矮山脊与湿地分隔流向梅津河和伯朝拉河的水系。南部河谷可见云杉与松树，向北树木则愈发稀疏。漫长冬季里积雪覆盖大地，短暂的夏季又使沼泽与溪流恢复生机。

english: The northern forests between the Ilesha and Uftyuga stretch across the watershed of the Pinega, Vychegda and Northern Dvina. Rivers rise among the woods and marshes and run towards the great waterways on either side. The Malaya Ilesha flows north towards the Pinega, while the Uftyuga makes its way west to the Northern Dvina. The intervening forest forms a broad inland country between the river valleys and their scattered settlements.
simp_chinese: 伊列沙河与乌夫秋加河之间的北方森林横跨皮涅加河、维切格达河及北德维纳河的分水岭。河流发源于林地和沼泽之间，流向两侧较大的水道。小伊列沙河向北流往皮涅加河，乌夫秋加河则向西汇入北德维纳河。其间的森林构成一片广阔的内陆地带，隔开了各条河谷及散布其间的聚落。

english: Russky Kameshkir was founded around 1700 on land belonging to the Trinity Monastery of Saint Sergius. Its first name, Sergiyevskoye, came from a church with an altar dedicated to Sergius of Radonezh, the monastery's founder. The village formed part of the spread of settlement into the lands southeast of Penza, where monastic estates stood among the communities of the Sura and Khopyor country. Its later name distinguished it as the Russian Kameshkir.
simp_chinese: 俄罗斯卡梅什基尔约于1700年建立在圣三一圣谢尔盖修道院的土地上。村庄最初名为谢尔吉耶夫斯科耶，得名于供奉修道院创建者拉多涅日的圣谢尔盖的教堂。它是向奔萨东南部扩展的聚落之一；在苏拉河与霍皮奥尔河流域，修道院庄园与众多村落并存。后来的名称将其称作“俄罗斯的卡梅什基尔”，以示区别。

english:
Rustaq lies in a broad oasis on the northern side of Oman's mountains. Its great fortress rises above palm gardens and water channels, guarding the approaches between the interior and the Batinah coast. Towers, gateways and thick walls mark successive stages in the building's long history.

In 1624 Omani leaders chose Nasir ibn Murshid of the Yaruba as imam at Rustaq. He made the town a centre of his authority and worked to bring divided territories together while challenging Portuguese positions on the coast. The fortress was renewed during his reign and became a strategic base of the Yaruba imamate. Rustaq served as a capital more than once; later rulers added to its defences, including the Wind Tower attributed to Imam Sayf ibn Sultan. The fort and its oasis recall a period when the interior was a base for a growing maritime power.
simp_chinese:
鲁斯塔格位于阿曼山脉北侧的一片广阔绿洲中。宏伟的堡垒俯瞰枣椰园和水渠，守护连接内陆与巴提纳海岸的通道。塔楼、城门与厚墙记录了这座建筑漫长历史中的不同阶段。

1624年，阿曼首领在鲁斯塔格推举雅鲁巴家族的纳西尔·伊本·穆尔希德为伊玛目。他以此镇为权力中心，努力联合分裂的地区，并挑战葡萄牙人在海岸的据点。堡垒在他统治期间重修，成为雅鲁巴伊玛目国的战略基地。鲁斯塔格曾多次担任都城；后来的统治者继续增筑防御工事，其中风塔被认为由伊玛目赛义夫·伊本·苏丹建造。堡垒和绿洲让人想起内陆成为新兴海上力量基地的时期。

english:
Rustavi lies in Georgia's Kura valley, along routes connecting farming districts with towns and neighbouring parts of the southern Caucasus. It has an ancient urban and ecclesiastical inheritance. Medieval warfare and invasions profoundly changed the town and surrounding country; agriculture and river-valley transport remain important context for its longer history.

During the later Middle Ages, the Georgian kingdom fragmented into competing political centres. Eastern Georgia faced strong Iranian influence as well as pressure from the Ottomans and other powers. Kings and nobles negotiated allegiance, tribute and military support amid changing conflicts. Russian intervention grew in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, and eastern Georgia was incorporated into the Russian Empire. Rustavi later became an industrial city, but the history of its river-valley site reaches much further back.
simp_chinese:
鲁斯塔维位于格鲁吉亚的库拉河谷，南高加索的道路把这一带的农区与城镇及邻近地区相连。这里有古代城市与教会的遗产；中世纪的战争和入侵则深刻改变了城镇及周边地区。河谷中的农业和交通，仍是理解这片地区历史的重要背景。

中世纪后期，格鲁吉亚王国分裂为多个政治中心。东格鲁吉亚受到伊朗的强烈影响，也面临奥斯曼等势力的压力。国王和贵族在不断变化的冲突中处理效忠、贡赋与军事支持。十八世纪末至十九世纪初，俄罗斯的介入加深，东格鲁吉亚最终并入俄罗斯帝国。鲁斯塔维后来发展成工业城市，但其河谷所在地的历史远早于这一时期。

english: Oakham is a market town in Rutland, with a remarkable Norman great hall at the heart of its old castle. Built in the late twelfth century for the lord of the manor, the hall preserves richly carved stonework from a time when it served both as a residence and a place of authority. An old local custom required visiting peers to present a horseshoe to the lord, and such gifts came to adorn the hall's walls.
simp_chinese: 奥克姆是拉特兰的一座集镇，旧城堡中心保存着一座非凡的诺曼大厅。大厅于十二世纪末为庄园领主建造，留有精美的石雕；它既是居所，也是行使权威的场所。当地古俗要求首次到访的贵族向领主献上一只马蹄铁，这些礼物后来装饰在大厅墙上。

english:
Rutok stands near the eastern end of Pangong Tso in western Tibet, where a fortified hill rises above the surrounding plain. The old settlement clustered beneath its dzong, and local traditions remember the hill as the seat of an ancient ruler of Zhang Zhung. The lake and its neighbouring valleys placed Rutok close to the routes linking Tibet with Ladakh.

Rutok belonged to the Ladakhi sphere before the war between Ladakh and the Lhasa government in the late seventeenth century. The settlement passed to central Tibetan authority after the conflict. The 1684 agreement at Tingmosgang nevertheless preserved important trading ties: it reserved the wool trade of western Tibet to Ladakhis, while limiting access to Rudok to the Ladakhi court's own trader. Wool and pashmina continued to connect the two sides of the frontier.
simp_chinese:
日土位于西藏西部班公错东端附近，一座设防山丘耸立在平原之上，旧聚落依宗堡而建。当地传说将山丘视为古代象雄统治者的驻地。湖泊与邻近谷地靠近连接西藏和拉达克的道路，使日土处于两地往来的要冲。

十七世纪末拉达克与拉萨政府交战以前，日土属于拉达克势力范围；战后转归西藏中部政权。1684年廷莫斯冈协议仍保留重要的贸易联系：西藏西部羊毛贸易由拉达克人经营，而进入日土的拉达克商人仅限王室商人。羊毛和细软的帕什米纳羊绒继续联系边界两侧。

english:
Rutul stands in the upper Samur valley, among the mountains of southern Dagestan. Its inhabitants call the village Mykha; the name Rutul, used by neighbors and recorded by the fifteenth century, came to designate the people and their language. The village was the center of a union of mountain communities whose members lived along the Samur and its tributaries.

The communities of the valley guarded their independence amid the rivalries of surrounding powers. In 1536 Rutul attacked Akhty, then a stronghold of Safavid influence in southern Dagestan. Local rivalries continued into the eighteenth century, when Rutul and its neighbors fought over villages along the Samur. Arabic inscriptions and the remains of a minaret testify to the long presence of Islam in this mountain country.
simp_chinese:
鲁图尔坐落在达吉斯坦南部群山中的萨穆尔河上游河谷。当地人称村庄为米哈；邻人使用的“鲁图尔”之名至迟在十五世纪已有记载，后来也用来称呼这里的居民及其语言。村庄是一个山地社群联盟的中心，成员分布在萨穆尔河及其支流沿岸。

河谷社群在周边势力的竞争中维护自身独立。1536年，鲁图尔袭击了当时萨法维势力在达吉斯坦南部的据点阿赫特。地方争端延续至十八世纪，鲁图尔与邻人争夺萨穆尔河沿岸的村庄。阿拉伯文铭文和宣礼塔遗迹见证了伊斯兰教在这片山地的悠久历史。

english: The Ruvuma River reaches the Indian Ocean on the East African coast, where its estuary meets the waters around Mnazi Bay. Mangroves, mudflats and seagrass beds fringe the shore, while coral reefs and small islands lie farther out. River water and tides shape a varied coastal landscape, providing sheltered waters for fish and other marine life. The open ocean beyond connects the coast with the Comoros.
simp_chinese: 鲁伍马河在东非海岸注入印度洋，河口与姆纳济湾周围水域相接。红树林、泥滩和海草床分布岸边，更远处是珊瑚礁和小岛。河水与潮汐共同塑造多样海岸景观，为鱼类等海洋生物提供避护水域。湾外开阔大海将海岸与科摩罗群岛连接起来。

english: Rúxī was a fortified settlement west of Qīnzhōu, among the frontier communities near Đại Việt. A stockade of this name was recorded under the Song, and the Ming later maintained a patrol office in the district. In 1427 leaders of several frontier communities gave their allegiance to the Lê rulers of Đại Việt. Following negotiations with the Mạc court, the disputed districts were returned to Ming administration in 1540; several were then incorporated into Rúxī and neighbouring Tiēlàng.
simp_chinese: 如昔是钦州以西靠近大越边境的一处寨地。宋代已有如昔寨，明代又在当地设巡检司。宣德二年（1427年），边境数峒首领归附大越黎氏。明朝后来与莫氏朝廷交涉，嘉靖十九年（1540年）收回争议地区，并将部分峒地并入如昔及邻近的贴浪。

english: Ruyang was the seat of Runing Prefecture on the southern Henan plain, a place also remembered by the older name Runan. Its temples and bridges reflected its standing as a prefectural town. The Wuying Pagoda, a brick Buddhist tower, rose outside the western gate; a Ming inscription records that the princely house of Chong contributed money to rebuild it during the Longqing reign. A Confucian temple and stone bridges likewise formed part of the town's Ming landscape.
simp_chinese: 汝阳是豫南平原上的汝宁府治，此地也以汝南的旧名为人所知。城西有砖造佛塔悟颖塔，明代碑刻记载，崇王府在隆庆年间捐资重建此塔。文庙与石桥等建筑也构成了明代府城的景观。

sources.title: 汝南县各级文物保护单位列表

english: Ruydar lies inland from the Persian Gulf in the country north of Bandar Khamir. The surrounding district is a land of palms and rugged hills, with the heights of Kuh-e Shab nearby. Rock carvings found in this landscape bear witness to people who left their marks on its stone long before the present settlement. The mountains separate the inland valleys from the Gulf coast to the south.
simp_chinese: 鲁伊达尔位于波斯湾内陆、哈米尔港以北的地区。附近是棕榈树与崎岖山岭交错的土地，沙布山的高地也在不远处。当地发现的岩刻表明，早在今日聚落形成之前，就有人在这片土地的岩石上留下了印记。山岭把内陆河谷与南面的海湾海岸分隔开来。

english: Ruyuan lies in the Nanling mountains of northern Guangdong, a region where Yao communities have long lived among the ridges and valleys. The Guoshan Yao preserve a tradition of song used to communicate, tell stories and express affection. A poem written by the county magistrate Wu Bangjun in 1599 describes Yao people coming down from the hills in spring, recording an encounter between the county town and its mountain neighbours.
simp_chinese: 乳源位于广东北部南岭山区，瑶族社群长期居住在山岭与河谷之间。过山瑶以歌传情、叙事和交流，歌声是其文化的重要部分。1599年，知县吴邦俊在诗中记述瑶民春日下山的情景，留下县城与山中居民往来的一幅画面。

english:
Ruza stands on a high bank of the river of the same name, west of Moscow. The district appears in a will of Ivan Kalita, who left Ruza together with Zvenigorod and other lands to his son Ivan. Its fortified site formed part of the western approaches to the Muscovite lands.

Ruza belonged to the Zvenigorod principality and faced the wars that crossed Moscow’s western frontier. In 1618 its defenders withstood a siege by Polish-Lithuanian forces under Prince Władysław. The Resurrection Cathedral was built between 1714 and 1721. The town received district-town status in 1781. War returned in 1812 and left Ruza badly damaged; in the following years cloth and cotton spinning developed in the surrounding district as the town recovered from the devastation of the war.
simp_chinese:
鲁扎坐落在莫斯科以西的同名河高岸上。伊凡·卡利塔的一份遗嘱提到了这一地区，他将鲁扎、兹韦尼哥罗德等地留给儿子伊凡。这里的设防地点是莫斯科土地西方门户的一部分。

鲁扎属于兹韦尼哥罗德公国，曾面对越过莫斯科西部边境的战争。1618年，守军抵御了瓦迪斯瓦夫王子统率的波兰立陶宛军队围攻。1714至1721年，城中修建了复活主教座堂。1781年，鲁扎获得县城地位。1812年战争再次来到此地，城镇严重受损；之后周围地区的呢绒和棉纺业逐渐发展，城镇从战火的破坏中恢复。

english: Ruzayevka lies on the Insar near the mouth of the Pishlya, in the Mordvin country. The village arose on land granted in 1631 to the service noble Uraz Tonkacheyev and was first known as Urazayevka. In the eighteenth century it passed to the Struysky family. Its owner Nikolai Struysky established a printing press here in 1788, bringing book production to an estate far from the great cities of Russia.
simp_chinese: 鲁扎耶夫卡位于莫尔多瓦地区的因萨尔河畔，靠近皮什利亚河口。村庄兴起于1631年赐予服役贵族乌拉兹·通卡切耶夫的土地上，最初称乌拉扎耶夫卡。18世纪，它转归斯特鲁伊斯基家族。庄园主人尼古拉·斯特鲁伊斯基于1788年在此设立印刷所，使远离俄罗斯大城市的庄园也能印制书籍。

english:
Ryazan belongs to the Oka river world southeast of Moscow, where fertile land and routes toward the steppe gave the region longstanding political importance. The present city was formerly Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky; it took the name Ryazan in 1778. The older princely capital, now known as Old Ryazan, was a separate site devastated during the Mongol invasion.

During the later Middle Ages, Ryazan's rulers negotiated relationships with neighboring Russian princes and steppe powers, maintaining a distinct principality before Muscovite incorporation. Political consolidation changed administrative and military arrangements, tying local resources to a larger state. The region's frontier position brought raids, defensive obligations, and the need to secure river crossings. Early modern settlement and stronger central authority gradually transformed the balance between border defense and rural commerce. Ryazan's historical setting therefore combines princely inheritance with the growth of a Muscovite and Russian provincial society. Its fields, churches, and routes continued to sustain communities whose daily work was closely connected to wider struggles over security, revenue, and the consolidation of state power.
simp_chinese:
梁赞属于莫斯科东南奥卡河地区，肥沃土地和通向草原的道路赋予这里长期的政治重要性。今城原称佩列亚斯拉夫尔梁赞斯基，1778年改名梁赞。更早的公国都城位于另一处，即今旧梁赞遗址，曾在蒙古入侵时遭到破坏。

中世纪后期，梁赞统治者与邻近罗斯诸侯及草原势力协商，保持独立公国直到莫斯科纳入。政治巩固改变行政军事，让地方资源服务大国家。边疆位置带来袭击、防御义务及保护渡口需要。近世定居和中央加强，逐步调整边防商业平衡。梁赞的历史背景因此结合公国遗产与俄罗斯行省社会成长。田地、教堂和道路维持居民，日常劳动紧密参与安全、税收及国家巩固斗争。更大权威依靠地方生产，居民也通过市场制度与远方政治变化持续相连。

english: Ryazhsk stands on the Khupta in the southern Ryazan country. Its name belonged to an early sixteenth-century fortified post guarding a portage and the open approaches used by raiders from the steppe. After the first fortification was destroyed, a new fortress was built on the Khupta in 1557 under the voivode Mikhail Kolychev. During the Time of Troubles it was burned by Aleksander Lisowski's forces in 1608, and its defences were later rebuilt.
simp_chinese: 梁亚日斯克位于梁赞南部的胡普塔河畔。这个名字最初属于16世纪初的一处设防哨所，负责守卫拖船路和草原袭击者经过的开阔地带。最初的防御工事遭毁后，总督米哈伊尔·科雷乔夫于1557年在胡普塔河畔修筑新堡垒。动乱时期，亚历山大·利索夫斯基的部队于1608年焚毁堡垒，防御设施后来得到重建。

english: The Rybachy Peninsula projects into the Barents Sea at the western end of the Murman Coast. Its shores were used by seasonal fishing parties, and a station at Kegor became a meeting place for Russian and foreign merchants in the sixteenth century. Fishers came for the cod and herring of these northern waters, while traders exchanged goods brought by sea. Commerce later shifted towards Kola, but the peninsula remained part of the fishing network of the Murman coast.
simp_chinese: 雷巴奇半岛从摩尔曼海岸西端伸入巴伦支海。季节性渔队利用半岛海岸，十六世纪凯戈尔渔场成为俄罗斯与外国商人交易的地点。渔民前来捕捞北方水域的鳕鱼和鲱鱼，商人则交换经海路带来的货物。商业中心后来转向科拉，但半岛仍属于摩尔曼海岸的渔业网络。

english:
Rychbach, known in German as Reichenbach, stands on the Piława at the foot of the Owl Mountains. First recorded in 1258, the town belonged to several Piast-ruled duchies before passing to the Bohemian Crown in 1392. Its arms showed St George slaying the dragon, and the Knights Hospitaller established a school and hospital here in 1338.

In the sixteenth century Rychbach became a centre of the linen and textile trade. Epidemic and the Thirty Years' War brought hardship, including plunder by Swedish and Imperial troops in 1633 and 1634. An earlier epidemic in 1606 had already killed some two thousand people. The town became Prussian after the First Silesian War. In 1790 representatives of Austria, Prussia, Britain, Poland and the Dutch Republic met here to discuss the wars involving the Ottoman Empire.
simp_chinese:
雷赫巴赫的德语名为赖兴巴赫，坐落在猫头鹰山麓的皮瓦瓦河畔。城镇首次见于1258年的记载，曾属于几个皮雅斯特公国，1392年归入波希米亚王冠。城徽描绘圣乔治屠龙，医院骑士团于1338年在此创办学校和医院。

十六世纪，雷赫巴赫成为亚麻布和纺织品贸易中心。疫病和三十年战争给城镇带来苦难，瑞典军队与帝国军队分别于1633年和1634年劫掠此地。更早的1606年，疫病已夺去约两千人的生命。第一次西里西亚战争后，城镇归属普鲁士。1790年，奥地利、普鲁士、英国、波兰和荷兰共和国的代表在此会晤，商议与奥斯曼帝国有关的战争。

english: Ryfylke is a landscape of islands, fjords and steep mountains on Norway's southwestern coast. Farms occupy the sheltered shores and valleys, with higher ground rising sharply behind them. At Årdal a timber church was built in 1619 and enlarged during the following century. Its painted walls and ceiling, completed in 1703, surround an altarpiece dating from 1633.
simp_chinese: 里菲尔克位于挪威西南海岸，由岛屿、峡湾和陡峭山岭组成。农庄坐落在受掩护的岸边和谷地，后方则是急剧升高的山地。奥达尔于1619年建起一座木教堂，此后一个世纪中不断扩建。1703年绘成的墙面和天花板环绕着一座1633年的祭坛装饰。

english: Rykuul lies in the country south of the Anadyr estuary, near the coast of Anadyr Gulf. Pebble and sand spits run along this shore, enclosing lagoons such as Tymna. The Tumanskaya River crosses the lowland to reach that lagoon and the Bering Sea.
simp_chinese: 雷库尔位于阿纳德尔河口以南、阿纳德尔湾沿岸附近。卵石和沙嘴沿海岸延伸，围成季姆纳等潟湖；图曼斯卡亚河穿过低地流向季姆纳潟湖与白令海。

english:
Rylsk lies in the Seym river country of the wider Severian region, where cultivated land, woodland, and routes across the eastern European frontier supported settlement. A defensible position and access to nearby agricultural resources helped sustain the town. River valleys connected communities and supplied food, while markets brought together rural produce and manufactured goods. The same routes that encouraged exchange could also expose settlements to the movement of armies and raiding forces.

Rylsk became the seat of a principality and later came under Lithuanian rule. Around 1500 its allegiance shifted toward Moscow, though accounts differ on the details of that transition. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries its fortress formed part of the southern defensive frontier. During the Time of Troubles, Rylsk supported False Dmitry I and resisted a siege by tsarist forces in 1605.
simp_chinese:
雷利斯克位于谢韦里亚更广地区的谢伊姆河一带，耕地、林地与穿越东欧边疆的道路支持定居。便于防御的位置和附近农业资源，帮助城镇维持生活。河谷连接社群并提供食物，市场汇聚乡村产品与手工业品。同样的道路促进交换，也可能让聚落暴露于军队和袭掠力量的移动。

雷利斯克曾是一个分封公国的中心，后来归立陶宛统治。约1500年，其归属转向莫斯科，但相关经过的记载存在分歧。十六至十七世纪，当地堡垒构成南部防御边疆的一部分。动乱时期，雷利斯克支持伪德米特里一世，并于1605年抵御沙皇军队的围攻。

english: The Ryn, or Naryn sands, stretch across the northern Caspian lowland between the Volga and the Ural. Dunes and sandy ridges alternate with hollows and patches of steppe pasture. In 1801 Sultan Bokei and families of the Lesser Zhuz were allowed to cross the Ural into the lands between the rivers. The Naryn sands became part of the pastures of the Inner Horde, whose herders also used the reed beds and floodplains nearer the Caspian coast.
simp_chinese: 雷恩沙地又称纳伦沙地，横贯伏尔加河与乌拉尔河之间的里海低地北部。沙丘和沙脊与洼地、草原牧场交错分布。1801年，布凯苏丹及小玉兹的家庭获准渡过乌拉尔河，进入两河之间的土地。纳伦沙地成为内帐汗国的牧场之一，牧民也利用更靠近里海海岸的芦苇地和泛滥平原。

english:
Ryn stands between Lakes Ryn and Ołów in the Masurian lake country. A substantial Teutonic castle rose on an older Prussian fortified site, and by the late fourteenth century onwards it was the seat of an Order commander, whose district was restored after the peace of 1466. The settlement below it was recorded in 1405; from the fifteenth century its inhabitants were mostly Polish.

Tatar raiders burned Ryn in 1657 and carried away many inhabitants. Plague followed in 1709–1711, yet the settlement remained an administrative centre for its rural district. Frederick William I granted it a town charter in 1723, when church services were held in Polish. Beneath the castle, a channel linked the lakes with the pond of a mill established by the Order.
simp_chinese:
雷恩位于马祖里亚湖区的雷恩湖与奥乌夫湖之间。条顿骑士团城堡建在更早的普鲁士防御据点上，十四世纪末成为骑士团指挥官的驻地，其辖区在1466年和约后得到恢复。城堡下的聚落见于1405年的记载，从十五世纪起居民大多为波兰人。

1657年，鞑靼袭击者焚毁雷恩并掳走许多居民。1709至1711年瘟疫接踵而至，但聚落仍是周围乡村的行政中心。1723年，腓特烈·威廉一世授予它城市特许，当时教堂礼拜使用波兰语。城堡下方的水道将湖泊与骑士团建造的磨坊池塘连接起来。

english: Rynda Bay lies along the western shore of the Sea of Japan, where the mountains of the Sikhote-Alin approach the coast. This shore is marked by small bays enclosed between rocky headlands, with forests covering the hills behind them. Farther south lies Olga Bay, another sheltered inlet on the same coast. The cold sea and the wooded mountains together shape this northern stretch of the coast.
simp_chinese: 伦达湾位于日本海西岸，锡霍特山脉在此靠近海边。这段海岸的小海湾被岩石岬角环抱，后方丘陵覆盖着森林。更南面是同一海岸上的另一处受庇护的海湾，即奥尔加湾。寒冷海水与林木覆盖的山地共同构成这段北方海岸的景观。

english: Rypin lies in Dobrzyń Land, east of Toruń. Its earlier stronghold stood at Starorypin, north of the later town, and served as a castellan's seat from the eleventh century. A Teutonic raid destroyed the original settlement in 1329, after which the town was established anew at its present site. The Piast dukes founded a hospital in memory of Duke Siemowit of Dobrzyń; in 1352 Duke Władysław the Hunchback granted it privileges. Rypin also lay on a trading route between Toruń and Brześć.
simp_chinese: 雷平位于托伦以东的多布任地区。早期据点位于后来城镇以北的旧雷平，从十一世纪起便是城堡长官驻地。1329年条顿骑士团的袭击摧毁了原聚落，城镇随后在新址重建。皮雅斯特王朝公爵为纪念多布任公爵谢莫维特创办医院；1352年，驼背公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫授予医院特权。雷平还位于连接托伦与布热希奇的贸易道路上。

english: Ryrkaypiy stands on a headland of the Chukchi Sea opposite Wrangel Island. Its Chukchi name refers to a walrus haul-out, recalling the marine animals that come to this Arctic shore. In 1791 Joseph Billings recorded the settlement during an overland journey by dog sled from Mechigmen Bay toward Chaun Bay. The coast and surrounding tundra supported both marine hunters and reindeer herders.
simp_chinese: 雷尔卡伊皮位于楚科奇海的岬角上，与弗兰格尔岛隔海相望。其楚科奇语名称意为海象栖息地，令人想起来到这片北极海岸的海兽。1791年，约瑟夫·比林斯乘狗拉雪橇从梅奇格门湾向恰翁湾作陆上旅行时，记录了这处聚落。海岸与周围苔原同时支持海兽猎人和驯鹿牧民的生活。

english: Yrytkuč'yn lies near the southern shore of Chaun Bay, where rivers reach the East Siberian Sea through a low tundra landscape. The name of the nearby Rytkuchi River has been translated as a shooter and linked to a remembered battle between Chukchi and mounted strangers. Reindeer herders moved across the surrounding country, whose rivers and marshes freeze during the long Arctic winter.
simp_chinese: 雷特库奇位于恰翁湾南岸附近，河流穿过低缓苔原，注入东西伯利亚海。附近雷特库奇河的名称被译作射手，与一场传说中楚科奇人和骑马外来者之间的战斗有关。驯鹿牧民在周围地区迁徙，河流和沼泽在漫长的北极冬季封冻。

english:
Rzeszów lies on the Wisłok River and received town rights in 1354. Trade routes connecting Kraków with Lwów and Lublin with the south helped the town recover from fires and attacks in the fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries. Jewish settlement is recorded from the fifteenth century.

From the 1580s its owner Mikołaj Spytek Ligęza invested in a castle, Bernardine church and monastery. The town passed to the Lubomirski family in 1638, and a college opened in 1658. Swedish and other armies damaged Rzeszów during later wars; after the first partition of Poland in 1772 it came under Austrian rule in Galicia.
simp_chinese:
热舒夫位于维斯沃克河畔，1354年获得城镇权利。连接克拉科夫与利沃夫、卢布林与南方的贸易路线，帮助城镇从15世纪及16世纪初的火灾和袭击中恢复。犹太人在此定居可追溯到15世纪。

1580年代起，镇主米科瓦伊·斯皮泰克·利根扎投资修建城堡、伯尔纳铎会教堂和修道院。1638年城镇转入卢博米尔斯基家族之手，1658年开设学院。后来的战争中，瑞典等军队破坏了热舒夫；1772年波兰第一次被瓜分后，它进入奥地利统治下的加利西亚。

english: Rzhavets lies in the wooded upper Oka country between Kozelsk and Odoyev. These lands once belonged to small principalities descended from the Chernigov rulers. In the sixteenth century the forest itself became part of Moscow’s southern defences: felled trees and guarded passages formed barriers against raids, while garrisons occupied nearby fortresses. The valleys and woods around Rzhavets lay within this wider frontier landscape.
simp_chinese: 勒扎韦茨位于科泽利斯克与奥多耶夫之间的奥卡河上游林区。这里曾属于出自切尔尼戈夫统治家族的小公国。十六世纪，森林本身成为莫斯科南方防御的一部分：倒木和受守卫的通道构成抵御袭击的障垒，驻军则占据附近堡垒。勒扎韦茨周围的河谷与树林属于这片更广阔的边疆地带。

english:
Rzhev stands on the upper Volga in western Russia. A chronicle mentions it in 1216 during a siege, and its position on river routes gave it both commercial and defensive importance. During the Time of Troubles, the town faced renewed fighting; in 1613 its defenders repelled an attack led by Aleksander Lisowski.

River commerce and local crafts continued to shape the town. After the Vyshny Volochyok water system was built in the eighteenth century, Rzhev became a transshipment point on the route toward Saint Petersburg. Administrative reform made it a district town in the Tver governorate in the 1770s.
simp_chinese:
勒热夫位于俄罗斯西部伏尔加河上游。编年史在1216年记载了对它的一次围攻；河路上的位置赋予城镇商业与防御价值。动乱时期这里再次遭遇战争，1613年守军击退了利索夫斯基率领的一次进攻。

河运贸易和地方手工业持续塑造城镇。18世纪维什尼沃洛乔克水系建成后，勒热夫成为通往圣彼得堡水路上的转运点。1770年代的行政改革使它成为特维尔省的一座县城。

english: Rzheva Pustaya was a centre of the Rzheva district on the frontier between the Novgorod and Lithuanian lands. Its name, meaning Empty Rzheva, distinguished it from the town of Rzhev on the upper Volga. Ivan III's testament named it among the Novgorod possessions left to his son Vasily. In 1536 the government founded the fortress of Zavolochye on the Lithuanian frontier and ordered the people of Rzheva moved there. Much later, in 1777, a new district town called Novorzhev was established on the Sorot road.
simp_chinese: 勒热夫普斯塔亚曾是诺夫哥罗德与立陶宛土地交界处勒热夫地区的中心。其名称意为“空勒热夫”，用以区别伏尔加河上游的勒热夫城。伊凡三世的遗嘱将它列入留给儿子瓦西里的诺夫哥罗德领地。1536年，政府在立陶宛边境建立扎沃洛奇耶堡垒，并下令将勒热夫居民迁往那里。很久之后的1777年，一座名为新勒热夫的县城在索罗季河道路上建立。

english: S’awdáan lies among the steep, forested shores and glacial waters of the mainland coast east of Stephens Passage. Its Tlingit name is associated with the jade-like colour of the bay. The people of S’awdáan belonged to a coastal world of villages, fishing places and canoe routes, with clans holding names and ties to particular lands. Inland, glaciers descend through the mountains towards the narrow arms of the sea.
simp_chinese: 索丹位于斯蒂芬斯水道以东的大陆海岸，周围是陡峭森林岸地与冰川融水。其特林吉特名称与海湾如玉般的颜色有关。索丹人生活在由村庄、渔场和独木舟航线构成的沿海世界中，氏族拥有各自的名称，并与特定土地相联系。内陆冰川从群山间向狭长海湾下降。

english: The southern Cardamom Hills rise above the lowlands of Travancore in the Western Ghats. Heavy monsoon rain feeds forest streams and sustains evergreen woodland on their slopes. Cardamom grows in the shade of these moist uplands, its fragrant pods valued in the spice trade of the Malabar coast. The Pamba flows west from the hill country, and the forested mountains include Sabarimala, a shrine associated with Ayyappa and the royal family of Pandalam.
simp_chinese: 小豆蔻山南段在特拉凡哥尔低地上方升起，属于西高止山脉。丰沛季风雨滋养山间溪流和常绿森林。小豆蔻生长在湿润高地的林荫中，其芬芳果荚在马拉巴尔海岸香料贸易中受到重视。潘巴河从山地向西流去；森林覆盖的山间还有萨巴里马拉神庙，与阿伊亚帕及潘达拉姆王室的传统相联系。

english: The Syezzhaya is a left-bank tributary of the Samara in the country southeast of the Volga. Its tributaries include the Kalmanka and, closer to the mouth, the Vetlyanka. One explanation of its name recalls boats drifting down the river to the Samara and onward to the Volga. The river crosses a landscape of open rolling plains cut by gullies and valleys, joining a larger watercourse that runs westward toward Samara on the Volga.
simp_chinese: 谢兹扎亚河是伏尔加河东南地区的一条河流，从左岸汇入萨马拉河。它的支流包括卡尔曼卡河以及靠近河口的韦特良卡河。关于河名的一种解释，使人想起小船顺流而下进入萨马拉河，再驶往伏尔加河。这条河穿过沟壑纵横的开阔起伏平原，汇入向西流向伏尔加河畔萨马拉的大河。

english: The peaks of Sylan rise on the mountain frontier between Jämtland and Trøndelag. Their ridges and valleys form part of a much wider highland landscape used by Sámi communities, whose customary lands extended across what became the Norwegian–Swedish border. Reindeer herding and seasonal movement made use of pastures at different elevations. The transfer of Jämtland to Sweden in 1645 placed a new political boundary through a region already traversed by its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 叙拉纳山群峰耸立在耶姆特兰与特伦德拉格之间的山地边界上。山脊与谷地属于一片更广阔的高地，萨米社群的传统土地横跨后来形成的挪威与瑞典边境。驯鹿放牧和季节性迁徙利用不同海拔的牧场。1645年耶姆特兰转归瑞典，使一条新的政治边界穿过居民早已往来的地区。

english: The Nallamala Hills extend between the Krishna and Pennar rivers, forming a long section of the Eastern Ghats. Forested ridges and gorges shelter sacred places such as Ahobilam, where temples honour Narasimha, the lion-headed form of Vishnu. Its shrines received gifts from the Kakatiya and Reddi dynasties and later from the rulers of Vijayanagara; Krishnadevaraya visited them in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 纳拉马拉山脉在克里希纳河与彭纳河之间延伸，构成东高止山脉的一段长岭。林木覆盖的山脊与峡谷间有阿霍比拉姆等圣地，那里的神庙供奉毗湿奴的狮首化身那罗辛诃。卡卡提亚和雷迪王朝曾向圣祠捐赠，后来毗奢耶那伽罗统治者也予以赞助；克里希纳德瓦拉亚于十六世纪亲临礼拜。

english: The Shuswap highlands are a country of wooded mountains, long valleys and lakes in the interior of the Pacific Northwest. Their streams feed the waterways of Secwépemc country, from the Shuswap lakes toward the Columbia. Eastern Secwépemc communities travelled and used lands across these valleys and uplands, maintaining connections with the Columbia's great bend and its headwaters. Salmon returning from the ocean reached the river systems of this inland country, linking mountain waters to the distant Pacific.
simp_chinese: 舒斯瓦普高地位于太平洋西北内陆，由森林山地、长谷与湖泊组成。山间溪流汇入塞克韦佩姆克地区的水系，从舒斯瓦普诸湖一直延伸到哥伦比亚河。东部塞克韦佩姆克社群往来于这些河谷与高地，利用当地土地，也与哥伦比亚河大弯及其上游保持联系。从大洋洄游的鲑鱼抵达这片内陆的水系，将山间河流同遥远的太平洋连接起来。

english: Sa Kaeo lies in the eastern Thai lowlands, between the wooded hills and the routes leading towards Cambodia. In the wider region stands Sdok Kok Thom, a Khmer sanctuary dedicated to Shiva. Its sandstone walls and towers enclosed a religious foundation served by a family of priests. A long inscription dated to the eleventh century recounts their service to Khmer kings over many generations, preserving a remarkable account of royal ritual and the early history of the Khmer court.
simp_chinese: 沙缴位于泰国东部低地，处在林木覆盖的丘陵与通往柬埔寨的道路之间。更广阔的地区内有供奉湿婆的高棉圣地斯多克高通。砂岩围墙与塔殿环绕着这座宗教建筑，一支祭司家族世代在此服务。十一世纪的一篇长碑铭记述了他们多代侍奉高棉国王的经历，留下有关王室仪式和高棉宫廷早期历史的重要记载。

english: Sa‘a lies at the southern end of Malaita, where the island narrows towards the small island of Maramasike. The Sa‘a language is spoken in this part of the Solomon Islands, among coastal and inland communities linked by paths and canoe routes. Forested slopes rise behind the shores, while the waters to the south lead towards Makira and Ulawa.
simp_chinese: 萨阿位于马莱塔南端，岛屿在此变窄，通向马拉马西凯小岛。萨阿语分布在所罗门群岛这一带，沿海与内陆社群通过小径和独木舟航路相连。森林山坡在海岸后方升起，南面水域则通向马基拉与乌拉瓦。

english: Saadatabad lies northeast of Sirjan on the road towards Kerman. A caravanserai near the village served travellers on this route between the interior and southern Iran. Its architecture belongs chiefly to the Qajar period, when traffic between the country's northern and southern regions gave the road importance. The fortified inn offered a place for caravans to halt before continuing across the dry Sirjan plain and the hills beyond.
simp_chinese: 萨达塔巴德位于锡尔詹东北、通往克尔曼的道路上。村庄附近的一座商队旅舍服务于往来内陆与伊朗南部的旅人。其建筑主要属于卡扎尔时期，当时伊朗南北之间的交通使这条道路具有重要地位。商队可在设防旅舍停留，随后继续穿越干燥的锡尔詹平原及前方丘陵。

english:
Saadatshahr lies near the plain of Pasargadae in northern Fars. Here Cyrus the Great founded the first dynastic capital of the Achaemenid empire in the sixth century BCE. Palaces and gardens spread across the plain, while his stone tomb stands apart on a stepped base beneath a pitched roof. The buildings brought together techniques and artistic traditions from lands under Persian rule.

In the medieval period the tomb was known as the grave of Solomon's mother. A mosque was built around it using columns taken from the ancient palaces, giving the monument a new sacred identity. The old royal city had long since passed from use, but its stone remains continued to stand in the valley and attract the attention of travellers crossing Fars.
simp_chinese:
萨阿达特沙赫尔位于法尔斯北部帕萨尔加德平原附近。公元前六世纪，居鲁士大帝在此创建阿契美尼德帝国的首座王朝都城。宫殿和园林散布在平原上，居鲁士的石墓独立于阶梯基座之上，顶部为斜屋顶。建筑汇集波斯统治下各地的技艺与艺术传统。

中世纪时，这座陵墓被称作所罗门母亲之墓。人们用古代宫殿的柱子在墓旁建造清真寺，赋予纪念建筑新的神圣身份。古老王城早已不再使用，但石造遗迹仍留在谷地，吸引穿越法尔斯的旅人注意。

english: Saaka is associated with the Esaaka-speaking communities of northern Mozambique, whose language belongs to the Makhuwa group. Their country extends across the hills and valleys inland from the Indian Ocean, around the lower Lurio and the coast near Memba. Farming communities occupy clearings among woodland, and family descent has traditionally followed the female line, linking households through enduring ties of kinship.
simp_chinese: 萨卡与莫桑比克北部讲埃萨卡语的社群有关，其语言属于马夸语群。居民的土地横跨印度洋内陆的丘陵和山谷，包括卢里奥河下游与门巴附近海岸。农耕社群居住在林地间的空地，家族血统传统上通过母系追溯，以持久的亲属关系连接各个家庭。

english: Saakak'hukaahaanu lies near the great bend of the Souris, or Mouse River, in the northern plains. Here the river turns north through low meadows and wooded bottomlands toward Canada. In the winter of 1797–98 the trader and surveyor David Thompson travelled from the Mouse River to the Mandan villages, recording observations on his journey. His survey helped map a region already crossed by Indigenous travel and trade.
simp_chinese: 萨卡克胡卡哈努靠近北方平原上苏里斯河的大弯，苏里斯河又称鼠河。河水在这里转向北方，穿过低地草甸与河谷林地，流往加拿大。1797至1798年冬，商人与测量员戴维·汤普森从鼠河前往曼丹村落，沿途记录观察。当地原住民早已在这一地区旅行和贸易，汤普森的测绘则为绘制地图提供了资料。

english:
Saalfeld stands on the Saale in Thuringia. A Benedictine abbey founded by Archbishop Anno of Cologne in 1071 became an important ecclesiastical centre, while the town grew beneath imperial and later noble authority. Mines in the surrounding country, river transport on the Saale and fishing supported its economy. In 1389 Landgrave Balthasar of Thuringia acquired Saalfeld for the Wettin dynasty.

The abbey was destroyed during the Peasants' War, and the Reformation dissolved the Franciscan monastery. After the division of Wettin lands, Saalfeld passed through several Ernestine duchies. From 1677 a new palace rose on the abbey's site and became the residence of the line later known as Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The ducal court subsequently moved its principal residence to Coburg, and in 1826 Saalfeld passed to Saxe-Meiningen.
simp_chinese:
萨尔费尔德位于图林根的萨勒河畔。科隆大主教安诺于1071年创办的本笃会修道院成为重要的教会中心，城镇则先后在帝国和贵族统治下发展。周围的矿山、萨勒河上的运输和渔业支持当地经济。1389年，图林根领地伯巴尔塔萨为韦廷王朝取得萨尔费尔德。

农民战争期间，修道院遭到毁坏，宗教改革又使方济各会修道院解散。韦廷领地分封后，萨尔费尔德先后归于多个恩斯特支系公国。自1677年起，一座新宫殿在修道院旧址上兴建，成为后来称为萨克森—科堡—萨尔费尔德的家族支系驻地。宫廷随后迁往科堡，1826年萨尔费尔德归于萨克森—迈宁根。

english:
Saalfelden lies in the Pinzgau of the eastern Alps, where a relatively open basin provides farmland beneath steep mountain walls. Routes through the valley connected local settlements with Salzburg and neighbouring Alpine districts. Livestock, hay meadows and limited arable cultivation supported rural households, while a market centre brought together farmers, craftsmen and travellers. The surrounding mountains supplied timber and pasture but also imposed seasonal limits on movement.

Saalfelden was mentioned as a market place by the mid-fourteenth century. In 1418 its court administration was joined to that of Lichtenberg Castle. Under the prince-archbishops of Salzburg, the market town's fortunes changed as trade routes shifted. A fire destroyed much of the market settlement in 1811, and Salzburg passed to Austria in 1816 after a period of Bavarian rule.
simp_chinese:
萨尔费尔登位于东阿尔卑斯山的平茨高地区，较开阔盆地在陡峭山壁下提供农田。河谷道路把聚落连接到萨尔茨堡及邻近山区。牲畜、割草地和有限耕地支持乡村家庭，市场中心则汇集农民、工匠与旅人。周围山地供应木材和牧场，也使人员流动受到季节限制，居民需要在不同高度环境之间安排生产。

十四世纪中叶，萨尔费尔登已作为集镇见于记载。1418年，当地法院的管理与利希滕贝格城堡合并。在萨尔茨堡亲王大主教统治下，贸易路线变化影响了集镇的兴衰。1811年大火毁坏了集镇大部分建筑；萨尔茨堡经过一段巴伐利亚统治后，于1816年归入奥地利。

english: Saamis is the Blackfoot word associated with Medicine Hat, on the South Saskatchewan River. It refers to the feathered headdress of a medicine person and is remembered in stories about the place. The river valley cuts through the dry prairie of southeastern Alberta, where a sheltered bend and its tributaries offered a meeting place for people travelling across the plains. Nearby archaeological remains attest to long Indigenous occupation of the valley.
simp_chinese: 萨米斯是与南萨斯喀彻温河畔梅迪辛哈特有关的黑脚语词，指医者佩戴的羽饰头冠，并出现在有关此地的故事中。河谷切穿艾伯塔东南部干燥草原，避风河湾及支流为横穿平原的人们提供会合之地。附近考古遗存见证原住民长期在河谷居住。

english:
Saanen lies in an Alpine valley crossed by mule trails towards Vaud and the Valais. First recorded in 1228 as Gissinay, it belonged to the county of Gruyère. The counts' financial difficulties allowed the inhabitants to buy some of their rights in the fourteenth century. Saanen became a market centre for the surrounding farming communities, whose livelihoods included seasonal mountain grazing, forestry and services for travellers crossing the passes.

The valley concluded agreements with its neighbours and made its own alliance with Bern in 1403. Its soldiers fought under their own banner in Bernese campaigns, though disputes over taxes and military losses later set Saanen against Bern. In 1555 the last count of Gruyère lost the district through bankruptcy; Bern took over the valley and introduced the Reformation the following year. A great fire destroyed much of Saanen in 1575, prompting the Bernese bailiff to move his residence elsewhere.
simp_chinese:
萨嫩位于阿尔卑斯谷地，通往沃州和瓦莱的骡道从此经过。1228年的文献首次将它记作吉西奈，当时它属于格吕耶尔伯国。十四世纪，伯爵的财政困难使居民得以购得部分权利。萨嫩成为周围农业社群的市场中心，居民以季节性山地放牧、林业以及为翻越山口的旅人提供服务维生。

谷地与邻近社群订立协议，并于1403年自行与伯尔尼结盟。萨嫩士兵在伯尔尼的战役中使用自己的旗帜，但税赋和军事损失引起的争端后来使谷地与伯尔尼发生对立。1555年，最后一位格吕耶尔伯爵破产，失去这一地区；次年伯尔尼接管谷地并推行宗教改革。1575年的大火摧毁萨嫩的大部分建筑，伯尔尼行政官因此将驻地迁往别处。

english:
Around the Saanich Peninsula and the neighbouring islands, W̱SÁNEĆ fishers used the reef net, or SX̱OLE, to catch migrating salmon. Set at places where fish passed through narrow waters, the net imitated the sea floor. W̱SÁNEĆ tradition tells of a young man who made the first net from willow bark and taught the people to use it; he was understood to be a salmon spirit in human form.

The later city of Victoria lies here.
simp_chinese:
在萨尼奇半岛和附近岛屿一带，W̱SÁNEĆ渔民使用称为SX̱OLE的礁网捕捉洄游鲑鱼。渔网设在鱼群通过的狭水道，布置得仿佛海底。W̱SÁNEĆ传统讲述，一位年轻人以柳树皮制成第一张网，教人们使用；人们认为他是化为人形的鲑鱼精灵。

后来的维多利亚即位于此地。

sources.title: WSANEC Stories ALL COMBINED REVIEW 02March2022 WLC SMJ.pdf

english: Saanyaa Kwáan, the people of the southern country, lived around Cape Fox and the waterways northwards towards the Unuk River. Their country offered salmon, eulachon and halibut as well as game and plants gathered inland. Among their clans were the Teikweidí, whose crest stories include that of the hunter Kaats’ and his grizzly bear wife. Carved house posts could make such ancestral stories visible at the village.
simp_chinese: 萨尼亚宽意为南方之民，他们居住在福克斯角及向北通往乌努克河的水域一带。这片土地出产鲑鱼、油烛鱼和大比目鱼，内陆还有猎物与可采集的植物。当地氏族之一的泰克韦迪人有关于猎人卡茨与灰熊妻子的纹章故事；村庄房屋的雕柱让这样的祖先故事呈现在众人面前。

english:
Saarbrücken grew on the Saar beneath a castle first recorded in 999, when Emperor Otto III granted it to the bishops of Metz. A county took shape around the stronghold, and in 1321 or 1322 Count Johann I granted town status both to Saarbrücken and to the fishing village of Saint Johann across the river. The two communities shared an administration. From 1381 the counts of Nassau-Saarbrücken became the principal rulers of the area.

A stone bridge joined the two banks in the sixteenth century, and Count Ludwig II later rebuilt the castle as a Renaissance residence. The Thirty Years' War devastated Saarbrücken; in 1677 French troops burned almost the whole town. The eighteenth century brought renewal under Prince William Henry, who took the coal mines into public ownership and sponsored new buildings. Architect Friedrich Joachim Stengel shaped the residence with Baroque churches, a town hall and a river crane. French revolutionary troops took Saarbrücken in 1793, and the county was annexed to France. Following Napoleon's defeat, the town passed to Prussia in 1815. Its coalfields and its position on the Saar remained central to the region's development.
simp_chinese:
萨尔布吕肯兴起于萨尔河畔的一座城堡下。城堡首次见于999年的文献，当时皇帝奥托三世将它赠予梅斯主教。堡垒周围形成一个伯国；1321或1322年，伯爵约翰一世同时授予萨尔布吕肯和河对岸渔村圣约翰城市地位，两个社区共同管理。自1381年起，拿骚—萨尔布吕肯伯爵成为当地的主要统治者。

十六世纪，一座石桥连接了两岸；伯爵路德维希二世后来将城堡改建为文艺复兴式宫邸。三十年战争重创萨尔布吕肯，1677年法军又几乎烧毁全城。十八世纪，威廉·海因里希亲王将煤矿收归公有，资助新建筑，城市迎来复兴。建筑师弗里德里希·约阿希姆·施滕格尔设计了巴洛克式教堂、市政厅和河岸起重机，塑造了这座驻地的面貌。1793年，法国革命军攻占萨尔布吕肯，伯国被并入法国。拿破仑战败后，城市于1815年归属普鲁士。煤田与萨尔河上的位置继续影响着地区的发展。

english:
Saarburg stands on the Saar upstream from its junction with the Moselle. A castle above the river was established in the tenth century, and the settlement below received town rights from King Rudolf in 1291. The archbishops of Trier made the castle and town part of their territorial network. A mill on the diverted Leuk stream supplied an additional source of revenue in the fourteenth century.

The castle and town experienced conflict on the western frontier: French troops captured and damaged the castle in 1673, and occupied town and castle again from 1705 to 1714. A bell foundry was operating in Saarburg by the 1770s. During the French period the town became the seat of a canton, before passing to Prussia after 1815.
simp_chinese:
萨尔堡位于萨尔河畔、摩泽尔河汇合处的上游。河上方的城堡建于10世纪，堡下聚落于1291年获得国王鲁道夫授予的城镇权。特里尔大主教将城堡和城镇纳入其领地网络；14世纪，引入镇内的洛伊克溪上的磨坊提供了额外收入。

城堡和城镇经历了西部边境的战争：法国军队于1673年攻占并损坏城堡，1705至1714年再次占领城镇和城堡。1770年代，萨尔堡已有铸钟作坊。法国统治时期它成为县区行政中心，1815年后归属普鲁士。

english: Saarde is a parish in the forested country south of Pärnu, near the old Livonian lands of Metsepole. Its church served a scattered rural community whose history reached back to the conversion of the region during the northern crusades. After the Livonian War, Christian Schrapfer, once a preacher at the court of Duke Magnus, served Saarde alongside several neighbouring parishes. In 1789 fire destroyed the parsonage and its church books. The pastor Voigdt gathered recollections and reconstructed lists of people and events, preserving some of the parish's history after the loss.
simp_chinese: 萨尔代是派尔努以南林地中的教区，靠近古老的利沃尼亚梅策波莱地区。当地教堂服务于分散的乡村社区，其历史可追溯至北方十字军时期这一带的基督教化。利沃尼亚战争后，曾在马格努斯公爵宫廷讲道的克里斯蒂安·施拉普费尔兼任萨尔代及几个邻近教区的牧师。1789年，一场火灾烧毁牧师住宅和教会簿册。牧师福格特收集旧日回忆，重建人物和事件的名录，在文书损失后保存了部分教区历史。

english: Saarijärvi lies among the lakes and forests of central Finland. In the sixteenth century the district formed part of the great inland parishes; a chapel was established at Palvasalmi in 1628 and an independent parish followed in 1639. The name Saarijärvi became established around 1690. A second church was built in 1694, but Russian troops burned the chaplain's residence during the Great Northern War in 1714.
simp_chinese: 萨里耶尔维位于芬兰中部的湖泊和森林之间。16世纪，这片地区属于广大的内陆教区；1628年帕尔瓦萨尔米设立礼拜堂，1639年成为独立教区，萨里耶尔维之名约在1690年固定下来。第二座教堂建于1694年，但大北方战争期间，俄军于1714年烧毁了牧师住宅。

english: Saarijoki lies in the wooded lake country of Karelia, west of Vygozero. The Segezha River carries water from Segozero toward Vygozero, while the Upper Vyg and Vozhma also feed the lake. The Lower Vyg flows onward toward the White Sea, linking this chain of inland lakes and rivers with the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 萨里约基位于卡累利阿森林湖区，在维戈泽罗湖以西。谢盖扎河将塞戈泽罗湖的水送往维戈泽罗湖，上维格河与沃日马河也注入湖中。下维格河继续流向白海，把这一串内陆湖泊和河流与北方海岸连接起来。

english: Saarwerden stands on the Saar, in a district once ruled by the counts who took their name from the place. The county passed to the house of Nassau in 1527, and Count Adolf introduced the Reformation after the Peace of Augsburg. Its inheritance was disputed between Nassau and Lorraine. In 1629 a judgment awarded Saarwerden and neighbouring Bouquenom to Lorraine, while the remainder of the county stayed with Nassau.
simp_chinese: 萨尔韦尔登坐落在萨尔河畔，这一地区曾由以此地为名的伯爵统治。1527年，伯国转入拿骚家族之手；奥格斯堡和约之后，阿道夫伯爵在此推行宗教改革。拿骚与洛林对继承权的争执持续不休，1629年的判决将萨尔韦尔登及邻近的布克农判给洛林，伯国其余部分则留在拿骚手中。

english: Saba lies on the southern coast of Suō, around the old provincial centre of Hōfu. Its Tenmangū shrine was an important place of worship under the Ōuchi lords, who held power across western Japan. Ōuchi Hiroyo rebuilt its buildings in the fourteenth century, and Ōuchi Yoshitaka undertook another rebuilding in 1530. Gifts of land and revenue supported rituals at the shrine, binding local worship to the fortunes of the ruling house.
simp_chinese: 佐波位于周防南岸，环绕古代国府所在的防府。当地天满宫在统治日本西部广大地区的大内氏时代是重要祭祀场所。大内弘世在十四世纪重建神社建筑，大内义隆又于1530年加以重修。土地和收入的捐赠支持了神社仪式，也使地方信仰与统治家族的兴衰相连。

english: Šabac stands on the southern bank of the Sava, at the edge of the fertile Mačva plain. A medieval settlement called Zaslon stood here before the Ottoman conquest. In 1470 the Ottomans built a fortress they called Böğürdelen; King Matthias Corvinus of Hungary captured it six years later, and it remained Hungarian until 1521. The town changed hands repeatedly in the Habsburg–Ottoman wars. Returned to Ottoman rule in 1739, it grew as a market on the imperial frontier. During the First Serbian Uprising, Karađorđe's forces defeated an Ottoman army near Mišar in 1806. After the Second Uprising, Šabac became part of the autonomous Serbian principality, where Jevrem Obrenović established his residence and encouraged new institutions.
simp_chinese: 沙巴茨位于萨瓦河南岸，靠近肥沃的马奇瓦平原。奥斯曼征服之前，这里有一座名为扎斯隆的中世纪聚落。1470年，奥斯曼人修筑堡垒，称之为伯于尔代伦；六年后，匈牙利国王马加什·科尔维努斯攻占它，堡垒一直由匈牙利控制到1521年。在哈布斯堡与奥斯曼战争中，沙巴茨多次易手。1739年重归奥斯曼后，它发展为两大帝国边境上的集镇。第一次塞尔维亚起义期间，卡拉乔尔杰的军队于1806年在附近的米沙尔击败奥斯曼军。第二次起义后，沙巴茨成为自治的塞尔维亚公国的一部分；耶夫雷姆·奥布雷诺维奇在此建立住所，推动新机构的发展。

english: Sabalgarh stands beneath a fort on a rocky hill near the Chambal country. The fort is associated with a local chief named Sabala and with the rulers of Karauli, who strengthened the settlement. Its position made it a valuable stronghold amid the eighteenth-century contests between Rajput chiefs and Maratha forces. The Scindia rulers of Gwalior later held Sabalgarh, and Daulat Rao Scindia resided in the fort during his rule.
simp_chinese: 萨巴尔加尔位于昌巴尔地区附近，一座岩山上的堡垒俯瞰城镇。堡垒与名为萨巴拉的地方首领及加劳利统治者有关，后者曾加强这处聚落。十八世纪拉杰普特首领与马拉塔军队争斗时，这里是具有价值的据点。瓜廖尔的辛迪亚统治者后来掌有萨巴尔加尔，道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚在位时曾居住于堡内。

english: Sabana is a name associated with the Indigenous country of central Cuba’s northern coast. Low plains reach toward shallow bays and a long chain of offshore cays, forming a landscape of mangroves, channels and sheltered waters. The name survived in the geography of the coast after the Spanish conquest, alongside the neighboring name Sabaneque. The islands along this shore lay near routes followed by ships sailing between the Caribbean and the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 萨瓦纳是与古巴中部北岸原住民地域相关的名称。低地平原伸向浅湾与绵长的外海礁岛，红树林、水道和受庇护的水域交织成一片沿海景观。西班牙征服之后，这一名称与相邻的萨巴内克一道保留在海岸地名中。沿岸岛屿靠近船只往来加勒比海与大西洋的航线。

sources.title: Historia de la Provincia de Ciego de Ávila

english: The Sabanê are an Indigenous people associated with the northern reaches of Nambikwara country, between the Tenente Marques and Juruena rivers. Their language forms a distinct branch of the Nambikwara family, differing markedly from its northern and southern relatives. The forested headwaters of these rivers belong to a region inhabited by neighbouring peoples with diverse languages and long histories of contact.
simp_chinese: 萨巴内人是与南比夸拉地区北部相联系的原住民族，生活在特南蒂马尔克斯河与茹鲁埃纳河之间。他们的语言是南比夸拉语系的一个独立分支，与北部和南部的同系语言差异显著。这些河流源头的森林地区居住着众多邻近民族，语言多样，彼此往来历史悠久。

english: The Sabangau River runs through a vast peat-swamp forest between the Katingan and Kahayan in southern Borneo. Its dark water drains deep layers of waterlogged plant material, while trees grow above the peat. Riverbank forest gives way inland to other forms of swamp woodland, creating a distinctive lowland landscape before the waterways reach the Java Sea.
simp_chinese: 萨邦高河流经婆罗洲南部卡廷安河与卡哈扬河之间广阔的泥炭沼泽林。深色河水排出深厚积水植物层中的水分，树木生长在泥炭之上。河岸森林向内陆逐渐过渡为其他类型的沼泽林，形成水道注入爪哇海之前独特的低地景观。

sources.title: Harrison-13-KFCP PSF phenology influence abiotic-variables on selected spp-Sabangau-Tuanan.pdf

english: Şabanözü lies south of Çankırı, in the inland country between that town and Ankara. The local Ulu Cami and Bakırlı mosque are among the landmarks of the settlement. In the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, the district also appears in the struggles of Ottoman provincial notables. Süleyman Bey of Çankırı was charged with punishing a man who claimed the position of local notable in Şabanözü, a reminder that authority in the provinces was often contested close to home.
simp_chinese: 沙巴讷祖位于昌克勒以南，处在昌克勒与安卡拉之间的内陆。当地的大清真寺和巴克尔勒清真寺是聚落的地标。十八世纪末至十九世纪初，这里也出现在奥斯曼地方名流的争斗中：昌克勒的苏莱曼贝伊曾受命惩处一位自称沙巴讷祖地方名流的人，显示省内权力在地方上同样存在争夺。

english:
Sabará stands at the meeting of the Sabará and Rio das Velhas rivers in the mining country of Minas Gerais. Its older name, Sabarabuçu, was associated with stories of a mountain of precious stones that drew expeditions into the Brazilian interior. The settlement that arose here became one of the earliest towns of the gold districts, its churches and public buildings reflecting the wealth extracted from the surrounding lands.

The expedition of Fernão Dias Paes reached the region in 1674 in search of mineral riches. Gold discoveries brought a rush of settlers, and after the War of the Emboabas the governor Antônio de Albuquerque established the Vila Real de Nossa Senhora da Conceição do Sabará in 1711. The Portuguese crown installed a foundry to supervise and tax gold; the Sabará foundry operated, with interruptions, from the eighteenth century until 1830. Its parish church, dedicated to Our Lady of the Conception, was inaugurated in 1710.
simp_chinese:
萨巴拉坐落在萨巴拉河与韦利亚斯河交汇处，位于米纳斯吉拉斯的矿区。它的旧称萨巴拉布库与一座盛产宝石的传说之山有关，这个传说曾吸引探险队深入巴西内陆。此地发展出的聚落成为金矿地区最早的城镇之一，教堂和公共建筑反映了从周围土地中开采出的财富。

1674年，费尔南·迪亚斯·派斯率领的探险队为寻找矿产抵达这一地区。黄金的发现引来大量移民；恩博阿巴斯战争之后，总督安东尼奥·迪阿尔布克尔克于1711年设立萨巴拉圣母无染原罪皇家镇。葡萄牙王室设立熔金所，监督黄金并征税；萨巴拉熔金所自十八世纪起间歇运作，直至1830年关闭。供奉无染原罪圣母的堂区教堂则于1710年落成。

english: Savè, or Sabe, was the centre of a Yoruba-speaking kingdom west of Oyo. Its ruler bore the title Onisabe, and royal tradition traced the first king to Oduduwa of Ile-Ife. Sabe's language and political traditions also show close connections with Oyo, while the kingdom developed its own place among the states of the western Yoruba frontier. By the late eighteenth century it was an independent kingdom in a region influenced by both Oyo and Dahomey.
simp_chinese: 萨韦又称萨贝，是奥约以西一个约鲁巴语王国的中心。统治者称奥尼萨贝，王室传统将首位国王追溯至伊莱伊费的奥杜杜瓦。萨贝的语言与政治传统也显示它同奥约关系密切；与此同时，这个王国在约鲁巴西部边疆诸国之间发展出自己的地位。十八世纪末，它是奥约与达荷美共同影响下的一个独立王国。

english: Sabha lies among the oases of Fezzan, north of Murzuq and east of the Wadi al-Ajal. Palm gardens and wells sustain settlement in a region surrounded by desert plains and dunes. The oasis country of Fezzan has long linked the Mediterranean coast with the central Sahara: routes south from Tripoli passed through this region towards Murzuq and the lands of Lake Chad. Nearby oasis settlements form a chain across the dry landscape.
simp_chinese: 塞卜哈位于费赞绿洲地区，处在穆尔祖格以北、阿贾勒河谷以东。棕榈园和水井维持着聚落，周围则是荒漠平原与沙丘。费赞绿洲地区长期连接地中海海岸与撒哈拉中部：从的黎波里南行的道路经过这里，通往穆尔祖格和乍得湖地区。附近的绿洲聚落在干旱土地上组成一条链。

english: Sabina is the hill country northeast of Rome, named for the ancient Sabines. Their territory extended between the Tiber and the mountains of central Italy; the Nera marked a boundary with Umbria. After the Roman conquest, Sabine lands were incorporated into the republic. In the early Middle Ages parts of the region belonged to the Lombard Duchy of Spoleto; later the popes governed it directly or through local counts, including members of the Crescentii family.
simp_chinese: 萨比纳是罗马东北方的丘陵地区，得名于古代萨宾人。他们的土地位于台伯河与意大利中部群山之间，内拉河构成与翁布里亚的边界。罗马征服后，萨宾领地被并入共和国。中世纪早期，这一地区的部分土地属于伦巴第人的斯波莱托公国；后来教皇直接统治此地，或通过地方伯爵治理，其中包括克雷申齐家族的成员。

english: Cayo Sabinal lies off Cuba’s northern coast, north of the Bay of Nuevitas and east of Cayo Guajaba. The cay belongs to the Sabana–Camagüey archipelago, a long chain of islands and reefs extending along the Cuban shore. The Atlantic faces its northern side, while the waters behind it lead towards the mainland bays. Reefs and shallow banks make this coast a distinctive maze of islands and channels.
simp_chinese: 萨比纳尔礁岛位于古巴北岸外，在努埃维塔斯湾以北、瓜哈巴礁岛以东。它属于萨瓦纳—卡马圭群岛，这条漫长的岛屿与礁石链沿古巴海岸延伸。礁岛北侧面向大西洋，背后的水域则通向大陆一侧的海湾。礁石与浅滩使这片海岸成为岛屿和水道交织的迷宫。

english: Sabine Lake is a broad estuary on the Gulf coast, formed where the Sabine and Neches rivers meet before reaching the sea. Shallow water, marshes and surrounding forests make it a meeting place of fresh and salt water. Indigenous peoples inhabited the rivers and coast around the lake, including Atakapan-speaking communities to the west. The estuary offered fish and shellfish as well as a water route between the inland rivers and the Gulf of Mexico.
simp_chinese: 萨宾湖是墨西哥湾沿岸宽阔的河口湖，萨宾河与内奇斯河在入海前于此汇合。浅水、沼泽和周围森林构成淡水与海水交汇的环境。原住民居住在湖泊周围的河流与海岸，包括西方说阿塔卡帕语的社区。河口湖提供鱼贝，也是一条连接内陆河流与墨西哥湾的水路。

english: Sablé-sur-Sarthe lies where a castle overlooks the Sarthe and the town's river crossing. The medieval stronghold stood between Maine and Anjou, while the river connected its market to the towns downstream. In 1711 Jean-Baptiste Colbert de Torcy, foreign minister under Louis XIV, purchased the marquisate of Sablé. He replaced the old fortress with a grand residence on the same commanding site. The new château reflected the ambitions of a royal minister, while the town continued to grow beside the river below.
simp_chinese: 萨尔特河畔萨布莱的城堡俯瞰河流与渡口。中世纪据点位于曼恩和安茹之间，河流则将市集与下游城镇相连。1711年，路易十四的外交大臣让—巴蒂斯特·科尔贝尔·德托尔西购得萨布莱侯爵领。他在同一处高地以宏大宅邸取代旧堡，新城堡体现了王室大臣的抱负，城镇则继续在下方河畔发展。

english: Sabt Bani Bishr is a settlement in the mountain country of the Banu Bishr in Asir. Its name recalls the Saturday market, one of the district's traditional gathering places. Mountain passes connect the highlands with the Tihamah lowlands; markets among the Banu Bishr brought together people from villages and pastoral country, with livestock, grain, honey and other produce carried up the steep routes.
simp_chinese: 萨卜特·巴尼比什尔是阿西尔巴努比什尔山地中的一处聚落，地名让人想起周六集市这一传统聚会场所。山口连接高地与提哈马低地；巴努比什尔人的集市吸引村庄与牧区的人们聚集，牲畜、谷物、蜂蜜和其他物产沿陡峭山路运来。

english:
Sabu belongs to the Lesser Sunda Islands, where seasonal rain, dry land and coastal waters shape livelihoods. Farming and livestock provide resources alongside fishing and exchange. Water and plant knowledge matter as conditions change through the year. Boats connect shores and neighbouring islands, with winds and currents influencing travel.

In the later medieval and early modern periods, trade, migration and political relationships connected the wider eastern Indonesian islands. Communities and rulers negotiated alliances while exchanging food, livestock, textiles and other goods. Religious traditions varied between islands, and merchants and migrants brought outside influences. Portuguese and Dutch interests added commercial and political pressure, while local institutions continued to organise land and work.
simp_chinese:
萨布属于小巽他群岛，季节性降雨、干地和沿海水域影响居民生计。耕作、畜牧、捕鱼与交换共同提供资源。全年条件变化使水源和植物知识十分重要；船只连接海岸与邻岛，风向和海流影响航行。

中世纪后期至近代早期，东印度尼西亚广大岛屿通过贸易、迁徙和政治关系相连。社群与统治者协商联盟，交换食物、牲畜、纺织品等货物。各岛宗教传统不同，商人和移民也带来外来影响。葡萄牙与荷兰势力增加商业和政治压力，地方制度仍继续组织土地利用与劳动。

english:
Sabugal stands above the Côa River in the upland border country of eastern Portugal. The town was founded under Alfonso IX of León, who granted it a charter. The Treaty of Alcañices in 1297 confirmed the area for Portugal, after which King Dinis strengthened the castle with a distinctive pentagonal keep.

King Manuel granted Sabugal a new municipal charter in 1515. Its Jewish heritage is recorded from at least the sixteenth century. During the Peninsular War, the Battle of Sabugal in 1811 brought British and Portuguese troops into conflict with the retreating French army near the town.
simp_chinese:
萨布加尔位于葡萄牙东部边境高地，俯瞰科阿河。莱昂国王阿方索九世建立城镇并授予特许状。1297年《阿尔卡尼塞斯条约》确认此地归属葡萄牙，此后国王迪尼斯加强城堡，修建了独特的五角主塔。

1515年，国王曼努埃尔向萨布加尔颁发新的市镇特许状。当地犹太人遗产至少可追溯至16世纪。半岛战争期间，1811年的萨布加尔战役使英葡军队与撤退中的法军在城镇附近交战。

english: Sabya lies on the Tihamah plain north of Jazan, west of Jabal Akwah. It grew into one of the towns of the Mikhlaf Sulaymani, the coastal country between the mountains and the Red Sea. A local historical tradition credits Sharif Idris ibn Mahwas al-Khawaji with laying out the town in 1551–52. In 1728 Sharif Ahmad led a campaign against Sabya, reflecting the contests over authority among the rulers of this region.
simp_chinese: 萨比亚位于吉赞以北的提哈马平原，阿克瓦山以西。它发展为苏莱曼尼辖区的城镇之一，所在地区夹在群山与红海之间。地方历史传统认为，谢里夫伊德里斯·伊本·马赫瓦斯·哈瓦吉于1551—1552年规划了这座城镇。1728年，谢里夫艾哈迈德率军进攻萨比亚，反映出这一地区统治者之间对权力的争夺。

english:
Sabzevar stands in the Bayhaq district of western Khorasan, on a major caravan route across the Iranian plateau toward Nishapur. Its busy markets and surrounding villages made it an important regional centre of commerce. In the fourteenth century the city became the seat of the Sarbadars, a movement whose name evokes their willingness to risk the gallows rather than submit to oppression. Their rule brought together urban notables, soldiers and religious adherents, though these groups did not always agree.

The movement began in the nearby village of Bashtin amid the disintegration of Ilkhanid authority. In 1337 Abd al-Razzaq took Sabzevar, and his brother Masud extended Sarbadar power across much of western Khorasan. The city became the base for campaigns against neighbouring rulers. Rivalries between the military leaders, local elites and followers of the religious teacher Hasan Juri repeatedly disturbed the state; after Masud's death his commander Muhammad Ay Timur ruled from Sabzevar until his assassination in 1346.

The Sarbadars continued to contend with the powers around them, at times taking Tus and Mashhad as well as Nishapur. Their independence ended as Timur advanced into Khorasan, and their last ruler submitted to him in 1381. The soldiers of Sabzevar subsequently served in Timurid campaigns, carrying the city's name beyond the frontier it had once defended.
simp_chinese:
萨卜泽瓦尔位于呼罗珊西部的拜哈格地区，坐落在横穿伊朗高原通往内沙布尔的重要商道上。市场和周围村庄使它成为重要的地区中心。十四世纪，城市成为萨尔巴达尔人的驻地；这一运动的名称令人想起他们宁赴绞架也不愿屈服压迫的决心。城市显贵、军人和宗教追随者共同参与统治，但彼此并非总能和睦相处。

伊儿汗国权威瓦解之际，这场运动发源于附近的巴什廷村。1337年，阿卜杜勒·拉扎克占领萨卜泽瓦尔，他的弟弟马苏德随后将势力扩展到呼罗珊西部大片地区。城市成为对邻国用兵的基地。军事领袖、地方精英和宗教导师哈桑·朱里追随者之间的竞争屡次动摇政权；马苏德死后，其将领穆罕默德·艾·帖木儿在此执政，直到1346年遇刺。

萨尔巴达尔人继续与周围势力争斗，一度占有内沙布尔、图斯和马什哈德。帖木儿进入呼罗珊时，他们的独立统治结束，末代统治者于1381年向他归附。此后萨卜泽瓦尔的士兵参加帖木儿的远征，将城市的名字带到曾经守卫的边疆之外。

english:
Sacchuma was a name recorded by members of Hernando de Soto's expedition for the Chakchiuma, a people of the upper Yazoo River country. Their name has been interpreted as “red crawfish,” referring to a tribal totem. French observers later described them as related to the Chickasaw and other peoples speaking western Muskogean languages.

In 1700 Carolina colonists encouraged Quapaw warriors to attack the Chakchiuma and seize captives for the slave trade, but the attack failed. The Chakchiuma later fought on the French side in the Yazoo War. Around 1739 conflict with the Chickasaw devastated them as an independent people; survivors joined Chickasaw and Choctaw communities, forming a Crawfish clan among the latter. A trader recorded Chakchiuma survivors living in Chickasaw villages in 1757.
simp_chinese:
萨楚马是埃尔南多·德索托远征队成员为查克丘马人记录的名称之一。查克丘马人居住在亚祖河上游地区，其族名被解释为“红色小龙虾”，指族群的图腾。法国观察者后来认为他们与奇克索人及其他讲西部马斯科吉语的民族有亲缘关系。

1700年，卡罗来纳殖民者鼓动夸波战士袭击查克丘马人，掳人贩卖为奴，但进攻失败。此后查克丘马人在亚祖战争中站在法国一方。约1739年，与奇克索人的冲突重创了这个独立族群；幸存者加入奇克索和乔克托社群，并在后者之中形成小龙虾氏族。1757年，一名商人记载查克丘马幸存者住在奇克索村庄。

english: Sachchaa Mukku lies in the fertile upper valley of Cochabamba, near Cliza. In the early sixteenth century the Incas settled people from many different regions in the Cochabamba valleys, drawing on their labour to cultivate land for the state. Under Spanish rule the valleys continued to produce grain, supplying the growing mining centres of Upper Peru and connecting agricultural communities with the silver economy.
simp_chinese: 萨查穆库位于科恰班巴肥沃的上谷地，靠近克利萨。十六世纪初，印加人将许多不同地区的居民迁入科恰班巴河谷，利用他们的劳动为国家耕种土地。西班牙统治下，河谷继续生产粮食，供应不断扩张的上秘鲁矿业中心，将农业社群与白银经济连接起来。

english: Sach'ŏn lies on a bay along Korea's southern coast. In 1592 Admiral Yi Sunsin brought his fleet into these waters against Japanese ships. A turtle ship led the Korean attack as the tide rose, followed by the other warships. During the renewed invasion, the Japanese built a coastal fortress here; in 1598 Korean and Ming forces attacked it as part of a wider campaign against Japanese strongholds.
simp_chinese: 泗川位于朝鲜南海岸的一处海湾。1592年，李舜臣率舰队在这片水域迎战日本船只。涨潮时，龟船率先冲入敌阵，其余战船随之进攻。日军再次入侵期间在当地修筑海岸城堡；1598年，朝明军队进攻此城，作为针对日军据点的更大规模行动的一部分。

english:
Sacheon Bay lies on Korea's southern coast, among tidal channels, islands and coastal settlements. Boats connected communities along the shore, while nearby farmland and marine resources supported local livelihoods. Knowledge of tides and anchorages mattered to movement through these waters.

During the Japanese invasions of Korea, Sacheon's waters became the scene of a naval battle in 1592. A Joseon fleet under Yi Sun-sin and other commanders fought Japanese forces off Sacheon; the engagement is remembered for the use of a turtle ship in combat. The battle brought a sheltered stretch of coast into a war that reached across the peninsula and its surrounding seas.
simp_chinese:
泗川湾位于朝鲜半岛南岸，周围分布着岛屿、潮汐水道和沿海聚落。舟船连接岸边的社区，附近农田与海洋资源则维持当地生计。熟悉潮汐和泊地，对在这些水域航行十分重要。

日本侵朝战争期间，泗川海域在1592年成为一场海战的战场。李舜臣等将领率领朝鲜水军在泗川外海迎战日军；这场战斗因龟船投入实战而闻名。战争由此波及这片相对隐蔽的海岸，也将其同半岛及周边海域的广大战局联系起来。

english:
Sada was a port on Madagascar's northwestern coast, in the maritime country around Ampasindava Bay. It belonged to a region connected by trade with the Comoros, East Africa and other shores of the Indian Ocean, where merchants exchanged goods carried across the open sea. The port formed part of a kingdom known in Portuguese accounts as Guingemaro, which emerged in the same region as the earlier trading town of Mahilaka.

Portuguese navigators reached Madagascar at the beginning of the sixteenth century. In 1506 they attacked and sacked Sada, bringing violence to a long established centre of trade. Its history reveals a coast already connected to the ocean before European ships began to challenge the merchants and rulers who held power there.
simp_chinese:
萨达是马达加斯加西北岸的一座港口，位于安帕西达瓦湾周边的海上地区。这里通过贸易与科摩罗、东非及印度洋其他海岸相连，商人在这些地方交换跨海运来的货物。港口属于葡萄牙记述中称为金格马鲁的王国，该王国在更早的贸易城镇马希拉卡所在地区兴起。

葡萄牙航海者于十六世纪初抵达马达加斯加。1506年，他们袭击并洗劫萨达，将暴力带到这一已有贸易中心。其历史显示，欧洲船只开始挑战当地掌权的商人和统治者之前，这段海岸已经与大洋各地相连。

sources.title: Histoire physique, naturelle, et politique de Madagascar (IA histoirephysique01gran).pdf

english:
Sadah is a walled city of the northern Yemeni highlands, on the inland route from Sanaa toward Najran. Its earth-built houses, markets and mosques stand within fortifications adapted to the plateau landscape. Before Islam the district was a station on the trade routes of southern Arabia; in the Islamic centuries Sadah became a centre of religious learning and political authority.

In 897 Yahya ibn al-Husayn, known as al-Hadi, established himself at Sadah and became imam. His teaching and his descendants' claims laid the foundations of the Zaydi imamate in Yemen. The mosque and mausoleum associated with him became enduring landmarks of the city; the dome of his tomb is considered among the earliest funerary domes in Yemen. Zaydi authority did not remain confined to Sadah. Rival imams and dynasties contested towns and strongholds across the highlands, and Ottoman armies entered Yemen in the sixteenth century. The city's place on the northern road and its association with the imamate ensured that it remained important in the struggles that shaped Yemen's later history.
simp_chinese:
萨达是也门北部高地上的有墙城镇，坐落在从萨那通向纳季兰的内陆道路上。土筑房屋、集市和清真寺位于适应高原地形的防御工事之内。伊斯兰教兴起前，这一地区已是南阿拉伯商路上的一站；伊斯兰时期，萨达成为宗教学术和政治权力的中心。

897年，叶海亚·伊本·侯赛因在萨达立足，成为伊玛目，人称哈迪。他的教导及其后代的权利主张，为也门宰德派伊玛目国奠定了基础。与他相关的清真寺和陵墓成为城中长期留存的地标；其墓穹顶被认为是也门最早的墓葬穹顶之一。宰德派的权力并不限于萨达。相互竞争的伊玛目和王朝争夺高地各处城镇与堡垒，奥斯曼军队也在十六世纪进入也门。萨达位于北方道路上，又与伊玛目国密切相关，因而在塑造也门后期历史的斗争中始终具有重要地位。

english: The Sadak rises near Matveyevka and flows to the Dyoma, joining it from the left near Dmitriyevka. Its waters belong to the Kama basin: the Dyoma joins the Belaya, which continues north to the Kama and thence to the Volga. The Sadak drains a network of small tributaries and lakes in the country between the Samara and Belaya river systems. Its valley lies in a region of steppe and woodland west of the southern Urals.
simp_chinese: 萨达克河发源于马特韦耶夫卡附近，在德米特里耶夫卡一带从左岸汇入焦马河。它属于卡马河流域：焦马河流入别拉亚河，后者向北汇入卡马河，再通往伏尔加河。萨达克河汇集了萨马拉河和别拉亚河水系之间众多小支流与湖泊的水，其河谷位于南乌拉尔以西的草原和林地之间。

english: The Saddle Hills rise sharply above the Peace River lowlands, their slopes giving way to the gentler country of the river valley. The Saddle River begins in these heights and cuts northeast across the lowlands to meet the Peace. The wider country was a homeland of the Dane-zaa, or Beaver people; Cree people also came west into the region. A peace between the peoples gave the great river its name and made its valley a place of meeting and trade.
simp_chinese: 鞍状山丘陡然高出和平河低地，山坡向下过渡为较平缓的河谷地带。萨德尔河发源于这片高地，向东北切过低地，汇入和平河。周围地区是达内扎人，即比弗人的家园，克里人也向西进入这一带。两族达成和平后，大河得名和平河，河谷成为人们相会和交易的地方。

english: South of the Peace River, wooded hills rise around a country of open prairie and river valleys. Bison and elk once ranged across the great prairie, while trails linked its lakes and surrounding uplands with the Peace valley. Dane-zaa, or Beaver, and Cree people lived in the area, travelling in family groups and meeting in larger gatherings. Their paths connected this country with Sturgeon Lake, the upper Athabasca and the river to the north.
simp_chinese: 和平河以南，林木覆盖的丘陵环绕着开阔草原和河谷。野牛与马鹿曾成群活动在大草原上，小径将湖泊、周边高地和和平河谷连接起来。达内扎人，即比弗人，与克里人在这一带生活，家庭结伴旅行，也在更大的集会中相聚。他们的道路通向斯特金湖、阿萨巴斯卡河上游和北面的和平河。

english: Saddleback Island rises off the southern coast of Baffin Island in Hudson Strait. Named for its shape, it is the largest and highest of the Middle Savage Islands, surrounded by smaller islands, rocks and dangerous shoals. The tides here can rise more than ten metres, driving strong currents between the islands; wind against the current can raise a heavy sea. In 1819 John Franklin's party reached Saddleback Island as a rendezvous on its journey through the strait.
simp_chinese: 鞍背岛耸立在哈得孙海峡中，靠近巴芬岛南岸，因形似马鞍而得名。它是中萨维奇群岛中最大、最高的一座，周围散布着小岛、岩礁和危险浅滩。此处潮差可超过十米，强劲潮流穿行于岛屿之间；逆流而来的风能掀起巨浪。1819年，约翰·富兰克林的队伍经过海峡，以鞍背岛为会合地点。

english: Sadeng is remembered as a small realm in the Puger country of eastern Java, near the southern coast. In 1331 it rose against Majapahit alongside Keta. The Nagarakretagama records that Queen Tribhuwana and her husband suppressed the revolt, while the Pararaton tells of rivalry over command of the campaign. Gajah Mada's role in the conflict became part of the story of his ascent to the highest office at the Majapahit court.
simp_chinese: 萨登相传是爪哇东部普格尔地区的一个小王国，靠近南部海岸。1331年，它与克塔一同反抗满者伯夷。《爪哇史颂》记载，女王特里布瓦娜及其丈夫平定了叛乱；《列王纪》则讲述了争夺征讨军指挥权的竞争。加查·马达在冲突中的作用，成为他升任满者伯夷王廷最高官职的故事的一部分。

english:
Sadhaura lies near the Himalayan foothills, on a route traditionally used by Hindu ascetics travelling to the Ganges. Its old mound and fort recall a long history of settlement, while the town's shrines include the fifteenth-century tomb of Shah Kumesh. Early coins found here range from those of the Kunindas to issues of the Hindu Shahis.

In the early eighteenth century Banda Singh Bahadur's Sikh forces defeated the local Mughal chief Usman Khan and took Sadhaura. Usman Khan was killed, the fort was destroyed and the town plundered. Banda Singh established a stronghold at nearby Lohgarh, which became associated with his campaigns against Mughal authority. Sadhaura also preserves the memory of Pir Budhan Shah, who had supported Guru Gobind Singh.
simp_chinese:
萨达乌罗靠近喜马拉雅山麓，传统上是印度教苦行者前往恒河途中经过的地方。古老的土丘与堡垒诉说着悠久的聚落历史，城中的圣迹还包括十五世纪沙阿·库梅什的陵墓。当地发现的早期钱币，从拘林陀王国的钱币到印度沙希王朝的钱币都有。

十八世纪初，班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔率领的锡克军队击败当地莫卧儿首领乌斯曼汗，夺取萨达乌罗。乌斯曼汗被杀，堡垒被毁，城镇遭到劫掠。班达·辛格在附近的洛赫加尔建立据点，并从那里展开反抗莫卧儿统治的行动。萨达乌罗还保存着皮尔·布丹沙阿的记忆，他曾支持古鲁·戈宾德·辛格。

english:
Sadiya lies near the head of the Brahmaputra valley, where rivers descend from the eastern Himalayan hills to meet the plains of Assam. It was a centre of the Chutia kingdom, whose rulers held territory along the upper Brahmaputra. The Tamreswari temple near Sadiya was associated with the worship of the goddess Kechai Khaiti.

The Chutias and Ahoms fought for control of the upper valley. In the early sixteenth century the Ahom king Suhungmung conquered the Chutia kingdom and placed the Sadiya country under a frontier governor known as the Sadiya Khowa Gohain. The temple and its traditions continued after the conquest. Towards the end of the eighteenth century Khamti settlers came to the region, and their chiefs displaced the Ahom governor. The meeting of hill routes and great rivers kept Sadiya an important frontier between the Assam plain and the mountains.
simp_chinese:
萨地亚位于布拉马普特拉河谷上游附近，东喜马拉雅山的河流在这里流入阿萨姆平原。它曾是丘蒂亚王国的中心，其统治者控制着布拉马普特拉河上游的土地。萨地亚附近的塔姆雷什瓦里寺与女神凯柴·凯蒂的崇拜相联系。

丘蒂亚人与阿洪人为争夺上游河谷而交战。十六世纪初，阿洪王苏洪蒙征服丘蒂亚王国，并任命称为萨地亚科瓦戈海因的边境总督管理这一地区。征服之后，寺庙及其传统仍延续下来。十八世纪末，坎蒂人来到此地定居，其首领取代了阿洪总督。山路和大河在此交会，使萨地亚成为阿萨姆平原与山地之间的重要边境。

english: Sadovoye lies beside a lake in the Bityug country, east of Voronezh. Service people are said to have founded the village around the end of the seventeenth century; in 1701 palace peasants were transferred here.
